axes.note: Every axis is on 0 to 1. Structural axes are measured from the prepared JPEG by image_analysis.py; narrative axes come only from a vision model's reading and are skipped when none is available. Photographer targets are editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements of it. Weights say how much an axis counts; tolerance is the absolute difference at which closeness reaches zero.

photographers.intro_en: A painter who photographed New York through steamed windows, rain and reflections on expired slide film, decades before colour was taken seriously. His frames are mostly obstruction, with the subject a small warm note in a field of muted colour.
photographers.intro_zh: 一个画家，用过期反转片透过蒙雾的窗、雨和倒影拍摄纽约，比彩色摄影被认真看待早了几十年。他的画面大部分是遮挡，主体只是一片柔和色彩中一个小小的暖色音符。

traits_en.color: Muted, desaturated with one accent, often red; expired film shifts.
traits_en.composition: Layered through glass; subject tiny and off-centre; large obstructed foregrounds.
traits_en.light: Overcast, snow, rain-blurred window light.

traits_zh.color: 柔和、低饱和，只留一个强调色，常常是红；过期胶片带来偏色。
traits_zh.composition: 透过玻璃层叠；主体很小并偏离中心；大面积被遮挡的前景。
traits_zh.light: 阴天、雪、被雨模糊的窗光。
traits_zh.tone: 柔和、低反差、温柔的高光。
traits_zh.texture: 柔焦、水汽、反转片的颗粒。

signature_en: A red umbrella in a grey street
A figure seen through a fogged window
Most of the frame given to blur or shadow
signature_zh: 灰色街道里的一把红伞
透过雾气窗户看到的人
大半画面交给模糊或阴影
photographers.explore_en: Shoot through something: a window, an awning, a passing coat. Let one small warm colour be the only subject.
photographers.explore_zh: 隔着什么东西拍：一扇窗、一块雨篷、一件走过的外套。让一小块暖色成为唯一的主体。

photographers.intro_en: The photographer who made colour respectable: a red ceiling, a tricycle, a freezer, all rendered in dye-transfer prints of saturated, oddly exact colour. The subject is never the thing but the colour relationships around it.
photographers.intro_zh: 让彩色摄影获得尊重的人。一面红色天花板、一辆三轮车、一台冰柜，全都以染料转印工艺呈现出饱和而奇异精确的色彩。主体从来不是那件东西，而是围绕它的色彩关系。

traits_en.color: Saturated, warm, with precise relationships between two or three hues.
traits_en.composition: Deadpan, often low or odd angles; one object given full attention.
traits_en.light: Southern daylight, fluorescent interiors, dusk.

traits_zh.color: 饱和、温暖，两三种色相之间关系精确。
traits_zh.composition: 面无表情，常用低角度或古怪的角度；一件物品得到全部注意。
traits_zh.light: 南方的日光、荧光灯的室内、黄昏。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，干净的高光。

signature_en: An ordinary object made monumental by colour
Red against green or blue, exactly balanced
Low angles that make the familiar strange
signature_zh: 被色彩变得纪念碑化的普通物件
红对绿或蓝，恰到好处的平衡
让熟悉之物变陌生的低角度
photographers.explore_en: Photograph something nobody would, from an angle nobody would, and judge the frame by colour alone.
photographers.explore_zh: 拍没人会拍的东西，用没人会用的角度，只用色彩来评判这张照片。

photographers.intro_en: The large-format eye of the American road: intersections, motels and plates of food described with total clarity and no drama. Everything is in focus, everything is level, nothing is emphasised.
photographers.intro_zh: 大画幅的美国公路之眼：十字路口、汽车旅馆、一盘盘食物，以完全的清晰和毫无戏剧性呈现。一切都对焦、一切都水平、没有任何强调。

traits_en.color: Natural, moderately saturated, true to daylight.
traits_en.composition: Level horizons, rectilinear, centred vanishing points, deep focus.
traits_en.light: Bright, even daylight; flat.
traits_en.tone: Low to medium contrast, open shadows, bright highlights.

traits_zh.color: 自然、中等饱和、忠于日光。
traits_zh.composition: 水平的地平线、直线构图、居中的消失点、全景深。
traits_zh.light: 明亮均匀的日光，平。
traits_zh.tone: 低到中等反差，明亮的暗部与高光。
traits_zh.texture: 8×10 大画幅的锐度，没有颗粒。

signature_en: An intersection seen as an exact map
A motel room or diner table in flat daylight
Deep focus with nothing singled out
signature_zh: 像精确地图一样的十字路口
平淡日光下的汽车旅馆房间或餐桌
没有任何重点的全景深
photographers.explore_en: Level the camera, stop down, stand where the lines converge, and refuse to make anything the subject.
photographers.explore_zh: 把相机放水平，收小光圈，站在线条汇聚的地方，拒绝让任何东西成为主体。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: From fast colour street work in 1960s New York to the slow, luminous large-format pictures of Cape Light: porches at dusk, bay water, bathers, all held in a soft, pearly light.
photographers.intro_zh: 从 1960 年代纽约快速的彩色街拍，到《海角之光》里缓慢而明亮的大画幅：黄昏的门廊、海湾的水、泳者，全都笼罩在柔和珍珠般的光里。

traits_en.color: Pastel, luminous, warm dusk colour; later work especially soft.
traits_en.composition: Open, horizontal, lots of sky and air.
traits_en.light: Twilight, overcast, long soft gradations.
traits_en.tone: Bright key, low contrast, highlights that never break.

traits_zh.color: 粉彩般、发光、温暖的黄昏色；后期作品尤其柔和。
traits_zh.composition: 开阔、水平、大量的天空和空气。
traits_zh.light: 暮色、阴天、漫长柔和的渐变。
traits_zh.tone: 明亮的调子、低反差、从不断裂的高光。

signature_en: A porch or pool at dusk in pale colour
Sky filling most of the frame
Light that seems to come from everywhere
signature_zh: 暮色中淡彩的门廊或泳池
占满大半画面的天空
仿佛来自四面八方的光
series: Bystander: A History of Street Photography (1994)
photographers.explore_en: Go out in the last half hour of light with a tripod, expose for the shadows, and leave most of the frame to sky.
photographers.explore_zh: 在最后半小时的光线里带上三脚架出门，按暗部曝光，把大半画面留给天空。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A nanny who photographed Chicago and New York for forty years with a Rolleiflex at waist level and showed almost no one. Square frames, direct encounters with strangers, and self-portraits in shop windows.
photographers.intro_zh: 一位保姆，用腰平取景的禄来相机拍了芝加哥和纽约四十年，几乎不给任何人看。方形画面、与陌生人的直接相遇、橱窗里的自拍。

traits_en.color: Black and white on the Rolleiflex; Ektachrome colour later.
traits_en.composition: Square, waist-level, subject centred and close.
traits_en.light: Street daylight, often slightly from above.

traits_zh.color: 禄来相机的黑白；后期用 Ektachrome 彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 方画幅、腰平视角、主体居中且贴近。
traits_zh.light: 街头日光，常略从上方来。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，完整的灰阶。
traits_zh.texture: 中画幅的平滑，颗粒适度。

signature_en: A stranger looking straight into a waist-level lens
A self-portrait reflected in a window
Children and the elderly caught mid-gesture
signature_zh: 直视腰平镜头的陌生人
映在橱窗里的自拍
动作进行中的孩子和老人
photographers.explore_en: Hold the camera at your waist, stand closer than you think you should, and let people notice you.
photographers.explore_zh: 把相机端在腰间，站得比你以为该站的更近，让人注意到你。
method_en: A Rolleiflex at the waist: with the camera below the face people stayed at ease, so she could stand very close, often a step away.
She caught a person's state, not just a person: nerves, doubt, pride, fatigue, never exaggerated, simply kept.
Three layers in a frame: a back in the foreground, the subject in the middle, the city behind, with the setting part of the story.
Her self-portraits never show her straight on: a mirror, a shop-window reflection or a shadow at the edge, there and not there.
Loneliness inside a busy street: people close together yet apart, recorded quietly and without judgement, leaving the verdict to the viewer.
She photographed only what truly interested her, never for publication, prizes or attention.
method_zh: 一台禄莱双反，腰平取景：不用把相机举到脸前，被拍的人戒备少，她因此能站得很近，常常只隔一步。
抓人的状态而不是人：紧张、疑惑、骄傲、疲惫，这些情绪不放大，只是真实地留下来。
画面有前、中、后三层：前景的背影、中间的主角、后面的城市一起讲故事，环境是故事的一部分。
自拍从不直接露脸，而是借镜子、橱窗倒影和影子出现在画面边缘，既在场又不在场。
热闹的街上拍出孤独：人群里彼此靠近又疏离的人，她安静地记录，不评判，把判断留给观看的人。
只拍自己真正感兴趣的东西，不为发表、获奖或流量。

photographers.intro_en: The Americans (1958) broke every rule of the well-made photograph: tilted, grainy, out of focus, cut off, and truer than anything before it. A melancholy outsider's road trip through a country that did not want to see itself.
photographers.intro_zh: 《美国人》（1958）打破了所有“好照片”的规则：倾斜、颗粒粗、失焦、被切断，却比此前的一切都更真实。一个忧郁的局外人穿越一个不愿看见自己的国家。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Off-kilter, cropped, figures turned away or cut by the edge.
traits_en.light: Dim interiors, jukebox glow, flat road light.
traits_en.tone: Murky greys, blocked shadows, rough highlights.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 歪斜、裁切，人物背对或被画框切断。
traits_zh.light: 昏暗的室内、点唱机的光、平淡的公路光。
traits_zh.tone: 浑浊的灰、堵死的暗部、粗糙的高光。

signature_en: A grainy, tilted frame that feels like a glance
Faces half-hidden or looking away
The road, the flag, the jukebox
signature_zh: 颗粒粗、歪斜、像一瞥的画面
半遮或别过去的脸
公路、国旗、点唱机
photographers.explore_en: Shoot fast, push the film, accept blur and tilt, and keep the frames that feel true rather than correct.
photographers.explore_zh: 快拍，迫冲胶片，接受模糊和倾斜，留下真实而不是正确的照片。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The most prolific street photographer of his era, wide lens tilted into crowds, frames crammed with simultaneous gestures. He photographed to find out what things looked like photographed.
photographers.intro_zh: 他那个时代最多产的街头摄影师，广角镜头倾斜地伸进人群，画面挤满同时发生的动作。他说拍照是为了看看事物被拍下来是什么样子。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Tilted horizons, wide angle, overflowing frames, edge-to-edge incident.
traits_en.light: Hard daylight, flash at events.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 倾斜的地平线、广角、溢出的画面，从边到边都是事件。
traits_zh.light: 硬朗的日光，活动现场用闪光灯。
traits_zh.tone: 中高反差。

signature_en: A tilted crowd with five separate gestures
Animals and people mirroring each other at the zoo
Chaos held just inside the frame
signature_zh: 倾斜画面里五个各自独立的动作
动物园里互相映照的动物与人
恰好被框住的混乱
photographers.explore_en: Use a 28 mm, walk into the crowd, tilt if you must, and shoot more than you can edit.
photographers.explore_zh: 用 28mm，走进人群，必要时倾斜，拍得比你能挑选的更多。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Seventy years of New York sidewalks: children playing, neighbours on stoops, chalk drawings on walls, first in black and white and from 1959 in gentle colour slides. Lyrical without ever being sweet.
photographers.intro_zh: 七十年的纽约人行道：玩耍的孩子、门阶上的邻居、墙上的粉笔画，先是黑白，1959 年起转为温和的彩色幻灯片。抒情而从不甜腻。

traits_en.color: Soft, warm Kodachrome in the colour years; mid-grey black and white before.
traits_en.composition: Small groups at mid distance; gestures balanced across the frame.
traits_en.light: Open street daylight.

traits_zh.color: 彩色时期是柔和温暖的 Kodachrome；之前是中灰的黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 中距离的小群体，动作在画面里平衡分布。
traits_zh.light: 开阔的街头日光。
traits_zh.tone: 温和的反差，没有刺眼之处。

signature_en: Children inventing a game on the sidewalk
A gesture that rhymes with another across the frame
Neighbourhood life seen at eye level
signature_zh: 在人行道上发明游戏的孩子
画面两端互相押韵的动作
平视的街坊生活
series: Slide Show: The Color Photographs of Helen Levitt (2005)
photographers.explore_en: Stand on one block for an afternoon and photograph only what people do with their hands and bodies.
photographers.explore_zh: 在一个街区站一下午，只拍人们用手和身体做的事。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The frontal, descriptive style that American documentary photography grew from: storefronts, signs and interiors photographed head-on with a view camera, in even light, with every detail legible and no comment added.
photographers.intro_zh: 美国纪实摄影由此生长的正面描述式风格：店面、招牌和室内，用大画幅正对着拍，光线均匀，每个细节清晰可读，不加任何评论。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Frontal, square-on, symmetrical; typographic surfaces.
traits_en.light: Flat, even daylight; no dramatic shadow.
traits_en.texture: Large-format sharpness; weathered surfaces rendered exactly.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 正面、正对、对称；充满文字的表面。
traits_zh.light: 平淡均匀的日光，没有戏剧性的阴影。
traits_zh.tone: 完整的灰阶，适中的反差。
traits_zh.texture: 大画幅的锐度，风化的表面被精确呈现。

signature_en: A storefront photographed square-on
Hand-painted signs and lettering
Interiors that describe a life without a person in them
signature_zh: 正对着拍的店面
手绘的招牌和字体
没有人却描述了一种生活的室内
series: Let Us Now Praise Famous Men (1941)
photographers.explore_en: Face the subject squarely, level the camera, wait for flat light, and remove yourself from the picture.
photographers.explore_zh: 正对主体，放平相机，等平淡的光，把你自己从照片里拿掉。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Square, frontal, flash-lit portraits of people who look straight back: twins, giants, nudists, suburban families. The directness is unnerving because the subjects collaborate in it.
photographers.intro_zh: 方画幅、正面、闪光灯下的肖像，被摄者直直地回望：双胞胎、巨人、天体主义者、郊区家庭。这种直接之所以令人不安，是因为被摄者参与其中。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Square, centred, frontal, subject filling the frame; black border.
traits_en.light: Direct on-camera flash, often in daylight; hard shadow behind.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 方画幅、居中、正面，主体充满画面；黑色边框。
traits_zh.light: 机顶直打闪光，常在日光下使用；身后硬影。
traits_zh.tone: 中高反差，被闪光压平。
traits_zh.texture: 中画幅的细节，略带颗粒。

signature_en: A person standing centred, looking straight into the lens
Flash in daylight making everything equally sharp
Twins, pairs and mirrored figures
signature_zh: 居中站立、直视镜头的人
日光下的闪光让一切同样清晰
双胞胎、成对与镜像的人物
photographers.explore_en: Ask someone to stand still in the centre, use a little flash even in daylight, and wait until they stop posing.
photographers.explore_zh: 请一个人静静站在中央，即使在日光下也用一点闪光，等到他们不再摆姿势。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Photographer of Harlem and jazz who printed in the darkest register photography allows: figures emerging from near-black, highlights kept low and velvety. Darkness in his work is a tone of tenderness, not of gloom.
photographers.intro_zh: 拍摄哈莱姆与爵士乐的摄影师，把照片印在摄影所允许的最暗区间：人物从近乎纯黑中浮现，高光压得低而丝绒。他作品里的黑暗是温柔的调子，不是阴郁。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Intimate distance, figures partly dissolved into shadow.
traits_en.light: Dim interiors, stage light, window light at dusk.
traits_en.tone: Very dark key, long smooth gradations through the shadows, no pure white.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 亲密的距离，人物部分溶解在阴影中。
traits_zh.light: 昏暗的室内、舞台灯、黄昏的窗光。
traits_zh.tone: 极暗的调子，暗部有漫长平滑的渐变，没有纯白。

signature_en: A face half-lit in a room that is mostly black
A musician caught in stage light
Shadows with detail where others would see nothing
signature_zh: 在近乎全黑的房间里半边受光的脸
舞台光下的乐手
别人看不见东西的阴影里仍有细节
photographers.explore_en: Underexpose the print until the highlights are grey, and look for the detail that survives in the shadows.
photographers.explore_zh: 把照片压暗到高光变灰，然后寻找在阴影里幸存的细节。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A formalist who reduced the world to line and tone: a single weed against snow, his wife Eleanor as a tiny figure in a lake, Chicago facades as pure pattern. High contrast and emptiness are his vocabulary.
photographers.intro_zh: 把世界简化为线条与影调的形式主义者：雪地上的一根枯草、妻子埃莉诺在湖中的小小身影、芝加哥的立面化作纯粹的图案。高反差与空无是他的词汇。

traits_en.color: Mostly black and white; quiet colour work later.
traits_en.composition: Minimal, one element in a field of white or black; strong verticals.
traits_en.light: Flat snow light or hard sun.
traits_en.tone: Extreme contrast, often only black and white.

traits_zh.color: 以黑白为主，后期有安静的彩色作品。
traits_zh.composition: 极简，白或黑的场域里只有一个元素；强烈的垂直线。
traits_zh.light: 平淡的雪光或硬朗的太阳。
traits_zh.tone: 极端反差，常常只有黑与白。

signature_en: A single dark line on a white field
A small figure in a vast empty space
Facades reduced to rhythm
signature_zh: 白色场域上的一道暗线
空旷空间里的一个小小身影
被简化为节奏的立面
photographers.explore_en: Find one line against one field, print for pure black and pure white, and leave everything else out.
photographers.explore_zh: 找到一个场域上的一根线，印成纯黑与纯白，把其他一切都去掉。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The visual diary that made the snapshot an art form: friends, lovers and herself in bedrooms and bars, lit by flash or lamp, in saturated reds and tungsten yellows. Nothing is staged and nothing is hidden.
photographers.intro_zh: 让快照成为艺术的视觉日记：朋友、爱人和她自己，在卧室和酒吧里，被闪光灯或台灯照亮，饱和的红与钨丝灯的黄。没有摆布，也没有隐藏。

traits_en.color: Saturated, warm, tungsten and flash colour; reds and golds.
traits_en.composition: Casual, close, snapshot framing; beds and mirrors.
traits_en.light: On-camera flash, bedside lamps, bar light.

traits_zh.color: 饱和、温暖的钨丝灯与闪光灯色彩；红与金。
traits_zh.composition: 随意、贴近的快照式取景；床与镜子。
traits_zh.light: 机顶闪光、床头灯、酒吧灯光。
traits_zh.tone: 幽暗的环境，闪光下明亮的皮肤。
traits_zh.texture: 颗粒明显的反转片，有时偏软。
traits_zh.mood: 亲密、生猛、充满爱、也悲伤。

signature_en: Someone you clearly know, on a bed, in lamplight
Flash reflected in a mirror
Red and gold tungsten colour
signature_zh: 你显然认识的人，在床上，在灯光里
镜子里反射的闪光
红与金的钨丝灯色
photographers.explore_en: Photograph the people in your own life, in the rooms you share, with whatever light is already on.
photographers.explore_zh: 拍你自己生活里的人，在你们共处的房间里，用已经亮着的任何灯。

photographers.intro_en: Suburban houses at night with one window lit, roads seen through a rain-streaked windshield, foggy fields in cold colour. Long exposures and film give the pictures a soft, sodium-lit melancholy.
photographers.intro_zh: 夜里只亮着一扇窗的郊区房子、透过雨痕挡风玻璃看到的公路、冷色调里的雾中田野。长曝光与胶片赋予画面柔和的、钠灯般的忧郁。

traits_en.color: Cool, desaturated, with warm sodium or window light as the only accent.
traits_en.composition: Sparse, centred, a lot of dark empty space.
traits_en.light: Night, fog, streetlamps, headlights; long exposures.
traits_en.tone: Dark key, deep shadows, gentle glowing highlights.
traits_en.texture: Soft, blurred through glass, film grain.

traits_zh.color: 冷、低饱和，唯一的强调是暖色的钠灯或窗光。
traits_zh.composition: 稀疏、居中，大量幽暗的空白。
traits_zh.light: 夜晚、雾、路灯、车灯；长曝光。
traits_zh.tone: 暗调、深影、温柔发光的高光。
traits_zh.texture: 柔和、隔着玻璃模糊、胶片颗粒。

signature_en: A house at night with one glowing window
A road dissolving in rain on the windshield
Fog that swallows the horizon
signature_zh: 夜里只有一扇窗发光的房子
在挡风玻璃雨水中溶解的公路
吞没地平线的雾
photographers.explore_en: Drive at night in bad weather, shoot through the windshield with a tripod, and let one small light carry the frame.
photographers.explore_zh: 在坏天气的夜里开车，架着三脚架隔着挡风玻璃拍，让一小点光撑起画面。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The grand American landscape at its most exacting: Yosemite, Moonrise over Hernandez, every tone placed by the Zone System from pure black to textured white. Sharp from the nearest rock to the farthest peak.
photographers.intro_zh: 最严谨的美国壮阔风景：优胜美地、赫尔南德斯的月出，每一个影调都用区域曝光法从纯黑到有质感的白精确安放。从最近的岩石到最远的山峰都清晰。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Grand vistas, strong foreground, layered distance; often symmetrical.
traits_en.light: Dramatic natural light, storms clearing, deep-filtered skies.
traits_en.tone: Full range with dense blacks and brilliant, textured highlights.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 宏大的远景、有力的前景、层叠的远近；常常对称。
traits_zh.light: 戏剧性的自然光、风暴初霁、滤镜压暗的天空。
traits_zh.tone: 从浓黑到明亮而有质感的高光的完整范围。
traits_zh.texture: 通篇大画幅的锐度，没有颗粒。

signature_en: A mountain range with a dark, filtered sky
Deep focus from foreground rock to distant peak
Every zone from black to white present
signature_zh: 滤镜压暗天空下的山脉
从前景岩石到远峰的全景深
从黑到白每一个区域都在
series: Sierra Nevada: The John Muir Trail (1938)
Yosemite and the Range of Light (1979)
photographers.explore_en: Use a tripod and the smallest aperture, previsualise where each tone will fall, and wait for the weather to break.
photographers.explore_zh: 用三脚架和最小光圈，预先想好每个影调落在哪里，等天气放晴的那一刻。

photographers.intro_en: Anti-photography that became a style: wide lens shoved into crowds, blur, grain, flare, faces pressed against the frame, printed with brutal contrast. New York 1956 looked like an assault and changed what a photobook could be.
photographers.intro_zh: 变成一种风格的反摄影：广角怼进人群，模糊、颗粒、眩光，脸压在画框上，以粗暴的反差印出。《纽约 1956》像一场突袭，改变了摄影书的可能。

traits_en.color: Black and white street work; colour in fashion.
traits_en.composition: Chaotic, overlapping, wide-angle, faces at the edges.
traits_en.light: Harsh, flash, flare.
traits_en.tone: Extreme contrast, blocked shadows, blown highlights.

traits_zh.color: 街头黑白；时尚作品用彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 混乱、重叠、广角，面孔挤在画面边缘。
traits_zh.light: 刺眼、闪光、眩光。
traits_zh.tone: 极端反差、堵死的暗部、飞掉的高光。

signature_en: A face blurred and too close, shouting
Crowds that overflow the frame on every side
Grain and contrast pushed to the limit
signature_zh: 模糊、过近、在喊叫的脸
从四面八方溢出画面的人群
推到极限的颗粒与反差
series: Life Is Good & Good for You in New York (1956)
photographers.explore_en: Get a wide lens, walk into the crowd, shoot without looking, and print everything harder than it was.
photographers.explore_zh: 拿一支广角，走进人群，不看取景器就拍，然后把一切印得比原本更硬。

photographers.intro_en: Vancouver in Kodachrome from the 1950s on, unseen for decades: neon, barber poles, second-hand shops and people on the street in the saturated reds and teals of the slide film. A city remembered in colour before anyone thought it worth remembering.
photographers.intro_zh: 从 1950 年代起用 Kodachrome 拍摄的温哥华，几十年无人看见：霓虹、理发店旋转灯、二手商店和街上的人，在反转片饱和的红与青绿里。一座在人们觉得值得记住之前就被用色彩记住的城市。

traits_en.color: Kodachrome red, teal and ochre; saturated but true.
traits_en.composition: Street-level, signs and shopfronts as structure, people in passing.
traits_en.light: Dusk, neon, overcast Pacific light.

traits_zh.color: Kodachrome 的红、青绿和赭色；饱和但真实。
traits_zh.composition: 街面视角，招牌和店面是结构，路人是过客。
traits_zh.light: 黄昏、霓虹、阴天的太平洋海岸光。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，浓郁的暗部。

signature_en: Neon and painted signs in saturated red
A shopfront with a passer-by in front of it
Dusk colour on a wet street
signature_zh: 饱和红色的霓虹和手绘招牌
店面前经过的路人
湿街道上的黄昏色彩
photographers.explore_en: Photograph your own city's signs and shopfronts at dusk, in colour, as if someone fifty years from now will need them.
photographers.explore_zh: 在黄昏用彩色拍你自己城市的招牌和店面，就像五十年后有人会需要它们一样。

photographers.intro_en: The social landscape crammed into one frame: reflections, poles, signs and fences all fighting for space, with his own shadow often lying across the scene. Shown with Winogrand and Arbus in MoMA's New Documents (1967); later he photographed America through the windows of rental cars.
photographers.intro_zh: 把社会景观塞进同一个画框：橱窗反光、电线杆、招牌和栅栏互相抢位置，他自己的影子还常常横在画面里。1967 年和温诺格兰德、阿勃丝一起参加现代艺术博物馆的新纪实展，后来又隔着租来的车的车窗拍美国。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Dense, fractured frames; poles and frames inside the frame cut the view into pieces.
traits_en.light: Plain daylight, hard shadows, often his own.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 密集、破碎的画面，电线杆和画中画框把视野切成好几块。
traits_zh.light: 普通日光，硬朗的影子，常常是他自己的。
traits_zh.tone: 完整的影调，中灰偏多。

signature_en: A street seen through a shop window full of reflections
The photographer's shadow falling across a stranger
A landscape framed by a car's window and side mirror
signature_zh: 透过满是反光的橱窗看到的街道
摄影师的影子落在陌生人身上
被车窗和后视镜框住的风景
photographers.explore_en: Let the poles, signs and reflections in; stop down so all of it is sharp, and see how many frames you can fit inside one frame.
photographers.explore_zh: 别躲开电线杆、招牌和反光，把它们都收进来；收小光圈让一切清晰，看看一个画面里能塞进几个画框。

photographers.intro_en: The American West after the developers arrived: tract houses, gas stations and new roads under a hard, bright sky. The New West (1974) and the New Topographics exhibition (1975) made the altered landscape a subject in its own right, described with grief and restraint.
photographers.intro_zh: 开发商来了之后的美国西部：一排排预制住宅、加油站和新修的路，头顶是刺眼的晴天。《新西部》（1974）和 1975 年的新地形展，让被改造过的土地本身成为题材，语气克制，带着哀伤。

traits_en.color: Black and white, pale.
traits_en.composition: Level, open, the horizon low; houses small against the land.
traits_en.light: Harsh high-altitude sun, washed-out skies.
traits_en.tone: High key, light greys, little black.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，偏淡。
traits_zh.composition: 水平、开阔，地平线压低，房子在大地上显得很小。
traits_zh.light: 高原上刺眼的阳光，发白的天空。
traits_zh.tone: 高调，浅灰为主，很少纯黑。

signature_en: A new tract house under a white sky
A suburban street with one young tree
A plain scarred by roads, seen from a low hill
signature_zh: 白色天空下一栋新建的预制住宅
郊区街道上一棵刚种下的小树
从矮坡上看到的、被道路划开的平原
photographers.explore_en: Photograph the new estate at the edge of town in midday light, level and from a distance, and let the sky stay white.
photographers.explore_zh: 在正午的光下拍城市边缘的新楼盘，保持水平、离远一点，让天空就那样白着。

photographers.intro_en: Blank facades of tilt-up industrial buildings photographed head-on, as if they were minimalist paintings. The New Industrial Parks near Irvine, California (1974) found an exact, cold beauty in places built to be anonymous.
photographers.intro_zh: 正面拍工业园区里一面面空白的预制墙，像在拍极简主义绘画。《加州尔湾附近的新工业园》（1974）在那些建来就为了不被记住的地方，找到一种精确而冰冷的美。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Frontal, flat, rectilinear; the wall fills the frame.
traits_en.light: Even, shadowless California light.
traits_en.tone: Mid greys, low contrast, clean whites.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 正面、平面、横平竖直，墙填满画面。
traits_zh.light: 均匀、几乎没有影子的加州光线。
traits_zh.tone: 中灰为主，反差低，白色干净。

signature_en: A windowless factory wall seen straight on
A loading door and one drain pipe
An empty lot with tyre tracks
signature_zh: 正对着拍的一面没有窗户的厂房墙
一扇装卸门和一根落水管
留着车辙的空地
series: The New Industrial Parks near Irvine, California (1974)
photographers.explore_en: Stand square to a plain wall, fill the frame with it, and keep the light flat; let the drain pipe be the event.
photographers.explore_zh: 正对一面平淡的墙站好，让它填满画面，光线保持平淡；让那根落水管成为画面里唯一的事件。

photographers.intro_en: Large-format colour across the United States, with a sharp eye for the strange moment inside an ordinary view. In McLean, Virginia, December 1978 a firefighter shops for pumpkins while a house burns behind him; the fire was a training exercise.
photographers.intro_zh: 用大画幅彩色走遍美国，总能在平常景象里看到奇怪的一刻。《弗吉尼亚州麦克莱恩，1978 年 12 月》里，一名消防员在挑南瓜，身后有栋房子在着火；后来才知道那是一场消防演练。

traits_en.color: Soft, warm, slightly faded colour; autumn and pastel tones.
traits_en.composition: Wide views from a slight height, the incident small inside the landscape.
traits_en.light: Overcast or soft daylight.

traits_zh.color: 柔和、偏暖、略褪色的色彩，常有秋色和粉彩调。
traits_zh.composition: 从稍高处看的宽景，事件在风景里只占一小块。
traits_zh.light: 阴天或柔和的日光。
traits_zh.tone: 反差温和，暗部通透。

signature_en: A small absurd event inside a wide, calm landscape
Autumn colour under a pale sky
A roadside scene that looks normal until it doesn't
signature_zh: 宽阔平静的风景里一件荒诞的小事
苍白天空下的秋天颜色
乍看正常、细看不对劲的路边场景
photographers.explore_en: Step back until the scene is small, wait in soft light, and look for the one detail that doesn't belong.
photographers.explore_zh: 往后退，直到场景变小；在柔和的光里等，找那个格格不入的细节。

photographers.intro_en: Decades in the American desert, where beauty and damage share the frame: test sites, floods, burned land under luminous pastel skies (Desert Cantos, from 1979). On the Beach looks straight down from a hotel window at tiny swimmers in a vast blue.
photographers.intro_zh: 几十年都在美国沙漠里拍，美和伤害在同一个画面里：核试验场、洪水、烧过的土地，头顶是发光的粉彩色天空（《沙漠诗章》，1979 年起）。《在海滩上》从酒店窗口垂直往下拍，人很小，蓝色很大。

traits_en.color: Luminous pastels: peach, lavender, pale blue; or one saturated colour field.
traits_en.composition: Vast emptiness, the horizon or the subject tiny; often seen from above.
traits_en.light: Dawn and dusk light, or hazy high sun.

traits_zh.color: 发光的粉彩：桃红、淡紫、浅蓝；或者一整片饱和的颜色。
traits_zh.composition: 巨大的空旷，地平线或主体很小，常常是俯拍。
traits_zh.light: 黎明和黄昏的光，或者朦胧的高空阳光。
traits_zh.tone: 柔和、高调、过渡平滑。
traits_zh.texture: 8×10 大画幅的锐度，大片平滑的色块。

signature_en: A desert horizon under a peach and lavender sky
Tiny swimmers in a field of blue, seen from far above
Beautiful light on a damaged landscape
signature_zh: 桃红和淡紫天空下的沙漠地平线
从高处看，一片蓝里小小的游泳者
照在受损土地上的美丽光线
photographers.explore_en: Go somewhere empty at dawn, put the horizon very low or look straight down, and let one soft colour fill most of the frame.
photographers.explore_zh: 黎明时去一个空旷的地方，把地平线压得很低，或者垂直往下拍，让一种柔和的颜色占据大半个画面。

photographers.intro_en: Large-format colour of how America makes and uses energy. For American Power (2003–2008) he photographed power plants from public land and was repeatedly stopped by corporate security, police and, by his account, once questioned by the FBI.
photographers.intro_zh: 用大画幅彩色拍美国如何生产和消耗能源。拍《美国能源》（2003–2008）时，他站在公共用地上拍发电厂，一次次被企业保安和警察拦下，据他自己说，还被联邦调查局盘问过一次。

traits_en.color: Natural, slightly cool colour; steam whites, industrial greys, suburban greens.
traits_en.composition: Wide views where houses, people and plants share one scale.
traits_en.light: Overcast daylight.

traits_zh.color: 自然、略冷的色彩；蒸汽的白、工业的灰、郊区的绿。
traits_zh.composition: 宽景，房子、人和电厂放在同一个尺度里。
traits_zh.light: 阴天的日光。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，暗部有细节。

signature_en: A cooling tower looming over a small house
Families on a lawn with industry behind them
A coal town under a grey sky
signature_zh: 冷却塔压在一栋小房子后面
草坪上的一家人，身后是工厂
灰色天空下的煤矿小镇
photographers.explore_en: Stand on public ground, include the house and the chimney in one level frame, and let the scale say what you don't.
photographers.explore_zh: 站在公共用地上，把房子和烟囱放进同一个水平的画面，让尺度替你说出没说的话。

photographers.intro_en: Street photography lit like cinema. For Heads (2001) he hid strobes on scaffolding in Times Square so passers-by stepped into a pool of light against a dark city; one subject sued and the court sided with the artist. Earlier tableaux made everyday rooms look like film stills.
photographers.intro_zh: 像电影一样打光的街头摄影。拍《头像》（2001）时，他把闪光灯藏在时代广场的脚手架上，路人一走进那块光就被拍下，背景的城市暗下去；其中一位被拍的人起诉了他，法院判摄影师胜诉。更早的作品把日常的房间拍成了电影剧照。

traits_en.color: Rich, saturated colour; warm skin against cool, dark surroundings.
traits_en.composition: Isolated figures, tight on the face or set in a stage-like street.
traits_en.light: Hidden flash mixed with ambient light: a spotlight in daylight.

traits_zh.color: 浓郁饱和的色彩，暖色的皮肤衬着偏冷的暗背景。
traits_zh.composition: 被孤立出来的人，或紧贴着脸，或站在像舞台一样的街上。
traits_zh.light: 藏起来的闪光灯混着环境光，白天也像打了追光。
traits_zh.tone: 高反差，影子迅速沉下去。
traits_zh.mood: 孤独、戏剧化、悬停的一刻。

signature_en: A passer-by lit by a hidden strobe against a dark street
A face caught mid-thought in a pool of light
An ordinary room lit like a film set
signature_zh: 暗街上被隐藏闪光灯照亮的路人
在一片光里陷入沉思的一张脸
像片场一样打光的普通房间
photographers.explore_en: Light one spot of the street with a flash, wait for someone to walk into it, and let everything else fall into darkness.
photographers.explore_zh: 用闪光灯照亮街上的一小块，等有人走进去，让其他一切都沉入黑暗。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Single photographs produced like feature films: crews, cranes, rain machines and actors, all for one frame of small-town America at twilight. Twilight (2002) and Beneath the Roses (2008) turn a suburban street into a scene of quiet dread.
photographers.intro_zh: 每张照片都像拍电影一样制作：剧组、摇臂、降雨机和演员，只为拍下一帧暮色里的美国小镇。《暮光》（2002）和《玫瑰之下》（2008）把郊区街道变成一个安静而令人不安的场景。

traits_en.color: Cinematic colour: blue dusk outside, warm tungsten inside.
traits_en.composition: Wide, symmetrical, deep-focus tableaux; every corner arranged.
traits_en.light: Twilight mixed with film lighting from many sources.

traits_zh.color: 电影感的色彩：屋外是蓝色的黄昏，屋里是暖色的钨丝灯。
traits_zh.composition: 宽阔、对称、全景深的场景，每个角落都经过安排。
traits_zh.light: 暮色加上来自四面八方的电影灯光。
traits_zh.tone: 反差浓郁，画面里的灯在发光。
traits_zh.texture: 极其锐利，细节经过合成。

signature_en: A lit house on a blue twilight street
A figure frozen in a room, staring at nothing
A suburban scene where something has just gone wrong
signature_zh: 蓝色暮光街道上一栋亮着灯的房子
房间里定住的一个人，盯着空处
刚刚出了点事的郊区场景
photographers.explore_en: Shoot in the blue minutes after sunset, switch on every lamp in the house, and stage one person doing nothing at all.
photographers.explore_zh: 在日落后蓝色的那几分钟里拍，把屋里的灯全打开，安排一个人什么都不做。

photographers.intro_en: The face of the Great Depression. Working for the Farm Security Administration, she photographed migrants and sharecroppers with close, dignified attention; Migrant Mother (1936), made in a few minutes at a pea pickers' camp in Nipomo, California, became one of the best-known photographs ever made.
photographers.intro_zh: 大萧条的面孔。她为农业安全局工作，近距离而有尊严地拍下流离的工人和佃农。《移民母亲》（1936）是在加州尼波莫一个豌豆采摘工营地里几分钟内拍成的，后来成了史上最广为人知的照片之一。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Close, often centred portraits; hands and faces carry the story.
traits_en.light: Soft overcast or open shade.
traits_en.tone: Full tonal range, gentle contrast, rich midtones.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 贴近、常常居中的肖像，手和脸讲出故事。
traits_zh.light: 柔和的阴天光或开阔的阴影。
traits_zh.tone: 完整的影调，反差温和，中间调丰富。

signature_en: A worried face with a hand raised to the chin
Children leaning on a parent, faces turned away
A worker in open shade, looking past the camera
signature_zh: 一张忧虑的脸，手抬到下巴
孩子靠在父母身上，把脸转开
开阔阴影里的劳动者，目光越过镜头
photographers.explore_en: Get close, stay respectful, find soft light, and let the hands say as much as the face.
photographers.explore_zh: 靠近，保持尊重，找柔和的光，让手说出和脸一样多的话。

photographers.intro_en: A sociologist with a camera. His photographs of children in mills, mines and fields for the National Child Labor Committee helped change American labour law. In 1930–31 he documented the Empire State Building's construction, swung out in a basket high above Fifth Avenue.
photographers.intro_zh: 拿相机的社会学家。他为全国童工委员会拍下工厂、矿井和田地里的孩子，推动了美国劳动法的改变。1930 至 1931 年，他记录帝国大厦的建造，坐在一只吊篮里，被吊到第五大道上空拍工人。

traits_en.color: Black and white, often toned prints.
traits_en.composition: Direct, frontal portraits; workers placed in their workplace.
traits_en.light: Available light and early flash; soft and plain.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，常是调色照片。
traits_zh.composition: 直接、正面的肖像，人放在他们干活的地方。
traits_zh.light: 现场光和早期闪光灯，柔和朴素。
traits_zh.tone: 反差温和，灰阶很长。
traits_zh.texture: 边缘偏软，有那个年代的颗粒。

signature_en: A child worker standing at a loom, looking at the camera
An ironworker sitting on a girder above the city
An immigrant family waiting in a hall
signature_zh: 站在织布机前、看着镜头的童工
坐在城市上空钢梁上的钢铁工人
在大厅里等待的移民一家
photographers.explore_en: Photograph people where they work, straight on and at their eye level, and let the place explain the person.
photographers.explore_zh: 在人们干活的地方拍他们，正面、与他们视线齐平，让环境来解释这个人。

photographers.magnum_note: Associated with Magnum from 1967; accounts differ on whether he was ever a full member, so he is not labelled as one.
photographers.intro_en: Documentary from the inside. He rode with the Chicago Outlaws motorcycle club from 1963 to 1967 and made The Bikeriders (1968); he photographed the civil rights movement as SNCC's photographer and spent fourteen months in Texas prisons for Conversations with the Dead (1971).
photographers.intro_zh: 从内部出发的纪实。1963 到 1967 年，他跟着芝加哥亡命之徒摩托车俱乐部一起骑行，拍成《机车骑手》（1968）；他做过学生非暴力协调委员会的摄影师，拍民权运动；又为《与死者对话》（1971）在得州监狱里拍了十四个月。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Close, involved, sometimes tilted; he is part of the scene.
traits_en.light: Available light, harsh sun or dim bars.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 贴近、身在其中，有时倾斜；他本人就是场景的一部分。
traits_zh.light: 现场光，刺眼的太阳或昏暗的酒吧。
traits_zh.tone: 浓重的黑，粗粝的反差。
traits_zh.texture: 颗粒粗，有时因为动作而发虚。

signature_en: A biker and his machine on an empty highway
Leather jackets in a smoky bar
A face seen from inside the group
signature_zh: 空旷公路上的骑手和他的车
烟雾弥漫的酒吧里的皮夹克
从群体内部看到的一张脸
photographers.explore_en: Join the group before you photograph it, shoot close in whatever light there is, and keep the grain.
photographers.explore_zh: 先成为那群人的一员再拍他们；用现场有的光贴近拍，留着颗粒。

photographers.intro_en: Hong Kong in the 1950s and 60s as a theatre of light: a single figure in a shaft of sun, smoke cutting across an alley, stairs and railings turned into pure geometry. Later a film director, he returned to the negatives in his seventies.
photographers.intro_zh: 1950、60 年代的香港，一个光的剧场：一束阳光里的孤单身影、横切过小巷的烟、变成纯粹几何的楼梯与栏杆。他后来成为电影导演，七十多岁时又回到了这些底片。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Strong diagonals, stairs, railings; one small figure placed in a geometric void.
traits_en.light: A single hard beam of sunlight or backlight through smoke; everything else dark.
traits_en.tone: Extreme contrast: ink-black shadows and one bright shape.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 强烈的对角线、楼梯、栏杆；一个小小的人置于几何的空无中。
traits_zh.light: 一束硬朗的阳光，或穿过烟雾的逆光；其他一切都是暗的。
traits_zh.tone: 极端反差：墨黑的阴影和一个明亮的形状。
traits_zh.texture: 平滑、图形化，常裁得很紧。

signature_en: A lone figure in a shaft of light in a dark alley
Smoke or steam lit from behind
Stairs and railings as abstract diagonals
signature_zh: 暗巷里一束光中的孤单身影
被逆光照亮的烟或蒸汽
化作抽象对角线的楼梯与栏杆
photographers.explore_en: Find a narrow street where sun enters from one side only, wait for a person to walk into the beam, and expose for the light.
photographers.explore_zh: 找一条阳光只从一侧进入的窄街，等一个人走进光束，按光的部分曝光。
method_en: Light first, people second. He found a hard shaft of light under Hong Kong's arcades, built the stage out of light and shadow, then waited for a passer-by to step into it while the clutter sank into shade.
He composed like a Chinese landscape painter: large white walls or shadows as empty space, figures in one corner, balance of dense and sparse instead of a rule of thirds.
Architecture as a frame: pillars, window frames, stairs and alleys cut the street into layers, so you are both inside the scene and slightly apart from it.
Street life without voyeurism or pity. Hawkers, old people and children appear as people living their lives, seen as equals.
Years as an actor and film director taught him staging and emotion, so even a still street scene carries a story.
Simple equipment, often a twin-lens reflex; the skill was in looking and waiting, not in the camera.
method_zh: 先看光，再等人。他在骑楼和唐楼里找到一道斜射的硬光，先把明暗搭成舞台，再等一个行人走进那道光里，周围的杂乱全藏进阴影。
用中国画的办法构图：大片白墙或阴影做留白，人物只放在一角，讲究疏密和虚实，不套三分法。
借建筑做框：立柱、窗框、楼梯和巷子的纵深把街景切出层次，让人既在现场，又隔着一点距离。
拍市井，但不猎奇、不卖惨。小贩、老人、孩子在他镜头里是松弛地过日子的人，他站在旁边平等地看。
做过演员和导演，懂镜头调度和人物情绪，所以一张静止的街景里也有故事。
器材很普通，一台双反就够；功夫在于看和等，不在于设备。

photographers.intro_en: The stills photographer on Wong Kar-wai's Happy Together, In the Mood for Love and 2046, whose own pictures carry the same saturated reds and greens, tungsten glow, motion blur and longing. Hong Kong nights as a slow-motion heartbreak.
photographers.intro_zh: 王家卫《春光乍泄》《花样年华》《2046》的剧照师。他自己的照片带着同样饱和的红与绿、钨丝灯的光晕、动态模糊和渴望。香港的夜像一场慢动作的心碎。

traits_en.color: Saturated red and green, warm tungsten yellow, cross-processed shifts.
traits_en.composition: Layered through doorways and curtains; figures half-hidden; tight crops.
traits_en.light: Tungsten lamps, neon, backlit smoke; dark surroundings.
traits_en.tone: Low key, deep shadows, glowing warm highlights.

traits_zh.color: 饱和的红与绿、温暖的钨丝灯黄、正负冲式的偏色。
traits_zh.composition: 透过门框和帘子层叠；人物半遮；紧裁。
traits_zh.light: 钨丝灯、霓虹、逆光的烟；幽暗的环境。
traits_zh.tone: 暗调、深影、发光的暖高光。

signature_en: A figure blurred in motion in a red-and-green room
Cigarette smoke lit from behind
A face half-hidden by a curtain or doorframe
signature_zh: 红绿房间里动态模糊的人
被逆光照亮的香烟烟雾
被帘子或门框遮住一半的脸
series: In the Mood for Love stills (2000)
photographers.explore_en: Shoot indoors at night under tungsten light with a slow shutter, and let the person move while the room stays still.
photographers.explore_zh: 在夜里的室内用钨丝灯和慢速快门拍，让人动而房间不动。

photographers.intro_en: A Brooklyn street photographer who came to the camera from illustration. His frames read like film stills: muted colour, hard light and shadow, and strangers caught mid-story.
photographers.intro_zh: 来自布鲁克林的街头摄影师，从插画转来拍照。他的画面像电影剧照：低饱和的颜色、硬朗的光影，陌生人被定格在故事的中途。

traits_en.color: Muted, low saturation, strong tonal contrast.
traits_en.composition: Street scenes built around one figure in a pool of light.
traits_en.light: Slanting sun and neon at night.

traits_zh.color: 低饱和，影调反差强。
traits_zh.composition: 街景围绕光里的一个人展开。
traits_zh.light: 斜射的阳光，夜里的霓虹。
traits_zh.tone: 阴影深，边缘亮。
traits_zh.texture: 干净的数码质感，略带颗粒。

signature_en: A stranger stepping into a shaft of sunlight
A neon-lit bar window at night
A street that looks like a frame from a film
signature_zh: 一个陌生人走进一束阳光
夜里霓虹照亮的酒吧橱窗
像电影截图一样的街道
photographers.explore_en: Find a strong patch of light on the street and wait for the right person to walk into it.
photographers.explore_zh: 在街上找一块强烈的光，等对的人走进去。
method_en: Uses light and shadow to build drama: slanting sun by day, neon by night.
Watches busy streets for the moment that hints at a story, a goodbye or a wait.
Grades low in saturation with strong contrast so the mood carries the picture.
method_zh: 用光影制造戏剧感：白天看斜射的太阳，夜里看霓虹。
在热闹的街上等那个暗示着故事的瞬间，比如一次告别、一次等待。
后期低饱和、高反差，让情绪撑起画面。

photographers.nationality: Puerto Rican, based in New Jersey
photographers.nationality_zh: 波多黎各裔，常居新泽西
photographers.intro_en: Born in San Juan and based in New Jersey, she photographs Manhattan and her travels as quiet cinematic scenes: faces, silhouettes under streetlights, people tired, lost or in love.
photographers.intro_zh: 生于圣胡安，常居新泽西。她把曼哈顿和旅途拍成安静的电影场景：人脸、路灯下的剪影，疲惫、茫然或相爱的人。

traits_en.color: Restrained teal-orange, controlled saturation and contrast.
traits_en.composition: Frames within frames, foreground blur for layers.
traits_en.light: Street light and window light.

traits_zh.color: 克制的青橙色，饱和度和反差都收着。
traits_zh.composition: 框中框，用前景虚化做层次。
traits_zh.light: 路灯和橱窗光。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，边缘干净。

signature_en: A face framed by a car window at night
A silhouette under a streetlight
A blurred foreground opening onto a quiet stranger
signature_zh: 夜里被车窗框住的一张脸
路灯下的剪影
虚化的前景后面，一个安静的陌生人
photographers.explore_en: Shoot through something, a window, a doorway, a blurred shoulder, and let the colour stay restrained.
photographers.explore_zh: 隔着点什么拍：窗、门框、虚化的肩膀；颜色保持克制。
method_en: Uses architecture and objects as frames to hold the viewer's eye.
Layers sharp and blurred planes for depth.
Grades teal-orange but keeps saturation and contrast low, so the colour supports rather than shouts.
method_zh: 借建筑和物件当画框，圈住视线。
把清晰和虚化的层次叠在一起，制造纵深。
后期用青橙色，但饱和度和反差压得低，颜色只是烘托。

photographers.intro_en: A French architect living in Saint Petersburg who walks the city with a camera. Snow, rain, blue hour and dusk turn its streets into melancholy film sets with tiny figures.
photographers.intro_zh: 住在圣彼得堡的法国建筑师，带着相机走遍这座城市。雪、雨、蓝调和黄昏，把街道变成忧郁的电影布景，人很小。

traits_en.color: Kodak-like greens and magentas, warm-cool clashes.
traits_en.composition: Small figures in big streets; frames through bus windows and umbrellas.
traits_en.light: Snowy nights, rain reflections, low raking dusk light.
traits_en.tone: Soft contrast in snow and fog.

traits_zh.color: 类似柯达胶片的绿和洋红，冷暖碰撞。
traits_zh.composition: 大街道里的小人物；透过公交车窗、雨伞取景。
traits_zh.light: 雪夜、雨天倒影、黄昏低角度的斜光。
traits_zh.tone: 雪和雾里反差柔和。

signature_en: A lone figure crossing a snowy square at blue hour
Neon smeared in wet pavement
A tram seen through a misted window
signature_zh: 蓝调时分独自穿过雪地广场的人
湿地面上晕开的霓虹
透过起雾的车窗看到的电车
photographers.explore_en: Go out in the weather everyone avoids: snow, rain, dusk. Find a frame and let one small figure cross it.
photographers.explore_zh: 在大家都躲着的天气出门：下雪、下雨、黄昏。找好画框，等一个小小的人走过。
method_en: Treats bad weather as a free studio: rain gives reflections, snow and fog soften contrast.
Shoots many frames at blue hour and dusk.
Frames scenes through bus windows and umbrellas to hint at a story.
Uses local signs, old cars, onion domes, Stalinist blocks, as anchors.
method_zh: 把坏天气当成免费的影棚：雨带来倒影，雪和雾柔化反差。
大量照片拍在蓝调和黄昏。
透过公交车窗、雨伞取景，暗示故事。
用城市特有的元素当锚点：老汽车、洋葱顶教堂、斯大林式建筑。

photographers.intro_en: A Russian street and travel photographer known online as Kosnio, much of whose work is made in Bangkok. His pictures look like happy accidents that landed in exactly the right place.
photographers.intro_zh: 网名 Kosnio 的俄罗斯街头和旅行摄影师，很多作品拍于曼谷。他的照片像一个个恰好落在对的位置的意外。

traits_en.color: Lively but controlled saturation, warm yellow light.
traits_en.composition: Busy street life with a clear subject.
traits_en.light: Warm evening and street light.
traits_en.tone: Medium contrast, subject separated from background.

traits_zh.color: 鲜活但有分寸的饱和度，暖黄的光。
traits_zh.composition: 热闹的街头，主体清楚。
traits_zh.light: 温暖的傍晚光和街灯。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，主体从背景里分离出来。

signature_en: A vendor laughing in warm evening light
Children playing in a crowded lane
A passer-by caught between two colours
signature_zh: 傍晚暖光里大笑的小贩
拥挤小巷里玩耍的孩子
被两种颜色夹住的路人
photographers.explore_en: Stand still on a busy street, watch, and wait for the moment to arrange itself.
photographers.explore_zh: 在热闹的街上站定，观察，等那一刻自己排好位置。
method_en: Waits patiently instead of chasing: the moment comes to the frame.
Gets close and stays friendly so people stay natural.
Edits series rather than single frames to tell one place's story.
Works with Sony A7 bodies and 35mm and 50mm primes.
method_zh: 耐心等，不追：让瞬间自己走进画面。
敢靠近，态度友好，被拍的人就自然。
用一组照片讲一个地方，而不只是单张。
用索尼 A7 机身配 35mm、50mm 定焦。

photographers.intro_en: A Japanese photographer who calls his genre the scenic portrait: a person inside a whole scene, lit only by the sun. His book IN THE ZONE gathers ten years of street-scene portraits from seven countries.
photographers.intro_zh: 日本摄影师，自称拍的是情景人像：人在完整的场景里，只用自然光。写真集《IN THE ZONE》收录了他十多年间在七个国家拍下的街景人像。

traits_en.color: Soft, unified palettes: warm pale orange and light brown, or cool pale blue, grey and green.
traits_en.composition: The scene first, the person inside it.
traits_en.light: Natural light only, often window light or a soft sun.

traits_zh.color: 柔和统一的色彩：浅橙淡棕的暖调，或浅蓝灰白淡绿的冷调。
traits_zh.composition: 先有场景，人在其中。
traits_zh.light: 只用自然光，常是窗光或柔和的阳光。
traits_zh.tone: 低反差，影调细腻。

signature_en: A woman waiting on a station bench in soft light
A figure by a window, not looking at the camera
A street where the city is the protagonist
signature_zh: 柔光里在车站长椅旁等待的女人
窗边不看镜头的人
城市才是主角的街道
photographers.explore_en: Give your subject something to do in a real place, wait for natural light, and keep the colours to one family.
photographers.explore_zh: 让人物在真实的场景里做一件事，等自然光，颜色只用一个色系。
method_en: Directs by giving the model a task, leaning on a table, waiting at a station, so poses come naturally.
Lets emotion come from the situation rather than from instructions.
Shoots many frames where the subject is not looking at the camera.
Picks a theme per outing, waiting, reading, a touch of red, to give the walk a purpose.
method_zh: 引导的办法是给模特一件具体的事：手肘撑在桌上、在车站等人，姿势就自然了。
让情绪从情境里长出来，而不是靠口头指令。
大量照片里人物都不看镜头。
每次出门定一个主题，等待、阅读、街头的一抹红，让拍摄有方向。

photographers.intro_en: A Russian photographer of serene, private portraits: a woman in an ordinary room or in nature, lit by a window, lost in thought. The feeling is solitude rather than glamour.
photographers.intro_zh: 俄罗斯摄影师，拍安静而私密的人像：普通房间或自然里的女性，被窗光照亮，出神。传达的是独处，不是光鲜。

traits_en.color: Colours merged into two or three, deep green against warm skin.
traits_en.composition: Simple rooms, foreground partly blocking the view.
traits_en.light: Window light and side-back rim light.
traits_en.tone: Soft highlights tinted grey, gentle contrast.

traits_zh.color: 颜色合并成两三种，比如墨绿配暖色皮肤。
traits_zh.composition: 简单的房间，前景遮住一部分。
traits_zh.light: 窗光和侧逆光勾出的轮廓。
traits_zh.tone: 高光带一层灰，反差柔和。
traits_zh.texture: 削弱数码锐度，像九十年代的胶片。

signature_en: A woman by a curtained window in late sun
An empty gaze in a plain bedroom
Green shadows around warm skin
signature_zh: 午后窗帘边的女人
普通卧室里放空的眼神
暖色皮肤周围的绿色阴影
photographers.explore_en: Use the light already in your room, let something in the foreground hide part of the frame, and reduce the colours to two.
photographers.explore_zh: 用房间里本来的光，让前景挡住一部分画面，把颜色减到两种。
method_en: Rarely uses flash: window light and backlight do the work.
Lets shadow and a blocked foreground become part of the picture.
Asks for empty, inward looks instead of smiles.
In editing merges the palette into two or three colours and softens sharpness for a film look.
method_zh: 很少用闪光灯，靠窗光和逆光。
让阴影和被挡住的前景也成为画面的一部分。
要的是放空、向内的眼神，不是笑。
后期把颜色合并成两三种，削弱锐度，接近胶片。

photographers.intro_en: A British travel photographer who started in 2015 while teaching English in Chongqing, then left to photograph Asia and beyond for tourism boards and brands. Landscapes always with people in them.
photographers.intro_zh: 英国旅行摄影师，2015 年在重庆教英语时开始拍照，后来辞职，为旅游局和品牌拍摄亚洲和世界各地。风景里总有人。

traits_en.color: True, warm colours with light grading.
traits_en.composition: A person placed in a big place for scale and story.
traits_en.light: Sunrise, sunset and night city light.

traits_zh.color: 真实偏暖的颜色，后期很轻。
traits_zh.composition: 把人放进大场景里，交代尺度和故事。
traits_zh.light: 日出、日落和城市夜光。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，颜色饱满。

signature_en: A lantern-lit old town at dusk
A figure on a ridge above layered mountains
A market vendor in morning steam
signature_zh: 黄昏挂满灯笼的老城
层叠山脉上方山脊的人影
早市热气里的小贩
photographers.explore_en: Put a person in the landscape, go back at the best light, and stay until it happens.
photographers.explore_zh: 把人放进风景里，在最好的光线时回去，等到它发生。
method_en: Stays curious about ordinary corners, watching a shopkeeper for half an hour to find the story.
Will wait days in one place for the right light.
Keeps colours true and grades lightly.
Pitched his portfolio to tourism boards and hotels himself before anyone knew him.
method_zh: 对普通的街角保持好奇，能蹲半小时观察店主，找到故事。
为了对的光，可以在一个地方等好几天。
颜色保持真实，后期很轻。
没名气时主动给旅游局和酒店发作品集。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A Los Angeles photographer and director whose dreamy pictures of the American West, gathered in the book Another Patch of Sky, feel like faded road-trip memories.
photographers.intro_zh: 洛杉矶的摄影师和导演，他拍美国西部的作品集结成《Another Patch of Sky》，看起来像褪了色的公路旅行记忆。

traits_en.color: Warm browns, beige and pale blue, one unified grade.
traits_en.composition: Frames from car doors, windows and fences; leading lines.
traits_en.light: Soft, often overcast diffuse light.

traits_zh.color: 暖棕、米黄和浅蓝，统一的色调。
traits_zh.composition: 用车门、窗户、栅栏做框；引导线。
traits_zh.light: 柔和的光，常是阴天的漫射光。
traits_zh.tone: 过渡柔和，反差低。

signature_en: A desert framed by an open car door
A lake whose blue echoes a grey-blue sky
A figure small in a wide, warm landscape
signature_zh: 被打开的车门框住的荒原
湖水的蓝呼应灰蓝的天
温暖辽阔风景里很小的人
photographers.explore_en: Frame the view with the car you came in, keep the light soft, and grade everything into one warm family.
photographers.explore_zh: 用开来的车框住风景，保持柔光，把所有颜色调进一个暖色系。
method_en: Unifies the colour of a whole series so skin, water and sky belong together.
Prefers soft or overcast light, never harsh.
Uses car doors, windows and fences as natural frames and roads as leading lines.
method_zh: 统一整组作品的色调，让皮肤、湖水和天空属于同一套颜色。
偏爱柔光或阴天的光，不用硬光。
车门、窗户、栅栏当天然画框，道路当引导线。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A San Francisco Bay Area portrait photographer who works mainly with natural light, usually a window, and shapes it so precisely that it looks like studio lighting: faces emerging from deep shadow.
photographers.intro_zh: 旧金山湾区的人像摄影师，主要用自然光，通常是一扇窗。他控光精确得像影棚灯，人脸从深深的阴影里浮出来。

traits_en.color: Restrained saturation; warm shadows, clean or cool highlights.
traits_en.composition: Strict, quiet frames; hidden frames of blurred plants; shots through car windows with reflections.
traits_en.light: Chiaroscuro from a window, Rembrandt and Caravaggio in feel.
traits_en.tone: Deep blacks but a matte curve, highlights never blown.

traits_zh.color: 饱和度克制；暗部偏暖，高光干净或偏冷。
traits_zh.composition: 严谨安静的构图；用虚化的植物做隐蔽的框；隔着车窗拍，带上倒影。
traits_zh.light: 窗光造出的明暗对比，接近伦勃朗和卡拉瓦乔。
traits_zh.tone: 黑很深，但曲线做成哑光，高光从不过曝。

signature_en: A face lit by a narrow window beam, the room in darkness
A woman behind a car window with the city reflected
A shoulder and eye just touched by light
signature_zh: 一束窄窗光照亮的脸，房间沉在黑暗里
车窗后的女人，玻璃上映着城市
光刚好碰到的肩膀和眼睛
photographers.explore_en: Move your subject away from the window until the light becomes a pocket, expose for the highlights, and let the rest go dark.
photographers.explore_zh: 让人物离窗户远一点，直到光变成一小块；按高光曝光，其余交给黑暗。
method_en: Looks for the edge where light turns into shadow rather than the brightest spot.
Narrows the light so it has direction, hiding clutter in black.
Protects highlights in camera and lifts nothing that should stay dark.
Edits with a matte curve, warm shadows, cool highlights and added grain.
method_zh: 找光从亮转暗的交界处，而不是最亮的地方。
收窄光线，让它有方向，把杂物藏进黑里。
前期保护高光，该暗的地方不提亮。
后期用哑光曲线，暗部暖、高光冷，再加颗粒。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A Barcelona-based artist and photographer who posts as @la_melancolia. His street pictures look careless at first: blur, missed focus, blown highlights. That roughness is the point.
photographers.intro_zh: 常居巴塞罗那的艺术家和摄影师，账号 @la_melancolia。他的街头照片乍看很随意：模糊、跑焦、高光溢出，这种粗糙恰恰是重点。

traits_en.color: Sometimes vivid, sometimes high-contrast; never polished.
traits_en.composition: Loose, imperfect framing.
traits_en.light: Whatever light is there, flash or street light.

traits_zh.color: 有时鲜艳，有时高反差，从不精修。
traits_zh.composition: 松散、不完美的构图。
traits_zh.light: 现场有什么光就用什么，闪光灯或街灯。
traits_zh.tone: 高光溢出，光晕。

signature_en: A blurred figure rushing past a neon sign
Friends caught mid-laugh, out of focus
A flash-lit face at night
signature_zh: 冲过霓虹招牌的模糊人影
笑到一半、焦点没对上的朋友
夜里被闪光灯照亮的脸
photographers.explore_en: Carry a small camera everywhere, stop worrying about settings, and photograph what is happening rather than what is posed.
photographers.explore_zh: 随身带一台小相机，别再纠结参数，拍正在发生的，不拍摆好的。
method_en: Shoots 35mm film and, often, just a phone.
Never asks anyone to stand still or pose.
Accepts missed focus, halation and blur as part of the language.
Cares about the moment, not about ISO or shutter settings.
method_zh: 用 35mm 胶片拍，很多时候干脆用手机。
从不让人站着别动、摆姿势。
把跑焦、光晕、模糊都当作语言的一部分。
在意的是瞬间，不是感光度和快门。

photographers.intro_en: A London-based street and travel photographer and YouTuber (Snaps by Fox) who documents slow travel: Vietnamese alleys, New York streets, Welsh hills, Madrid summers.
photographers.intro_zh: 常居伦敦的街头和旅行摄影师、YouTube 博主（Snaps by Fox），记录慢旅行：越南的小巷、纽约的街道、威尔士的山区、马德里的夏天。

traits_en.color: Dark, slightly green old-photo grade.
traits_en.composition: One well-placed subject; light diagonals cutting the frame; subject on a strong point.
traits_en.light: Raking light and shadow.

traits_zh.color: 偏暗、带一点绿的老照片色调。
traits_zh.composition: 一个放得恰到好处的主体；光线斜着切开画面；主体放在黄金分割处。
traits_zh.light: 斜射的光和影。
traits_zh.tone: 低调，反差明显。

signature_en: A diagonal of sunlight with one figure stepping into it
A quiet alley with a single vendor
A town square at dusk, slightly green
signature_zh: 一道斜射的阳光，一个人正好走进去
安静的小巷里只有一个小贩
黄昏偏绿的小镇广场
photographers.explore_en: Find an interesting scene, then fish: wait for the one person it is missing.
photographers.explore_zh: 找到一个有意思的场景，然后像钓鱼一样，等那个缺的人出现。
method_en: Says many good scenes lack only a subject, so he waits like an angler for the right one.
Uses light changes and diagonals to cut the frame, placing the subject at a strong point.
Grades darker with a faint green, like an old print.
method_zh: 他说很多好场景只差一个主体，所以像钓鱼一样等对的人出现。
用光线变化和对角线切割画面，把主体放在黄金分割处。
后期偏暗，带一点淡绿，像老照片。

photographers.intro_en: An American landscape photographer whose canyons, dunes and storms look like another planet: hard low light cutting across rock, a tiny figure in a complementary colour, two colours and nothing else.
photographers.intro_zh: 美国风光摄影师，他拍的峡谷、沙丘和雷暴像另一个星球：低角度的硬光横切过岩石，一个穿补色衣服的小人，只有两种颜色。

traits_en.color: Two main colours, warm orange against teal-blue; others removed.
traits_en.composition: Telephoto compression and isolated geometry; a tiny figure for scale.
traits_en.light: Hard low side light and backlight; light like a spotlight on one peak.
traits_en.tone: Strong contrast between lit and shaded faces.

traits_zh.color: 两种主色，暖橙对青蓝，其余颜色去掉。
traits_zh.composition: 长焦压缩，截取几何；用一个小人交代尺度。
traits_zh.light: 低角度的侧光和逆光，硬；光像追光灯一样只打在一座山尖上。
traits_zh.tone: 受光面和背光面分得很清楚。

signature_en: A sunlit peak above a shadowed valley
A figure in yellow among red rock
Blue haze layers compressed by a long lens
signature_zh: 阴影山谷上方被阳光点亮的山尖
红色岩石里穿黄衣服的人
长焦压缩出的层层蓝色雾霭
photographers.explore_en: Put on a 70-200mm, wait for the last light to hit one ridge, and remove every colour that isn't the main two.
photographers.explore_zh: 换上 70-200mm，等最后一缕光打在一道山脊上，把两种主色之外的颜色都去掉。
method_en: Dresses figures in complementary colours: yellow in red rock, red in front of snow.
Waits for hard low light that cuts across texture and lights only part of the scene.
Uses mid and long telephotos to compress layers and isolate shapes.
Edits to two dominant colours, often orange and teal, and pulls down everything else.
method_zh: 给人物穿补色：红色岩石里穿黄，雪山前穿红。
等低角度的硬光横切过纹理，只照亮场景的一部分。
用中长焦压缩层次、截取形状。
后期只留两种主色，常是橙和青，其他都压下去。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A Melbourne landscape and travel photographer whose dark teal pictures of roads, forests and coasts look painted, with grain lying over the colour like texture.
photographers.intro_zh: 墨尔本的风光和旅行摄影师，他拍的道路、森林和海岸是深青色的，像画一样，颗粒像一层质感覆在颜色上。

traits_en.color: One dominant dark teal, other colours pulled down; a little warmth in highlights.
traits_en.composition: Negative space of sky, wall, sea or road; lines leading to the subject.
traits_en.light: Soft dusk and overcast light; cool sky, warm city lights.

traits_zh.color: 一种主色深青，其他颜色压低；高光留一点暖。
traits_zh.composition: 天空、墙面、海面、道路做留白；线条把视线引向主体。
traits_zh.light: 黄昏和阴天的柔光；冷的天，暖的城市灯。
traits_zh.tone: 保住高光，暗部有层次。

signature_en: A road vanishing into dark teal forest
A figure on a cold coast with one warm light
An ordinary street turned into a painting
signature_zh: 消失在深青森林里的公路
冷色海岸上的人，和一点暖光
被拍成画一样的普通街道
photographers.explore_en: Decide the main colour first, pull every other colour down, then add a little grain.
photographers.explore_zh: 先定主色，把其他颜色都压下去，最后加一点颗粒。
method_en: Lets the environment and a small action carry the story instead of a posed subject.
Uses sky, walls, sea and roads as empty space with lines leading in.
Avoids hard midday light; if forced, finds shade and underexposes slightly to keep highlights.
Grades around one main colour with cool shadows and warm accents, then adds even grain.
method_zh: 让环境和一个小动作讲故事，而不是摆好的主体。
用天空、墙、海和路做留白，线条把视线引进来。
避开正午硬光；如果只能中午拍，就找阴影，略微欠曝保住高光。
围绕一种主色调色，暗部冷、点缀暖，再加均匀的颗粒。

photographers.intro_en: An amateur film photographer in Brighton who shoots 35mm and 120 on the seafront promenade, mostly at golden hour: locals, sea light and long shadows in amber.
photographers.intro_zh: 布莱顿的业余胶片摄影师，用 35mm 和 120 胶片拍海滨步道，大多在黄金时刻：本地人、海面的光和琥珀色的长影子。

traits_en.color: Golden and amber warmth, restrained saturation.
traits_en.composition: People blended into the seafront.
traits_en.light: Low golden-hour sun, sea reflections.

traits_zh.color: 金色和琥珀色的暖调，饱和度克制。
traits_zh.composition: 人和海滨融为一体。
traits_zh.light: 黄金时刻的低角度阳光，海面反光。
traits_zh.tone: 柔和偏暖的反差。

signature_en: A couple on the promenade in amber light
Long shadows on the beach at sunset
A swimmer against glittering sea
signature_zh: 琥珀色光里步道上的情侣
日落时沙滩上的长影子
波光里的游泳者
photographers.explore_en: Pick one stretch of coast near home, go back at golden hour again and again, and shoot film.
photographers.explore_zh: 在家附近选一段海岸，一次次在黄金时刻回去，用胶片拍。
method_en: Shoots 35mm and 120 film because he likes its colour and its imperfections.
Works one place, the Brighton seafront, over and over.
Times outings for golden hour so the light becomes part of the story.
Photographs strangers as they are, without posing.
method_zh: 用 35mm 和 120 胶片，喜欢它的颜色和不完美。
反复拍同一个地方：布莱顿海滨。
按黄金时刻出门，让光成为故事的一部分。
拍陌生人本来的样子，不摆拍。

photographers.intro_en: A German portrait photographer whose fashion-minded pictures of women in alleys, under bridges and in dappled light are warm like an autumn evening or an old film.
photographers.intro_zh: 德国人像摄影师，带时尚感，拍小巷里、桥洞下、斑驳光影中的女性，画面温暖得像秋天的傍晚或老电影。

traits_en.color: Warm, unified autumn tones.
traits_en.composition: Models integrated with textured settings.
traits_en.light: Soft indoor light or directional side and back light.
traits_en.tone: Chiaroscuro rhythm, light picking the model out.

traits_zh.color: 温暖统一的秋色调。
traits_zh.composition: 模特和有质感的环境融为一体。
traits_zh.light: 室内柔光，或方向明确的侧光、逆光。
traits_zh.tone: 有节奏的明暗，光把人从背景里拎出来。

signature_en: A model in an alley with sun through leaves
Side light tracing a profile under a bridge
Warm skin against a dark textured wall
signature_zh: 小巷里，阳光透过树叶照在模特身上
桥洞下侧光勾出的侧脸
暗色有纹理的墙前的暖色皮肤
photographers.explore_en: Choose a textured place, light from the side, and guide the model until the pose carries a feeling.
photographers.explore_zh: 选一个有质感的地方，从侧面打光，引导模特直到姿态里有情绪。
method_en: Guides models closely so expressions and poses carry emotion without stiffness.
Switches between wrapping soft light and strongly directional side or back light.
Uses contrast and textured backgrounds to lift the subject out.
Grades everything warm and unified.
method_zh: 细致引导模特，让表情和姿态有情绪又不僵硬。
在包裹式的柔光和方向明确的侧光、逆光之间切换。
用明暗对比和有纹理的背景把人物拎出来。
后期统一成暖色调。

photographers.intro_en: A Toronto creative director and photographer with a very large online following, known for a dark blue-orange look that makes architecture and landscapes feel sleek and cold.
photographers.intro_zh: 多伦多的创意总监和摄影师，网上粉丝众多，以暗黑的蓝橙色调出名，让建筑和风景显得冷峻高级。

traits_en.color: Dark blue-orange, cold and sleek.
traits_en.composition: Clean geometry; architecture as abstraction; tiny figures.
traits_en.light: Low-key, controlled light.

traits_zh.color: 暗黑的蓝橙色，冷峻高级。
traits_zh.composition: 干净的几何；把建筑当抽象画；人很小。
traits_zh.light: 低调，光线可控。
traits_zh.tone: 阴影深，高光利落。

signature_en: A curved façade in dark blue with one warm window
A lone figure under brutalist concrete
A city at dusk graded teal and orange
signature_zh: 深蓝色弧形立面上一扇暖色的窗
粗野主义混凝土下的一个人
黄昏被调成青橙色的城市
photographers.explore_en: Look for one strong geometric shape, wait for a small figure, and push the shadows blue.
photographers.explore_zh: 找一个强烈的几何形状，等一个小小的人，把阴影推向蓝色。
method_en: Draws on an early love of architecture and design for clean geometric frames.
Finds the unusual detail in ordinary places while travelling.
Grades dark, with blue shadows and orange accents.
method_zh: 从小喜欢建筑和设计，构图干净几何。
旅行中在平常的地方找不寻常的细节。
后期偏暗，阴影蓝，点缀橙。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A Hong Kong photographer with a Japanese-style look: summer pictures as fresh as iced soda, blue sky and white shirts, a dash of bright yellow, people relaxed and playful.
photographers.intro_zh: 香港摄影师，风格偏日系：夏天的照片清爽得像冰镇气泡水，蓝天白衬衫，一抹亮黄，人物松弛又俏皮。

traits_en.color: Blue sky and white as the base, small accents of bright yellow or orange-red.
traits_en.composition: Frames of doors, windows, plants and grids; low angles against the sky; leading lines.
traits_en.light: Bright natural sun, translucent skin.

traits_zh.color: 蓝天和白色打底，少量亮黄或橙红点缀。
traits_zh.composition: 门窗、植物、网格做框；低角度仰拍天空；引导线。
traits_zh.light: 明亮的自然阳光，皮肤通透。
traits_zh.tone: 高调，有空气感。

signature_en: A friend waving out of a car window under blue sky
A white shirt glowing in sun with one yellow accent
A low-angle jump against clouds
signature_zh: 蓝天下探出车窗挥手的朋友
阳光里透亮的白衬衫，和一点黄色
对着云朵的低角度跳跃
photographers.explore_en: Shoot from low against a blue sky, dress in white, add one bright accent and let friends play.
photographers.explore_zh: 低角度对着蓝天拍，穿白色，加一个亮色点缀，让朋友们自己玩。
method_en: Builds frames from doors, windows, plants and gaps between buildings.
Shoots from low so people meet the sky and the space opens up.
Keeps blue and white as the base and adds one or two saturated accents.
Catches unscripted gestures, waving, biting a straw, stretching.
method_zh: 用门窗、植物、建筑缝隙搭画框。
低角度仰拍，让人和天空相遇，空间打开。
以蓝白为底色，只加一两个高饱和点缀。
抓没有剧本的小动作：挥手、咬吸管、伸展。

photographers.intro_en: A Korean portrait photographer, cocographer online, mixing Japanese freshness with Korean softness: small expressions, props like snow, a vintage train or a glass of water, and a restrained film palette.
photographers.intro_zh: 韩国人像摄影师，网名 cocographer，融合了日系的清新和韩系的柔美：细微的表情，雪地、复古火车、一杯水这样的道具，还有克制的胶片色调。

traits_en.color: Restrained film palette: cyan-blue, warm yellow, grey-brown.
traits_en.composition: Props and sheer curtains as foreground or background.
traits_en.light: Bright, often side-back light on the eyes.
traits_en.tone: Clear contrast that keeps shadow detail.

traits_zh.color: 克制的胶片色：青蓝、暖黄、灰褐。
traits_zh.composition: 道具和半透明窗帘做前景或背景。
traits_zh.light: 明亮，常用侧后方的光打在眼神上。
traits_zh.tone: 对比清楚，暗部留细节。

signature_en: A girl behind a sheer curtain in morning light
A vintage train window with a quiet face
Snow and a warm coat
signature_zh: 晨光里半透明窗帘后的女孩
复古火车车窗里一张安静的脸
雪地和一件暖色外套
photographers.explore_en: Give your subject a prop and a window, wait for a small expression, and keep the colours few and soft.
photographers.explore_zh: 给人物一件道具和一扇窗，等一个细微的表情，颜色少而柔。
method_en: Avoids big gestures; the story is in small expressions.
Uses props and settings, snow, trains, glass, curtains, as foreground or background veils.
Lights the eyes from the side-back for a clean, lonely purity.
Grades around film texture with restrained neutral colours.
method_zh: 不要夸张的动作，故事在细微的表情里。
用雪地、火车、玻璃杯、窗帘这些道具和场景，做前景或背景的一层纱。
光从侧后方切入，照在眼神上，干净又孤独。
后期以胶片质感为核心，颜色克制中性。

photographers.intro_en: Paris after dark in the 1930s: wet cobbles under a single lamp, fog, lovers in cafés, the Seine in mist. Long exposures and magnesium flash made the night city visible for the first time.
photographers.intro_zh: 1930 年代入夜后的巴黎：一盏路灯下湿漉漉的鹅卵石、雾、咖啡馆里的情侣、雾中的塞纳河。长曝光和镁光灯第一次让夜晚的城市被看见。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: A lamp, a figure, a wall; strong simple structure; often symmetrical.
traits_en.light: Single street lamps, fog halos, flash in cafés; strongly directional.
traits_en.tone: Very dark with glowing pools of light.
traits_en.texture: Smooth plate tonality; wet surfaces gleam.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 一盏灯、一个人、一面墙；结构简单有力，常常对称。
traits_zh.light: 单盏路灯、雾中的光晕、咖啡馆里的闪光；方向性很强。
traits_zh.tone: 极暗，只有发光的光池。
traits_zh.texture: 平滑的玻璃底片影调，湿润的表面发亮。

signature_en: Wet cobblestones under one street lamp
Fog turning lamps into halos
Figures in doorways and cafés at night
signature_zh: 一盏路灯下湿漉漉的鹅卵石
把灯变成光晕的雾
夜里门口和咖啡馆里的人
photographers.explore_en: Go out after rain at night with a tripod, find one light source, and let everything else fall to black.
photographers.explore_zh: 雨后的夜里带三脚架出门，找到一个光源，让其他一切沉入黑暗。

photographers.magnum_note: A member of the Rapho agency, not Magnum.
photographers.intro_en: The warmest of the French humanists: the kiss by the Hôtel de Ville, children on their way home from school, concierges and café regulars. Small kindnesses and small jokes in grey Paris light.
photographers.intro_zh: 法国人文主义摄影师中最温暖的一位：市政厅前的吻、放学回家的孩子、门房和咖啡馆的常客。灰色巴黎光线里的小善意与小玩笑。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Mid-distance groups, a joke or tenderness placed at the centre.
traits_en.light: Soft Parisian daylight, overcast.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 中距离的群体，一个玩笑或一点温情放在中央。
traits_zh.light: 柔和的巴黎日光，阴天。
traits_zh.tone: 温和的中灰，反差适度。
traits_zh.texture: 自然的颗粒，不做作的清晰。

signature_en: Lovers oblivious to the street around them
Children turning a street into a playground
A small human comedy in one frame
signature_zh: 对周围街道浑然不觉的恋人
把街道变成游乐场的孩子
一个画面里的小小人间喜剧
series: Le Baiser de l'hôtel de ville (1950)
photographers.explore_en: Wait on a corner for the moment two strangers become a story, and be kind to both of them.
photographers.explore_zh: 在街角等两个陌生人变成一个故事的瞬间，并对他们两人都保持善意。

photographers.intro_en: The quiet modernist whom Cartier-Bresson said taught everyone: a fork on a plate, a reader on a rooftop, shadows on Washington Square, each composed with a lightness that hides its rigour.
photographers.intro_zh: 布列松说“我们都欠他”的安静现代主义者：盘子上的叉子、屋顶上的读者、华盛顿广场上的影子，每一张都以轻盈的方式藏起严谨。

traits_en.color: Black and white (a late Polaroid colour series exists).
traits_en.composition: High viewpoints, geometric shadows, small figures, generous emptiness.
traits_en.light: Window light, winter sun, long shadows.

traits_zh.color: 黑白（晚年有一组宝丽来彩色作品）。
traits_zh.composition: 高视角、几何的影子、小小的人物、慷慨的留白。
traits_zh.light: 窗光、冬日的太阳、长长的影子。
traits_zh.tone: 精致的灰，适中的反差。

signature_en: A small figure seen from above in a geometric space
Shadows that make the composition
A domestic still life made monumental
signature_zh: 从上方看、置于几何空间里的小人物
构成画面的影子
被变得纪念碑化的家常静物
photographers.explore_en: Find a high window, wait for long shadows, and let a single person become a note in the pattern.
photographers.explore_zh: 找一扇高处的窗，等长影子出现，让一个人成为图案里的一个音符。

photographers.intro_en: Pale Kodachrome pictures of the Italian provinces: a wall, a sky, a map, a postcard rack, all in soft pastel with almost no contrast. Photographs about looking, as gentle as the fog of the Po valley.
photographers.intro_zh: 淡色 Kodachrome 的意大利外省：一面墙、一片天、一张地图、一个明信片架，全是柔和的粉彩，几乎没有反差。关于“看”本身的照片，像波河平原的雾一样温柔。

traits_en.color: Pastel, desaturated, pale blues and creams.
traits_en.composition: Frontal, centred, flat; frames within frames; generous empty sky.
traits_en.light: Overcast, haze, mid-morning flatness.
traits_en.tone: Very low contrast, high key, no deep shadow.

traits_zh.color: 粉彩般、低饱和，淡蓝与奶油色。
traits_zh.composition: 正面、居中、平面；画中画；慷慨的空天。
traits_zh.light: 阴天、薄雾、上午的平淡光线。
traits_zh.tone: 极低反差、高调、没有深影。
traits_zh.texture: 柔和、略带颗粒的小画幅彩色。

signature_en: A pale wall with one small object in front of it
Sky taking up most of a flat, frontal frame
Pictures of pictures: postcards, maps, posters
signature_zh: 一面淡色的墙，前面只有一件小东西
占据平面正面构图大半的天空
关于图像的图像：明信片、地图、海报
photographers.explore_en: Shoot on an overcast morning, face a wall or a horizon squarely, and keep the colours as pale as the day.
photographers.explore_zh: 在阴天的早晨拍，正对一面墙或一条地平线，让色彩像那天一样淡。

photographers.intro_en: Minimal black-and-white landscapes made with long exposures at dawn or night: a single tree in Hokkaido snow, posts in silky water, fog erasing everything but shape. Square, small, and silent.
photographers.intro_zh: 黎明或夜晚用长曝光拍出的极简黑白风景：北海道雪地上的一棵树、丝绸般水面上的几根桩、雾抹去除轮廓之外的一切。方形、小幅、无声。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Square, minimal, one element in vast emptiness; horizon placed low or high.
traits_en.light: Dawn, dusk, night; soft and diffuse.
traits_en.tone: Delicate greys, smooth gradients, modest contrast.
traits_en.texture: Silky water and sky from long exposure; fine grain.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 方画幅、极简，辽阔的空无中只有一个元素；地平线放得很低或很高。
traits_zh.light: 黎明、黄昏、夜；柔和而弥散。
traits_zh.tone: 精致的灰、平滑的渐变、适度的反差。
traits_zh.texture: 长曝光带来的丝绸般的水和天空；细颗粒。

signature_en: A lone tree in a field of snow
Posts or a pier vanishing into milky water
A square frame that is mostly empty
signature_zh: 雪原上的一棵孤树
消失在乳白色水面中的木桩或栈桥
大部分是空白的方形画面
photographers.explore_en: Find one shape against snow, fog or water, expose for minutes, and remove everything else from the frame.
photographers.explore_zh: 在雪、雾或水前找到一个形状，曝光几分钟，把其他一切都从画面里拿掉。

photographers.intro_en: Small, exquisitely printed black-and-white pictures in which a dog, a bird or a distant figure gives scale to a wide northern landscape. Animals appear as fellow travellers, never as specimens.
photographers.intro_zh: 小幅、印制精美的黑白作品：一只狗、一只鸟或远处的一个人，为辽阔的北方风景提供尺度。动物在他的照片里是同路人，而不是标本。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Wide or panoramic, horizon low, one creature small in the frame.
traits_en.light: Northern winter light, snow glare, dusk.
traits_en.tone: Luminous greys, soft blacks, bright snow held with detail.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 宽幅或全景，地平线很低，一只小小的生物在画面里。
traits_zh.light: 北方冬天的光、雪的反光、黄昏。
traits_zh.tone: 发光的灰、柔和的黑、保留细节的亮雪。

signature_en: A dog walking across a vast snowy field
Birds as punctuation in an empty sky
A village seen from far away, in winter
signature_zh: 走过辽阔雪原的一只狗
空旷天空里作为标点的鸟
冬天远远看到的村庄
photographers.explore_en: Step back from the animal until the landscape matters as much as it does, and wait for it to move.
photographers.explore_zh: 从动物身边退开，直到风景和它一样重要，然后等它动起来。

photographers.intro_en: Fashion and fairy tales shot like half-remembered dreams: heavy grain, movement, Polaroid negatives, faded colour or smoky monochrome. The subject is always slipping away from the lens.
photographers.intro_zh: 像半记得的梦一样拍摄的时尚与童话：重颗粒、动态、宝丽来负片、褪色的彩色或烟雾般的黑白。主体总是从镜头前溜走。

traits_en.color: Faded, sepia or muted colour; often monochrome.
traits_en.composition: Figures partly out of frame, veils and blur.
traits_en.light: Soft, diffuse, sometimes a single hard source.
traits_en.texture: Very grainy, soft focus, scratched, motion-blurred.

traits_zh.color: 褪色的、深褐或柔和的彩色；常常是黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 人物部分出画，面纱与模糊。
traits_zh.light: 柔和、弥散，有时是一个硬光源。
traits_zh.tone: 暗调，高光发光。
traits_zh.texture: 极重的颗粒、柔焦、划痕、动态模糊。

signature_en: A figure dissolving into grain and movement
Faded colour that looks found in an attic
A fairy tale glimpsed rather than told
signature_zh: 溶解在颗粒和动态里的人
像在阁楼里找到的褪色色彩
被瞥见而不是被讲述的童话
photographers.explore_en: Use fast film, a slow shutter and a veil of something between you and the subject; keep what barely survives.
photographers.explore_zh: 用高速胶片、慢速快门，在你和主体之间隔一层什么；留下那些勉强幸存的画面。

photographers.intro_en: The poet of Prague who photographed the same studio window for fourteen years: condensation, a glass, an egg, a branch outside in snow. Contact prints with the slowest, most patient light in photography.
photographers.intro_zh: 布拉格的诗人，用十四年拍摄同一扇工作室的窗：水汽、一只玻璃杯、一枚鸡蛋、窗外雪中的树枝。接触印相，有着摄影中最缓慢、最耐心的光。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: A window, a sill, a few objects; interiors looking out.
traits_en.light: Window light through mist and condensation; dusk.
traits_en.tone: Long, luminous mid-tones; soft blacks; glowing highlights.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 一扇窗、一道窗台、几件物品；从室内向外看。
traits_zh.light: 透过雾气和水汽的窗光；黄昏。
traits_zh.tone: 漫长发光的中间调、柔和的黑、发光的高光。
traits_zh.texture: 接触印相的平滑；水汽与玻璃。

signature_en: A misted window with a garden beyond
A glass of water and an egg on a sill
Prague in fog and lamplight
signature_zh: 蒙着雾气的窗和窗外的花园
窗台上的一杯水和一枚鸡蛋
雾与灯光中的布拉格
photographers.explore_en: Choose one window in your home and photograph it through a whole year of weather.
photographers.explore_zh: 选家里的一扇窗，用一整年的天气去拍它。

photographers.intro_en: English life between the wars, then nudes distorted by a wide-angle police camera, all printed in his late style of near-black shadows and chalk-white highlights. Few photographers made darkness so deliberate.
photographers.intro_zh: 两次大战之间的英国生活，然后是用广角警用相机变形的人体，全都以晚期风格印出：近乎全黑的阴影和粉笔白的高光。很少有摄影师把黑暗用得如此刻意。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Stark, graphic, bodies and rooms as shapes; wide-angle distortion.
traits_en.light: Moonlight, blackout, hard window light.
traits_en.tone: Extreme contrast; blocked shadows; chalky whites.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 严峻、图形化，身体和房间化作形状；广角畸变。
traits_zh.light: 月光、灯火管制、硬窗光。
traits_zh.tone: 极端反差；堵死的阴影；粉笔般的白。

signature_en: A room reduced to black with one white shape
A body distorted by a wide lens on a pebble beach
London streets under blackout moonlight
signature_zh: 只剩一个白色形状的全黑房间
卵石海滩上被广角变形的身体
灯火管制月光下的伦敦街道
photographers.explore_en: Print harder than you were taught: let the shadows go black and keep only the shapes that matter.
photographers.explore_zh: 印得比你学到的更硬：让阴影变黑，只留下真正重要的形状。

photographers.intro_en: A boy with a camera in Belle Époque France who photographed his family jumping, racing and flying with a joy no one has matched since. Motion, blur and tilted wheels, plus early Autochrome colour.
photographers.intro_zh: 美好年代的法国，一个拿着相机的男孩，拍下家人跳跃、赛车和飞行，那份喜悦至今无人企及。动态、模糊、倾斜的车轮，还有早期的 Autochrome 彩色。

traits_en.color: Black and white; soft Autochrome colour for some early work.
traits_en.composition: Spontaneous, figures mid-air, horizons tilted by panning.
traits_en.light: Bright seaside and garden daylight.
traits_en.texture: Early emulsions: soft, slightly grainy; motion smear.

traits_zh.color: 黑白；部分早期作品是柔和的 Autochrome 彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 即兴，人物在半空，追随摇摄让地平线倾斜。
traits_zh.light: 明亮的海边和花园日光。
traits_zh.tone: 开阔、明亮、反差适度。
traits_zh.texture: 早期感光乳剂：柔和、略带颗粒；动态拖影。

signature_en: Someone caught mid-leap
A racing car with elliptical wheels from panning
Elegant figures at play by the sea
signature_zh: 跳到半空的人
摇摄下车轮变成椭圆的赛车
海边玩耍的优雅人物
photographers.explore_en: Photograph your friends doing something ridiculous, at the top of the jump, with the sun behind you.
photographers.explore_zh: 在阳光从背后照来的时候，拍你的朋友做傻事，就在跳到最高点的那一刻。

photographers.intro_en: India in colour, by an Indian, long before the West accepted colour: dense, layered frames of Bombay, Calcutta and the Ganges in which pink, saffron and green are not exotic but simply true. A master of the crowded, multi-layered picture.
photographers.intro_zh: 在西方接受彩色之前很久，一个印度人用彩色拍摄的印度：孟买、加尔各答和恒河的密集层叠画面，粉红、藏红花色和绿色不是异域情调，只是真实。拥挤多层画面的大师。

traits_en.color: Vivid, multi-hued, saturated but balanced; colour as structure.
traits_en.composition: Very dense, layered, frames within frames, many figures.
traits_en.light: Monsoon haze, hard sun, interiors of cars and doorways.

traits_zh.color: 鲜艳、多色相、饱和而平衡；色彩即结构。
traits_zh.composition: 极其密集、层叠、画中画、众多人物。
traits_zh.light: 季风的薄雾、硬朗的太阳、汽车和门廊的内部。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，丰富的中间调。
traits_zh.mood: 欢庆、观察入微、有人情味。

signature_en: A street seen through a car window, layered front to back
Saris and walls in pink, green and saffron
Crowds organised by colour rather than by subject
signature_zh: 透过车窗看到的、从前到后层叠的街道
粉红、绿与藏红花色的纱丽和墙
按颜色而不是主题组织的人群
photographers.explore_en: Stand inside a doorway or a car and let the street stack up in depth, organised by colour.
photographers.explore_zh: 站在门廊或车里，让街道在纵深里堆叠起来，按颜色来组织。

photographers.intro_en: Mexico's great black-and-white photographer: the woman with iguanas on her head, birds filling the sky, rituals and markets of Juchitán. Documentary that keeps crossing into myth.
photographers.intro_zh: 墨西哥最重要的黑白摄影师：头顶鬣蜥的女人、填满天空的鸟、胡奇坦的仪式与市集。不断越界进入神话的纪实。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Figures centred and frontal, often against sky; birds as pattern.
traits_en.light: Hard Mexican sun, deep shade.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 人物居中正面，常以天空为背景；鸟化作图案。
traits_zh.light: 墨西哥硬朗的太阳、深重的阴影。
traits_zh.tone: 强反差，浓郁的黑。

signature_en: A woman standing like a statue against the sky
A flock of birds turning sky into pattern
Ritual seen with respect rather than curiosity
signature_zh: 像雕像一样站在天空前的女人
把天空变成图案的一群鸟
以尊重而非猎奇看待的仪式
photographers.explore_en: Photograph a person from slightly below against open sky, and wait for the moment they look like a monument.
photographers.explore_zh: 以略低的角度、以开阔天空为背景拍一个人，等他们看起来像纪念碑的那一刻。

photographers.intro_en: Are, bure, boke: grainy, blurred, out of focus. The Provoke-era snapshots of Shinjuku, a stray dog, headlights on a highway, all printed so hard that the city becomes a scream in black and white. He has never stopped walking and shooting.
photographers.intro_zh: “粗糙、晃动、失焦”。《挑衅》时期的新宿快照、一条野狗、公路上的车灯，全都印得极硬，城市变成一声黑白的尖叫。他从未停止行走与拍摄。

traits_en.color: Mostly black and white; the colour work keeps the same roughness.
traits_en.composition: Tilted, cropped, shot from the hip; fragments rather than scenes.
traits_en.light: Flash, neon, harsh sun, deep shade.
traits_en.tone: Crushed blacks, burnt whites, almost no mid-grey.

traits_zh.color: 以黑白为主，彩色作品保持同样的粗粝。
traits_zh.composition: 倾斜、裁切、不看取景器就拍；碎片而不是场景。
traits_zh.light: 闪光、霓虹、刺眼的太阳、深影。
traits_zh.tone: 压死的黑、烧掉的白，几乎没有中灰。
traits_zh.texture: 极端的颗粒、模糊、划痕、网点。

signature_en: A stray dog staring back, grainy and tilted
Neon and tights at night in Shinjuku
A frame so rough it feels like a memory
signature_zh: 回望镜头的野狗，颗粒粗、画面斜
新宿夜里的霓虹与丝袜
粗糙到像一段记忆的画面
photographers.explore_en: Walk fast, shoot from the hip with a compact camera, push the film three stops and print on the hardest paper you have.
photographers.explore_zh: 走得快，用小相机从腰间拍，胶片迫冲三档，用你手上最硬的相纸印。
method_en: The grain, high contrast, shake and blur are deliberate: he wanted the jolt of the street, not a correct postcard.
He often shot without the viewfinder, camera at the chest or in the hand, pressing the shutter as he walked and trusting his body.
In the darkroom he pushed contrast to the limit, dropping the middle greys for harsh white and deep black, and kept the grain.
Close on fragments: direct flash on fishnet stockings, lip posters and cigarette ends, tearing familiar things out of context until they look strange.
The camera as a copy machine: one small compact, walking Shinjuku every day, shooting huge numbers of frames. No quantity, no quality.
He photographed his own state of mind. The stray dog looking back in Misawa, he said, was himself.
Copying the filter misses the point. What to learn is dropping gear obsession, shooting what makes the heart race, and accepting the roughness of the real.
method_zh: 粗颗粒、高反差、晃动和失焦都是刻意的：他想要的是在街上被刺激的那一下，不是一张规矩的明信片。
常常不看取景器，相机挂在胸前或拿在手里，边走边按快门，交给身体和本能。
冲洗时把反差推到极限，去掉中间灰，只留刺眼的白和很深的黑；颗粒也照样保留。
靠近碎片拍：用闪光灯直打网袜、红唇海报、烟头，把熟悉的东西从原来的语境里撕出来，变得陌生。
相机像复印机：一台小卡片机，每天在新宿走，拍得极多。他信没有数量就没有质量。
拍的是自己的心境。三泽那只回头的野狗，他说那就是他自己。
学他不要只学滤镜。真正要学的是放下器材执念、跟着心跳拍、接受现实的粗糙。
