photographers.intro_en: Ravens, made after his marriage ended, is often called the greatest photobook of the past half century: black birds in grey skies, blurred and grainy, a diary of grief disguised as nature photography. Everything he shot was ultimately about himself.
photographers.intro_zh: 《鸦》作于婚姻结束之后，常被称为过去半个世纪最伟大的摄影书：灰色天空里的黑鸟，模糊、颗粒粗，一本伪装成自然摄影的悲伤日记。他拍的一切最终都关于他自己。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Dark shapes against empty grey; silhouettes; off-balance.
traits_en.light: Dusk, overcast, winter; flash on birds at night.
traits_en.tone: Heavy blacks, murky greys, few highlights.
traits_en.texture: Coarse grain, motion blur, soft focus.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 空灰背景前的黑色形状；剪影；失衡。
traits_zh.light: 黄昏、阴天、冬天；夜里对鸟用闪光。
traits_zh.tone: 沉重的黑、浑浊的灰、极少的高光。

signature_en: A black bird as a smear against a grey sky
A figure seen from behind, walking away
Grain and blur as the texture of loss
signature_zh: 灰天上一抹黑色的鸟影
从背后看到的、走远的人
作为失去之质感的颗粒与模糊
photographers.explore_en: Photograph one thing you cannot stop thinking about, for years, until the pictures stop being about it.
photographers.explore_zh: 用几年去拍一件你无法停止想的事，直到照片不再关于它本身。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The central figure of postwar Japanese photography: a watch stopped at 11:02 in Nagasaki, American bases, Shinjuku youth, and later the sun-soaked colour of Okinawa. Documentary turned into something closer to poetry.
photographers.intro_zh: 战后日本摄影的核心人物：长崎停在 11 点 02 分的手表、美军基地、新宿的青年，后来是冲绳被阳光浸透的彩色。纪实被转化为更接近诗的东西。

traits_en.color: Black and white for decades; saturated, sun-bleached colour in Okinawa.
traits_en.composition: Close, fragmentary, objects as symbols; strong diagonals.
traits_en.light: Harsh sun, flash, shadow.
traits_en.texture: Grainy, textured surfaces: melted glass, skin, asphalt.

traits_zh.color: 几十年的黑白；冲绳时期是被阳光漂白的饱和彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 贴近、碎片化，物件作为象征；强烈的对角线。
traits_zh.light: 刺眼的太阳、闪光、阴影。
traits_zh.tone: 高反差、堵死的暗部。
traits_zh.texture: 颗粒明显、有质感的表面：熔化的玻璃、皮肤、沥青。

signature_en: An object made to stand for a catastrophe
Surfaces, skin and asphalt in hard light
Okinawa light bleaching colour to white
signature_zh: 一件代表灾难的物件
硬光下的表面、皮肤和沥青
把色彩漂白到发白的冲绳光线
photographers.explore_en: Photograph the object that stands for the story rather than the story itself, as close and as hard-lit as you can.
photographers.explore_zh: 拍那件代表故事的物件，而不是故事本身，尽量贴近，光线尽量硬。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Family and friends arranged like chess pieces on the Tottori dunes under an enormous sky: a man with an umbrella, children in a row, a hat floating in space. Playful, surreal and perfectly still.
photographers.intro_zh: 家人和朋友像棋子一样被安排在鸟取沙丘上，头顶是巨大的天空：撑伞的男人、排成一行的孩子、悬在空中的帽子。顽皮、超现实、完全静止。

traits_en.color: Mostly black and white; gentle colour later.
traits_en.composition: Figures spaced across an empty dune, horizon low, vast negative space.
traits_en.light: Bright, even seaside light; crisp shadows.
traits_en.tone: High key, clean whites, moderate contrast.

traits_zh.color: 以黑白为主，后期有温和的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 人物间隔分布在空旷的沙丘上，地平线很低，大面积留白。
traits_zh.light: 明亮均匀的海边光，影子清晰。
traits_zh.tone: 高调、干净的白、适中的反差。

signature_en: Figures posed at intervals on a sand dune
A hat, an umbrella or a bicycle as a prop in empty space
A horizon line low in a sky-filled frame
signature_zh: 间隔站在沙丘上的人
空无中作为道具的帽子、伞或自行车
在天空占满的画面里压得很低的地平线
photographers.explore_en: Take friends to an empty place, pose them like objects on a table, and leave most of the frame to sky.
photographers.explore_zh: 带朋友去一个空旷的地方，把他们像桌上的物件一样摆好，把大半画面留给天空。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Seascapes divided exactly in half by the horizon, cinema screens exposed for the whole film until they glow white, dioramas that look alive. Large-format black and white reduced to time, light and a line.
photographers.intro_zh: 被地平线精确平分的海景、曝光一整部电影直到发白的银幕、看起来像活着的立体模型。大画幅黑白被简化为时间、光和一条线。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Symmetry, a single horizon, total emptiness; centred frontal views.
traits_en.light: Diffuse, ambient, long exposures.
traits_en.tone: Subtle greys with gradual gradients; no harsh contrast.
traits_en.texture: Smooth, grainless, sometimes deliberately out of focus.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 对称、一条地平线、彻底的空无；居中正面。
traits_zh.light: 弥散的环境光，长曝光。
traits_zh.tone: 细微的灰与渐变，没有刺眼的反差。
traits_zh.texture: 平滑、无颗粒，有时刻意失焦。

signature_en: Sea and sky split exactly at the middle
A glowing white screen in an empty theatre
Buildings dissolved by deliberate blur
signature_zh: 在正中被平分的海与天
空剧院里发光的白色银幕
被刻意虚化的建筑
photographers.explore_en: Put the horizon in the exact centre, remove every object, and let the exposure run long enough to erase time.
photographers.explore_zh: 把地平线放在正中央，去掉所有物体，让曝光长到足以抹去时间。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Square black-and-white pictures of festivals and street corners in which something is always slightly off: a mask, a gesture, a child looking at something outside the frame. The ordinary made uncanny without any trick.
photographers.intro_zh: 方画幅黑白的祭典和街角，总有什么地方微妙地不对劲：一张面具、一个动作、一个望向画外的孩子。不用任何技巧，就让日常变得诡异。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Square, centred, frontal; one figure or object isolated; flash at times.
traits_en.light: Daylight and fill flash; crisp.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 方画幅、居中、正面；一个人物或物件被孤立出来；有时用闪光。
traits_zh.light: 日光加补光闪光；清晰。
traits_zh.tone: 强反差，深黑。
traits_zh.texture: 中画幅的锐度，颗粒适度。

signature_en: A masked or costumed figure centred in a square
A child or animal caught mid-gesture, slightly wrong
Everyday Japan with a strangeness underneath
signature_zh: 方画幅正中戴面具或穿戏服的人
动作进行中、略显异样的孩子或动物
表面之下带着怪异的日常日本
photographers.explore_en: Use a square frame, centre the subject, and wait for the one detail that makes an ordinary scene strange.
photographers.explore_zh: 用方画幅，把主体放在中间，等那个让普通场景变得奇怪的细节。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Small moments on 6×6 colour film: a watermelon, a drop of water, a child's hand, fireworks, all overexposed into pale, luminous pastel. The pictures feel like breathing. She is the most influential Japanese photographer of her generation.
photographers.intro_zh: 6×6 彩色胶片上的细小时刻：一块西瓜、一滴水、孩子的手、烟花，全都过曝成淡淡发光的粉彩。照片像呼吸一样。她是她这一代最有影响力的日本摄影师。

traits_en.color: Pale, high-key, desaturated pastel; soft blues and pinks.
traits_en.composition: Square, simple, one small thing; lots of light and air.
traits_en.light: Backlight, haze, overexposure, sunlight through things.
traits_en.tone: Very bright, low contrast, highlights that glow but hold.

traits_zh.color: 淡、高调、低饱和的粉彩；柔和的蓝与粉。
traits_zh.composition: 方画幅、简单、一件小东西；大量的光与空气。
traits_zh.light: 逆光、薄雾、过曝、穿透物体的阳光。
traits_zh.tone: 非常明亮、低反差，高光发光但不飞掉。
traits_zh.texture: 柔和、略带颗粒的中画幅彩色。

signature_en: A small bright thing in a pale, overexposed frame
Light itself as the subject: flares, haze, drops
A square of pastel colour that feels like a breath
signature_zh: 淡色过曝画面里的一件明亮小物
光本身作为主体：眩光、薄雾、水滴
一方像呼吸一样的粉彩色块
photographers.explore_en: Overexpose by a stop or two, shoot into the light, and photograph the smallest thing that moved you today.
photographers.explore_zh: 过曝一两档，对着光拍，拍今天打动你的最小的东西。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Tokyo Suburbia: new towns, blank apartment blocks and bored teenagers in flat, even light, with colour so neutral it reads as an absence of style. The deadpan look that defined 1990s Japanese photography.
photographers.intro_zh: 《东京郊外》：新城、空白的公寓楼、无聊的少年，在平淡均匀的光线里，色彩中性到像没有风格。定义了 1990 年代日本摄影的面无表情之风。

traits_en.color: Neutral, slightly cool, muted; nothing saturated.
traits_en.composition: Frontal, level, architectural; subject centred in flat space.
traits_en.light: Overcast, shadowless, even.
traits_en.tone: Low contrast, open shadows, bright but not glowing.

traits_zh.color: 中性、略冷、柔和；没有任何饱和。
traits_zh.composition: 正面、水平、建筑式；主体居于平面空间的中央。
traits_zh.light: 阴天、无影、均匀。
traits_zh.tone: 低反差、明亮的暗部，亮而不发光。
traits_zh.texture: 干净、清晰的大画幅或中画幅。

signature_en: An apartment block photographed square-on under grey sky
A teenager standing still in an empty new town
Colour so neutral it feels like no colour
signature_zh: 灰天下正对着拍的公寓楼
静静站在空荡新城里的少年
中性到像没有颜色的色彩
photographers.explore_en: Wait for an overcast day, face the building squarely, and photograph it as if it were evidence.
photographers.explore_zh: 等一个阴天，正对那栋建筑，像拍证据一样拍它。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Colour pushed past saturation: flowers, goldfish and women in kimono drowned in red, pink and gold, with glitter and neon. Maximalist, pop and unapologetically beautiful; also a film director.
photographers.intro_zh: 被推到饱和之外的色彩：花、金鱼和穿和服的女性淹没在红、粉与金里，带着闪粉和霓虹。极繁、流行、毫不掩饰地美；她也是电影导演。

traits_en.color: Maximum saturation, red and pink dominant, many hues at once.
traits_en.composition: Filled to the edges with pattern; close, decorative.
traits_en.light: Bright, flat or flash; sparkle.
traits_en.tone: Bright, moderate contrast, no deep shadow.

traits_zh.color: 最大饱和度，红与粉为主，多种色相同时出现。
traits_zh.composition: 从边到边都是图案；贴近、装饰性。
traits_zh.light: 明亮、平光或闪光；闪烁。
traits_zh.tone: 明亮、反差适中，没有深影。

signature_en: Flowers so saturated they look artificial
Goldfish and petals filling the whole frame
Red, pink and gold with glitter
signature_zh: 饱和到像假的花
占满整个画面的金鱼和花瓣
带闪粉的红、粉与金
photographers.explore_en: Fill the frame with one kind of colourful thing, light it flat and bright, and turn the saturation up rather than down.
photographers.explore_zh: 用一种有颜色的东西填满画面，用平而亮的光，然后把饱和度往上而不是往下调。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Japan seen from the water: the camera half-submerged, a wave or a blurred swell in the foreground, the shore and Mount Fuji drifting beyond it. Land becomes something you might not reach.
photographers.intro_zh: 从水里看到的日本：相机半浸在水中，前景是一道浪或一片模糊的涌动，海岸和富士山在远处漂移。陆地变成了你也许到不了的地方。

traits_en.color: Muted, cool sea colours; soft greens and greys.
traits_en.composition: Low, water-level viewpoint; heavy blurred foreground; horizon high.
traits_en.light: Overcast or hazy daylight on water.

traits_zh.color: 柔和、偏冷的海的颜色；柔和的绿与灰。
traits_zh.composition: 贴近水面的低视角；大面积模糊的前景；地平线很高。
traits_zh.light: 阴天或薄雾下的水面日光。
traits_zh.tone: 中间调，温和的反差。
traits_zh.texture: 模糊的水对着清晰的远景。

signature_en: A wave about to cover the lens with land beyond it
The shore seen as if by a swimmer
Mount Fuji drifting over blurred water
signature_zh: 即将盖住镜头的浪，和浪后的陆地
像游泳者看到的海岸
在模糊水面上漂移的富士山
series: half awake and half asleep in the water (2007)
photographers.explore_en: Put the lens at the surface of the water and photograph the land as something seen from outside it.
photographers.explore_zh: 把镜头放到水面的高度，把陆地当作从外面看到的东西来拍。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A Shizuoka photographer who posts as @SinPictures. His Summer Colour series, begun in 2015, sets young models in school uniforms on country roads under wide skies, with Mt Fuji and telegraph wires as the stage. Each frame is planned like a film still and reads like a remembered summer.
photographers.intro_zh: 静冈的摄影师，在网上以 @SinPictures 发表作品。2015 年开始的夏色写真系列，让穿校服的年轻模特走在乡间小路上，头顶是大片天空，富士山和电线杆当布景。每张都像电影剧照一样提前设计，看起来像一段记忆里的夏天。

traits_en.color: Clean, bright colour: blue sky, green fields, white shirts, little grading grime.
traits_en.composition: Small figures in a wide country scene, roads and wires leading to a big backdrop.
traits_en.light: Clear daylight and late-afternoon sun, faces lit softly.
traits_en.tone: High key, open shadows, gentle contrast.
traits_en.texture: Sharp, clean digital files, no grain.
traits_en.mood: Playful, nostalgic, a summer that feels already over.

traits_zh.color: 干净明亮的颜色：蓝天、绿田、白衬衫，几乎不做脏调。
traits_zh.composition: 人物在宽阔的乡间场景里显得小，道路和电线把视线引向远处的大背景。
traits_zh.light: 晴天的日光和傍晚的斜阳，人脸被柔和地照亮。
traits_zh.tone: 高调，暗部通透，反差温和。
traits_zh.texture: 清晰干净的数码画质，没有颗粒。
traits_zh.mood: 轻快、怀旧，像一个已经过去了的夏天。

signature_en: Two friends laughing on a country road with Mt Fuji behind them
A school uniform against a huge summer sky
Telegraph wires criss-crossing above a quiet rural lane
signature_zh: 两个朋友在乡间公路上大笑，身后是富士山
校服衬在一大片夏日天空下
安静的乡间小路上方交错的电线
photographers.explore_en: Plan the shot before the day: find a road with a big backdrop, wait for clear late-afternoon light, and let your subjects play inside a frame you have already composed.
photographers.explore_zh: 拍之前先设计好画面：找一条背景开阔的路，等晴天傍晚的光，让人物在你已经构好的画框里自由地玩。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Osaka's modernist of the 1930s. Early Summer Nerves (1933) turned the city into solarised, montaged, feverish fragments: a camera used as a nervous system rather than a window.
photographers.intro_zh: 1930 年代大阪的现代主义者。《初夏神经》（1933）把城市变成曝光反转、拼贴、发烧般的碎片：相机不是窗户，而是一套神经系统。

traits_en.color: Black and white, often solarised or printed in negative.
traits_en.composition: Montage, diagonals, fragments cut from the whole.
traits_en.light: Hard studio and street light, reversed tones.
traits_en.tone: High contrast with inverted and posterised passages.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，常用曝光反转或负像印放。
traits_zh.composition: 拼贴、对角线、从整体里切出的碎片。
traits_zh.light: 硬的棚光与街光，影调被颠倒。
traits_zh.tone: 高反差，带反转与色调分离的段落。
traits_zh.texture: 层叠、拼贴，偶有多重曝光。

signature_en: A solarised face dissolving into machine parts
A city street cut into diagonal slivers
Negative-printed clouds over factory chimneys
signature_zh: 溶进机械零件的反转人脸
被切成斜条的城市街道
工厂烟囱上负像的云
photographers.explore_en: Shoot ordinary objects, then break the image: invert it, cut it, layer two frames, and let the result be strange.
photographers.explore_zh: 先拍最普通的东西，再去破坏它：反转、裁切、叠两张，让结果变得陌生。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The quiet master of prewar Osaka, a founder of the Tampei Photography Club. He moved freely between surreal still lifes, street snapshots and the 1941 photographs of Jewish refugees in Kobe, all with the same calm precision.
photographers.intro_zh: 战前大阪安静的大师，丹平写真俱乐部的创办者之一。他在超现实静物、街头快照和 1941 年神户犹太难民的照片之间自由来去，始终带着同样沉着的精确。

traits_en.color: Black and white with a full, silvery grey scale.
traits_en.composition: Classical balance, a single clear subject, careful edges.
traits_en.light: Soft daylight, occasional strong backlight.
traits_en.tone: Middle-grey rich, blacks held, never crushed.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，银灰色阶完整。
traits_zh.composition: 古典的平衡，一个清晰的主体，边缘讲究。
traits_zh.light: 柔和的日光，偶有强逆光。
traits_zh.tone: 中灰丰富，黑保留，不压死。

signature_en: A flag caught mid-fold against a blank sky
A refugee's face lit from a window in Kobe
A beetle or a shell photographed like a monument
signature_zh: 空白天空下折叠到一半的旗
神户窗光下的难民面孔
被拍得像纪念碑的甲虫或贝壳
photographers.explore_en: Pick one subject per frame, wait for soft light, and print for the middle greys rather than for drama.
photographers.explore_zh: 一张照片只拍一个主体，等柔光，印放时照顾中灰而不是戏剧性。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Pictorialist, theorist of 'light and its harmony', and the head of Shiseido. Paris et la Seine (1922) and his Matsue and Musashino landscapes are soft, tonal pictures where mist and water do most of the work.
photographers.intro_zh: 画意摄影家、“光与其谐调”的理论者，也是资生堂的掌门人。《巴黎与塞纳河》（1922）以及松江、武藏野的风景，都是柔和的影调画面，雾与水承担了大部分表达。

traits_en.color: Monochrome, warm-toned prints.
traits_en.composition: Open horizons, reflections, a lone tree or boat.
traits_en.light: Overcast, misty, diffused.
traits_en.tone: Low contrast, long gentle grey scale.

traits_zh.color: 单色，暖调的相纸。
traits_zh.composition: 开阔的地平线、倒影，一棵孤树或一只船。
traits_zh.light: 阴天、雾气、漫射。
traits_zh.tone: 低反差，长而温柔的灰阶。

signature_en: A barge on the Seine fading into haze
A lake in Matsue with one reflected pine
Musashino fields under a soft white sky
signature_zh: 塞纳河上消失在雾里的驳船
松江湖面上一棵倒映的松
白色柔天下的武藏野田野
photographers.explore_en: Shoot water and sky on overcast mornings, keep the horizon open, and let the print stay soft and low in contrast.
photographers.explore_zh: 在阴天的清晨拍水和天，留出开阔的地平线，让照片保持柔和、低反差。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The man who brought the German picture magazine to Japan, founder of NIPPON (1934). His America 1937 pictures are confident, graphic reportage: a story told in frames that read fast.
photographers.intro_zh: 把德国画报式报道带回日本的人，《NIPPON》（1934）的创办者。《美国 1937》是自信而有图形感的报道摄影：一组读起来很快的画面讲一个故事。

traits_en.color: Black and white, clean and printed for reproduction.
traits_en.composition: Strong graphic shapes, high and low viewpoints, series logic.
traits_en.light: Daylight and available light, sharp.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，干净，为印刷而印放。
traits_zh.composition: 强烈的图形、俯仰的视角、成组的叙事逻辑。
traits_zh.light: 日光与现场光，锐利。
traits_zh.tone: 中高反差，白得清楚。

signature_en: A crowd seen from above as a pattern
A skyscraper tilted into a diagonal
A worker's hands filling the frame
signature_zh: 俯视成图案的人群
倾斜成对角线的摩天楼
填满画面的工人双手
photographers.explore_en: Shoot a subject as a story of ten frames, mixing wide, close and high viewpoints, then edit it to five.
photographers.explore_zh: 把一个题材当成十张照片的故事来拍，混用远景、特写和俯视，再剪到五张。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The Leica snapshot made Japanese. Downtown Tokyo, Akita's snow-country farmers and Paris in 1954: unposed, quick, kind, with nothing forced and nothing missed.
photographers.intro_zh: 把徕卡快照变成日本式的人。东京的下町、秋田雪国的农民、1954 年的巴黎：不摆拍、很快、很温厚，什么都不勉强，什么也没错过。

traits_en.color: Mostly black and white; the Paris colour is soft and faded.
traits_en.composition: Loose, natural, a figure caught mid-gesture.
traits_en.light: Available light, overcast or shade.

traits_zh.color: 以黑白为主；巴黎的彩色柔和、略褪。
traits_zh.composition: 松弛、自然，人物在动作中间被抓住。
traits_zh.light: 现场光，阴天或阴影里。
traits_zh.tone: 完整的灰阶，中等反差。

signature_en: A girl in Akita turning in the snow
A Tokyo alley with a laugh caught in passing
Paris pavement in muted 1950s colour
signature_zh: 雪地里转身的秋田女孩
东京小巷里一个擦肩而过的笑
1950 年代淡彩的巴黎人行道
photographers.explore_en: Use a small camera, stay close and friendly, and shoot the moment before people compose themselves.
photographers.explore_zh: 用小相机，靠近，态度友善，在人们整理好表情之前按下快门。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: An amateur who walked Tokyo in 1936 with a Leica and, decades later as an editor, published those negatives as Tokyo, Showa 11 (1974). Plain frontal pictures of a city that was about to disappear.
photographers.intro_zh: 1936 年带着徕卡走遍东京的业余摄影师，几十年后作为编辑把那些底片出版为《东京昭和十一年》（1974）。朴素、正面的画面，拍的是一座即将消失的城市。

traits_en.color: Black and white, neutral prints.
traits_en.composition: Frontal, centred, the street as a stage set.
traits_en.light: Flat daylight.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，中性的印放。
traits_zh.composition: 正面、居中，街道像舞台布景。
traits_zh.light: 平的日光。
traits_zh.tone: 均匀，中等反差。
traits_zh.mood: 朴素，回看时怀旧，不慌不忙。

signature_en: A shop front with its signs read straight on
Children on a Tokyo street staring back
A tram stop in flat afternoon light
signature_zh: 正对着读得清招牌的店面
东京街头回望镜头的孩子
平淡午后光里的电车站
photographers.explore_en: Stand square to the street, include the signs, and photograph what is ordinary today as if it were already history.
photographers.explore_zh: 正对街道站好，把招牌拍进去，把今天最平常的东西当作已经成为历史来拍。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The great realist. Fubo (1953) stared at faces, Hiroshima (1958) at scars, Children of Chikuho (1960) at poverty, and Pilgrimage to Ancient Temples at the carved wood of the Buddhas, always with a hard, declarative sharpness.
photographers.intro_zh: 伟大的写实主义者。《风貌》（1953）盯着面孔，《广岛》（1958）盯着伤痕，《筑丰的孩子们》（1960）盯着贫穷，《古寺巡礼》盯着佛像的木纹，始终是一种坚硬、宣告式的锐利。

traits_en.color: Black and white, dense and heavy.
traits_en.composition: Tight, frontal, subject filling the frame.
traits_en.light: Hard directional light, strong modelling.
traits_en.tone: Deep blacks, bright highlights, high contrast.
traits_en.texture: Extremely sharp, every pore and grain of wood.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，厚重浓密。
traits_zh.composition: 紧、正面，主体填满画面。
traits_zh.light: 硬的方向光，立体感强。
traits_zh.tone: 深黑、亮白，高反差。
traits_zh.texture: 极度锐利，每个毛孔、每道木纹。

signature_en: A Buddha's hand filling the whole frame
A miner's child in Chikuho looking straight at you
A scarred face in Hiroshima, unflinching
signature_zh: 填满整张画面的佛手
筑丰矿区直视你的孩子
广岛一张毫不回避的伤痕面孔
photographers.explore_en: Get close, use hard light, focus on the detail that carries the whole subject, and print the blacks deep.
photographers.explore_zh: 靠近，用硬光，对准那个能承载整个主体的细节，把黑印得深。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Snow Country (1956) and Japan's Back Coast (1957) recorded the rituals and winters of the Japan Sea side with patience and respect. He later became Magnum's first Japanese contributor and turned to vast nature landscapes.
photographers.intro_zh: 《雪国》（1956）与《背面的日本》（1957）耐心而敬重地记录了日本海一侧的仪式和冬天。他后来成为玛格南图片社的第一位日本供稿摄影师，并转向广阔的自然风景。

traits_en.color: Mostly black and white; later colour landscapes are natural and cool.
traits_en.composition: Figures small in a wide winter; ceremonies seen whole.
traits_en.light: Snow light, overcast, soft and bright.
traits_en.tone: Long grey scale, snow kept luminous.
traits_en.texture: Fine, detailed, textured snow and straw.

traits_zh.color: 以黑白为主；后期的彩色风景自然偏冷。
traits_zh.composition: 人物小小地置于宽广的冬天；仪式完整地呈现。
traits_zh.light: 雪光，阴天，柔而亮。
traits_zh.tone: 长灰阶，雪保持明亮。
traits_zh.texture: 细腻、细节丰富，雪与稻草的质感。

signature_en: Children in straw coats crossing deep snow
A village ritual at night lit by torches
A snow field with one dark line of walkers
signature_zh: 披着蓑衣穿过深雪的孩子
火把照亮的村中夜祭
雪原上一行深色的行人
series: A Chronicle of Grief and Anger (1960)
photographers.explore_en: Follow a place through a whole season, keep people small inside the landscape, and expose for luminous snow.
photographers.explore_zh: 跟着一个地方走完一整个季节，让人在风景里小一点，曝光以保留雪的明亮。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Born in San Francisco, trained at Chicago's Institute of Design, he brought Bauhaus rigour to Japan. Someday, Somewhere (1958) is Chicago and Tokyo seen as pattern; Katsura (1960) reads a villa as pure geometry.
photographers.intro_zh: 生于旧金山，受教于芝加哥设计学院，他把包豪斯的严谨带回日本。《某日某地》（1958）把芝加哥与东京看成图案；《桂》（1960）把一座离宫读成纯粹的几何。

traits_en.color: Black and white, precise and cool.
traits_en.composition: Rigorous geometry, flattened planes, strong grids.
traits_en.light: Clear daylight and shadow edges.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，精确而冷静。
traits_zh.composition: 严谨的几何、压平的面、强烈的网格。
traits_zh.light: 清晰的日光与影子的边缘。
traits_zh.tone: 干净，中高反差，灰阶准确。

signature_en: Katsura's stepping stones as a flat composition
Chicago children playing against a brick grid
A snow-covered Chicago street reduced to lines
signature_zh: 压成平面构成的桂离宫踏石
砖墙网格前玩耍的芝加哥孩子
被雪简化成线条的芝加哥街道
photographers.explore_en: Look for grids and planes, square the camera to them, and compose until nothing in the frame is accidental.
photographers.explore_zh: 找网格和平面，把相机摆正，构图到画面里没有一处是偶然的。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Tokyo's long-distance observer. From the salarymen and ruins of the 1950s to the glass towers of Distant Gaze (1989), he watched the city change from a few steps back, never dramatising it.
photographers.intro_zh: 东京的长期观察者。从 1950 年代的上班族和废墟，到《遥远的视线》（1989）里的玻璃大楼，他退后几步看着这座城市变化，从不渲染。

traits_en.color: Black and white, neutral.
traits_en.composition: Medium distance, people and architecture in proportion.
traits_en.light: Daylight, often overcast.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，中性。
traits_zh.composition: 中景，人和建筑比例恰当。
traits_zh.light: 日光，常是阴天。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，灰阶完整。

signature_en: Salarymen crossing a Marunouchi street in formation
A lone figure under a new glass tower
A 1950s rooftop with laundry and a view of Tokyo
signature_zh: 列队穿过丸之内街道的上班族
新玻璃大楼下孤单的一个人
1950 年代晾着衣服、望得见东京的屋顶
photographers.explore_en: Step back from the action, keep people and buildings in proportion, and come back to the same streets over decades.
photographers.explore_zh: 从事件里退后一步，让人和建筑保持比例，几十年里不断回到同几条街。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The photographer of the kasutori years, the hungover, improvised Tokyo of 1946 to 1950. His portrait of Dazai Osamu perched on a bar stool at Lupin is the image of that era, and his writers' portraits defined a genre.
photographers.intro_zh: “劣酒时代”的摄影师，拍的是 1946 到 1950 年那个宿醉、凑合的东京。他拍太宰治坐在酒吧 Lupin 高脚凳上的那张肖像就是那个年代的形象，他的文士肖像定义了一个门类。

traits_en.color: Black and white, smoky.
traits_en.composition: Environmental portraits, the room as character.
traits_en.light: Bare bulbs, bar light, flash when needed.
traits_en.tone: Medium contrast with dim, warm-feeling greys.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，带烟雾感。
traits_zh.composition: 环境肖像，房间本身也是角色。
traits_zh.light: 裸灯泡、酒吧的光，需要时用闪光。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，昏暗而有暖意的灰。

signature_en: A writer perched on a bar stool with a cigarette
A black-market stall under a bare bulb
A cramped room full of books and smoke
signature_zh: 坐在酒吧高脚凳上叼着烟的作家
裸灯泡下的黑市摊
堆满书和烟雾的狭小房间
photographers.explore_en: Photograph people where they actually spend their nights, keep the room in the frame, and let the light stay dim.
photographers.explore_zh: 在人们真正度过夜晚的地方拍他们，把房间拍进去，让光保持昏暗。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Photography as theatre. Man and Woman (1961) made bodies into black shapes, Ordeal by Roses (1963) cast Mishima as a baroque martyr, and Kamaitachi (1969) let a butoh dancer run wild through Tohoku rice fields.
photographers.intro_zh: 摄影即剧场。《男与女》（1961）把身体变成黑色的形，《蔷薇刑》（1963）让三岛由纪夫扮成巴洛克式的殉道者，《镰鼬》（1969）让舞踏舞者在东北的稻田里撒野。

traits_en.color: Black and white, often extreme.
traits_en.composition: Bodies cropped into shapes, staged tableaux, wild angles.
traits_en.light: Hard, theatrical, high contrast.
traits_en.tone: Deep black masses, blown whites, little grey.
traits_en.texture: Grain, solarisation, blur in the action pieces.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，常常走极端。
traits_zh.composition: 身体被裁成形状，摆布的舞台画面，狂野的角度。
traits_zh.light: 硬、戏剧化、高反差。
traits_zh.tone: 大块的深黑、烧掉的白，灰很少。
traits_zh.texture: 颗粒、曝光反转，动作作品里有晃动。

signature_en: A dancer leaping over farmers in a rice field
Mishima bound in roses and shadow
Two bodies reduced to a single black silhouette
signature_zh: 在稻田里越过农民跳起的舞者
被蔷薇与阴影捆住的三岛
合成一个黑色剪影的两具身体
photographers.explore_en: Direct your subject like a dancer, use one hard light, and print until the body becomes shape.
photographers.explore_zh: 像导演舞者一样指挥被摄者，用一盏硬光，印到身体变成形状为止。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Tsugaru (1963) and the short life behind it. Aomori's farmers and fishermen stand on flat horizons under enormous skies, printed dark and heavy, the north of Japan as a place of endurance.
photographers.intro_zh: 《津轻》（1963）与背后短暂的一生。青森的农民和渔民站在平坦的地平线上、巨大的天空下，印得又暗又重，日本的北方是一个忍耐的地方。

traits_en.color: Black and white, dark and heavy prints.
traits_en.composition: Low horizons, tiny figures, vast sky or snow.
traits_en.light: Winter overcast, backlight on snow.
traits_en.tone: Deep, burnt-in skies and shadows; strong contrast.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，又暗又重的印放。
traits_zh.composition: 低地平线、很小的人、巨大的天或雪。
traits_zh.light: 冬季阴天，雪地逆光。
traits_zh.tone: 加深的天空与阴影；反差强。

signature_en: A farmer bent against the wind on a snow plain
A dark sky pressing down on a flat field
Horses and sledges as specks on white
signature_zh: 雪原上顶风弯腰的农民
压在平坦田野上的黑天
白雪上如黑点的马与雪橇
photographers.explore_en: Find a flat landscape, put the horizon low, keep people small, and burn the sky in until it weighs on them.
photographers.explore_zh: 找一片平坦的地，把地平线放低，让人很小，把天空加深到压在他们身上。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The Map (1965) is the photobook as a sealed object: stains on the ceiling of the Hiroshima dome, crumpled flags, the relics of a lost war, printed so dark they read as geology. A VIVO founder who has kept photographing skies and ruins ever since.
photographers.intro_zh: 《地图》（1965）是作为封闭物件的摄影书：广岛原爆圆顶天花板上的污渍、揉皱的旗帜、战败的遗物，印得黑到像地质层。VIVO 的创始人之一，此后一直在拍天空与废墟。

traits_en.color: Black and white, nearly black.
traits_en.composition: Close, flat surfaces, no horizon, folded pages.
traits_en.light: Dim, raking, forensic.
traits_en.tone: Very dark, textured blacks, small bright marks.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，几近全黑。
traits_zh.composition: 贴近的平面，没有地平线，折页。
traits_zh.light: 昏暗、侧扫、像取证。
traits_zh.tone: 极暗，有质感的黑，少许亮点。

signature_en: A stained ceiling that looks like a map of nowhere
A crumpled Rising Sun flag in near darkness
A storm sky as a wall of black
signature_zh: 像无处之地图的污渍天花板
近乎黑暗中揉皱的太阳旗
一堵黑墙般的风暴天空
photographers.explore_en: Photograph surfaces instead of scenes, underexpose, and print so dark that only the texture survives.
photographers.explore_zh: 拍表面而不是场景，欠曝，印到只剩质感的黑。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Resistance (1965) was shot from inside the student barricades; Sanrizuka (1971) stood with the farmers fighting Narita airport; To the Villages (1980) walked rural Japan with a wide lens and a soft heart.
photographers.intro_zh: 《抵抗》（1965）在学生街垒的内部拍摄；《三里塚》（1971）与抵抗成田机场的农民站在一起；《去村里》（1980）带着广角镜头和一颗柔软的心走遍日本乡村。

traits_en.color: Black and white, grey and gentle in the village work.
traits_en.composition: Wide lens, close to people, the road leading away.
traits_en.light: Overcast daylight, dim interiors.
traits_en.tone: Soft contrast, open shadows, lots of grey.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，村落系列灰而温和。
traits_zh.composition: 广角，贴近人，一条路通向远方。
traits_zh.light: 阴天的日光，昏暗的室内。
traits_zh.tone: 反差柔和，暗部打开，灰很多。

signature_en: A farmer's family behind a barricade of logs
A country road with a child looking back
Students in helmets in a smoky dawn
signature_zh: 原木街垒后的一户农民
乡间路上回头看的孩子
烟雾黎明里戴头盔的学生
photographers.explore_en: Use a wide lens and stay inside the group you photograph; print soft, with the shadows open.
photographers.explore_zh: 用广角，待在你拍的那群人中间；印得柔和，暗部打开。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The theorist of Provoke and its most radical image-maker. For a Language to Come (1970) is night, grain and glare; after burning his archive and losing his memory, he reappeared with flat, vertical colour pictures of whatever was in front of him.
photographers.intro_zh: 《挑衅》的理论者，也是其中最激进的影像作者。《为了该来的语言》（1970）是夜、颗粒与眩光；在烧掉自己的底片并失去记忆之后，他带着平直、竖幅的彩色照片回来，拍眼前的一切。

traits_en.color: Early black and white; late work in plain, saturated, flash-lit colour.
traits_en.composition: Tilted fragments, then rigid vertical frames filled edge to edge.
traits_en.light: Street lamps, headlights, later hard daylight and flash.
traits_en.tone: Crushed blacks and flare early; flat and bright late.
traits_en.texture: Heavy grain and blur, then sharp and literal.

traits_zh.color: 早期黑白；晚期是平直、饱和、闪光灯照亮的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 倾斜的碎片，之后是填满边缘的僵硬竖幅。
traits_zh.light: 路灯、车灯，后期是硬日光和闪光。
traits_zh.tone: 早期压黑与眩光；晚期平而亮。
traits_zh.texture: 早期重颗粒与晃动，后期锐利而直白。
traits_zh.mood: 狂热，然后固执地陈述事实。

signature_en: A street lamp bleeding into black night
A vertical colour photograph of a cat, dead centre
A harbour crane in flat afternoon colour
signature_zh: 在黑夜里晕开的路灯
一张竖幅彩色照片，猫在正中
平淡午后彩色里的港口吊机
photographers.explore_en: Shoot at night with grain and no fear of blur, or the opposite: a vertical frame, flash, and the thing itself with no comment.
photographers.explore_zh: 晚上带着颗粒去拍，不怕晃；或者反过来：竖幅、闪光，只拍东西本身，不加评论。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The photographic diarist. Sentimental Journey (1971) is his honeymoon, Winter Journey (1991) his wife's death, and between and after them tens of thousands of pictures of Tokyo, flowers, women and the sky from his balcony, dated and relentless.
photographers.intro_zh: 摄影日记作者。《感伤之旅》（1971）是他的蜜月，《冬之旅》（1991）是妻子的离世，之间和之后是成千上万张东京、花、女人和阳台外天空的照片，标着日期，从不停歇。

traits_en.color: Black and white diary pages and lush, often oversaturated colour.
traits_en.composition: Snapshot framing, dated edges, the subject close and direct.
traits_en.light: Flash, window light, overcast Tokyo.
traits_en.tone: Hard black and white; colour printed rich and slightly off.

traits_zh.color: 黑白的日记页面，以及浓艳、常常过饱和的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 快照式取景，带日期的边角，主体近而直接。
traits_zh.light: 闪光灯、窗光、阴天的东京。
traits_zh.tone: 硬的黑白；彩色印得浓，略微偏色。
traits_zh.texture: 颗粒、闪光的油亮、胶片边框。

signature_en: Yoko curled in a boat on the honeymoon river
A flower photographed like a body, in saturated colour
A Tokyo street with the date burnt into the corner
signature_zh: 蜜月河上蜷在船里的阳子
拍得像身体的花，饱和的彩色
角上烧着日期的东京街道
photographers.explore_en: Photograph every day, date the frames, mix the sky with the bedroom, and never decide which pictures are important.
photographers.explore_zh: 每天都拍，给照片标上日期，把天空和卧室混在一起，永远不要决定哪些照片重要。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: He walked Shinjuku's Kabukicho at night offering portraits for a few hundred yen. Gangs of Shinjuku (1973) is the result: hosts, drag queens, yakuza and drunks posing proudly under a bare flash, each print sold back to its subject.
photographers.intro_zh: 他夜里走遍新宿歌舞伎町，几百日元给人拍一张肖像。《新宿群盗传》（1973）就是结果：男公关、变装者、黑道和醉汉在裸闪光下骄傲地摆姿势，每张照片都卖回给被拍的人。

traits_en.color: Black and white, flash-lit.
traits_en.composition: Frontal, full-length or half-length, subjects posing for the camera.
traits_en.light: Direct on-camera flash against the night.
traits_en.texture: Flash sheen, grain, cheap print feel.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，闪光灯照亮。
traits_zh.composition: 正面、全身或半身，被拍者对着镜头摆姿势。
traits_zh.light: 直打的机顶闪光，衬着黑夜。
traits_zh.tone: 亮的脸、黑的背景，硬。
traits_zh.texture: 闪光的油亮、颗粒、廉价照片的质感。

signature_en: Two hosts in white suits posing under a flash
A drag queen laughing in a Kabukicho alley
A yakuza showing his tattoo to the camera
signature_zh: 闪光下摆姿势的两个白西装男公关
歌舞伎町小巷里大笑的变装者
向镜头展示刺青的黑道
photographers.explore_en: Ask strangers at night to pose, use a bare flash, and give them the print.
photographers.explore_zh: 夜里请陌生人摆个姿势，用裸闪光拍，然后把照片送给他们。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: FLASH UP (1980): Ikebukuro's nights shot on a 6×7 camera with a brutal flash. Bikers, yakuza, hostesses and accidents frozen in pin-sharp detail, more forensic than Moriyama and just as wild.
photographers.intro_zh: 《FLASH UP》（1980）：用 6×7 相机和凶狠的闪光拍下池袋的夜。飞车党、黑道、陪酒女和车祸被钉在针一般锐利的细节里，比森山大道更像取证，也同样狂野。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Medium format, wide, the whole scene in sharp focus.
traits_en.light: Powerful flash, black beyond its reach.
traits_en.tone: Very high contrast, white skin, black night.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 中画幅、广角，整个场景都清晰。
traits_zh.light: 强力闪光，照不到的地方全黑。
traits_zh.tone: 极高反差，白的皮肤，黑的夜。
traits_zh.texture: 刀锋般锐利，细颗粒，被闪光压平。

signature_en: A biker gang caught mid-shout in a flash
A tattooed back in a bathhouse, every line sharp
A crashed car at night with onlookers
signature_zh: 闪光里正在吼叫的飞车党
澡堂里的刺青后背，每条线都清楚
夜里撞毁的车和围观者
photographers.explore_en: Use the biggest camera you can hold and a strong flash; shoot the night wide, close and in focus.
photographers.explore_zh: 用你拿得动的最大相机和强闪光；把夜拍得广、近、清楚。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Alice (1973) took a young girl to the English countryside and photographed Wonderland in soft colour: meadows, mirrors, rabbits, a dream half remembered. Fashion and nudes followed, always with the same pastel tenderness.
photographers.intro_zh: 《少女爱丽丝》（1973）带一个小女孩去英国乡间，用柔和的彩色拍出仙境：草地、镜子、兔子、半记得的梦。之后的时装与人体作品，始终带着同样的粉彩般的温柔。

traits_en.color: Soft, pastel, slightly faded colour.
traits_en.composition: Figure in a landscape or a room, fairy-tale staging.
traits_en.light: Overcast English daylight, window light.
traits_en.texture: Fine grain with a mild diffusion.

traits_zh.color: 柔和、粉彩、略褪色的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 人物置于风景或房间中，童话式的布置。
traits_zh.light: 阴天的英国日光，窗光。
traits_zh.tone: 低反差，温柔的高光。

signature_en: A girl in a blue dress lying in long grass
A mirror in a meadow reflecting the sky
A rabbit on a tea table in soft light
signature_zh: 躺在长草里的蓝裙女孩
草地上映着天空的镜子
柔光里茶桌上的兔子
photographers.explore_en: Stage a small story in soft overcast light, keep the colours pale, and let the picture feel like a memory.
photographers.explore_zh: 在柔和的阴天光里布置一个小故事，颜色保持淡，让画面像一段记忆。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A Provoke founder who went the other way: Towards the City (1974) is Tokyo as a cool, dense inventory, Machi (1977) its old quarters in large format, and Hatsukuni (1993) the whole country surveyed with a view camera.
photographers.intro_zh: 《挑衅》的创始人之一，却走向了相反的方向：《向着都市》（1974）把东京当作冷静而密集的清单，《町》（1977）用大画幅拍旧街区，《初国》（1993）用座机把整个国家勘测了一遍。

traits_en.color: Black and white, cool and even.
traits_en.composition: Dense, layered city frames; later frontal, formal views.
traits_en.light: Flat daylight, fluorescent interiors.
traits_en.tone: Medium contrast, full detail in both ends.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，冷而均匀。
traits_zh.composition: 密集、分层的城市画面；后期正面、正式的取景。
traits_zh.light: 平的日光、日光灯的室内。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，两端都保留细节。
traits_zh.texture: 从 135 的颗粒到大画幅的清晰。

signature_en: Commuters packed against a train window
A tofu shop interior photographed like a monument
A plain Japanese town seen straight on with a view camera
signature_zh: 挤在车窗后的通勤者
被拍得像纪念碑的豆腐店内部
用座机正面拍下的普通日本小镇
photographers.explore_en: Treat the city as a collection: photograph the same kind of place again and again, frontally, with everything in focus.
photographers.explore_zh: 把城市当作收藏：同一类地方反复拍，正面拍，全部清晰。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Human Land (1956) and Domains (1958) invented the personal documentary in Japan: a mining island, a village under a volcano, a monastery and a women's prison as closed worlds. Europe: Where Time Has Stopped (1967) and Where Time Has Vanished (1975) carried the same stillness abroad.
photographers.intro_zh: 《人间的土地》（1956）和《王国》（1958）在日本发明了个人纪实：矿岛、火山下的村庄、修道院和女子监狱，都是封闭的世界。《欧洲·静止的时间》（1967）与《消失的时间》（1975）把同样的静止带到了海外。

traits_en.color: Black and white; later American work in clear, cool colour.
traits_en.composition: Formal, often symmetrical, a figure placed in a closed space.
traits_en.light: Sharp directional light, deep shade.

traits_zh.color: 黑白；后期的美国作品是清澈偏冷的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 正式，常对称，人物置于封闭空间中。
traits_zh.light: 锐利的方向光，深影。
traits_zh.tone: 高反差，灰阶优雅。

signature_en: A nun walking a corridor of light and shadow
A mining island seen as a fortress on the sea
A Spanish plaza at noon, empty and exact
signature_zh: 走过光影走廊的修女
被看作海上堡垒的矿岛
正午空无一人、精确的西班牙广场
photographers.explore_en: Choose one enclosed place and photograph it as a world; frame formally and wait for the light to carve it.
photographers.explore_zh: 选一个封闭的地方，把它当作一个世界来拍；构图正式，等光把它雕出来。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Zokushin: Gods of the Earth (1976) went looking for the folk Japan hidden under the modern one, in masks, pilgrims and fairgrounds. Counting Grains of Sand (1990) then photographed the crowd itself, beaches and stadiums packed edge to edge.
photographers.intro_zh: 《俗神》（1976）去寻找藏在现代日本之下的民俗日本：面具、朝圣者、庙会。《数砂》（1990）则直接拍人群本身，海滩和体育场挤到画面边缘。

traits_en.color: Black and white, neutral.
traits_en.composition: Centred figures early; later wall-to-wall crowds with no subject.
traits_en.light: Daylight, often harsh and direct.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，中性。
traits_zh.composition: 早期人物居中；后期人群铺满画面，没有主体。
traits_zh.light: 日光，常常硬而直接。
traits_zh.tone: 高反差，黑很密。

signature_en: A masked dancer at a village festival, dead centre
A beach so full of people it becomes a texture
A stadium crowd as a single grey field
signature_zh: 村祭里正中央戴面具的舞者
挤满人到变成质感的海滩
成为一片灰色的体育场人群
photographers.explore_en: Photograph a crowd until no single person matters, or a ritual until the mask matters more than the face.
photographers.explore_zh: 拍人群，拍到没有哪一个人重要；或者拍仪式，拍到面具比脸更重要。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A chemist turned photographer of the spirit world. Baba (1979) is the old women of Tohoku's mountain cults, shot at night with a flash so hard they look like apparitions; Tokyo (1985) did the same to the city.
photographers.intro_zh: 化学家出身的灵界摄影师。《婆》（1979）拍东北山岳信仰中的老妇人，夜里用极硬的闪光，让她们看起来像显灵；《东京》（1985）对城市做了同样的事。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Faces and figures looming out of black, close and distorted.
traits_en.light: Direct flash at night, nothing else.
traits_en.tone: Extreme contrast, white faces in total black.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 脸和身影从黑里浮出，近而变形。
traits_zh.light: 夜里直打的闪光，别无其他。
traits_zh.tone: 极端反差，全黑中的白脸。

signature_en: An old woman's face blazing white against the night
A mountain ascetic mid-chant, eyes shut
A Tokyo crowd turned into ghosts by flash
signature_zh: 夜里白得发亮的老妇人的脸
闭着眼念诵中的山伏
被闪光变成鬼魂的东京人群
photographers.explore_en: Shoot at night with a direct flash and nothing else lit; get close to faces and let the dark swallow the rest.
photographers.explore_zh: 夜里只用直打的闪光，别的都不照亮；贴近面孔，让黑暗吞掉其余一切。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Self and Others (1977): people looking back at a camera held by a man who knew he would not live long. Square, frontal, quiet portraits of children, couples and strangers, each one a small question about the distance between two people.
photographers.intro_zh: 《自我与他者》（1977）：人们回望一台相机，拿相机的人知道自己活不长。方画幅、正面、安静的孩子、情侣和陌生人的肖像，每一张都是关于两个人之间距离的小小提问。

traits_en.color: Black and white, soft and grey.
traits_en.composition: Square, frontal, the subject centred and looking at you.
traits_en.light: Overcast daylight, window light.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，柔而灰。
traits_zh.composition: 方画幅、正面，主体居中并看着你。
traits_zh.light: 阴天的日光，窗光。
traits_zh.tone: 低到中等反差，温和。

signature_en: Two children standing side by side, looking straight at the camera
A couple on a bench, slightly apart
A girl in a doorway, half smiling
signature_zh: 并肩站着直视镜头的两个孩子
长椅上略微隔开的一对
门口半笑着的女孩
photographers.explore_en: Ask people to look at the camera, keep a little distance, shoot square in soft light, and print gently.
photographers.explore_zh: 请人看着镜头，保持一点距离，在柔光里拍方画幅，印得温和。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Japan's most famous portraitist, from 135 Women Friends to Santa Fe (1991), the bestselling nude of its decade. Bright, frontal, flawlessly lit and composed, with the confidence of a photographer who never doubted the camera.
photographers.intro_zh: 日本最有名的肖像摄影师，从《135 个女朋友》到那个年代最畅销的人体写真《Santa Fe》（1991）。明亮、正面、用光和构图毫无瑕疵，带着一个从不怀疑相机的摄影师的自信。

traits_en.color: Clean, bright, true colour; black and white for the houses.
traits_en.composition: Frontal, symmetrical, the subject owning the frame.
traits_en.light: Flawless daylight or studio light, open and even.

traits_zh.color: 干净、明亮、真实的彩色；拍房子时用黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 正面、对称，主体掌控画面。
traits_zh.light: 完美的日光或棚光，开阔均匀。
traits_zh.tone: 明亮，中等反差，干净的白。

signature_en: An actress standing square to the camera in bright New Mexico light
A traditional house photographed as a perfect frontal elevation
A hundred people posed on a beach like a class photo
signature_zh: 新墨西哥明亮的光里正对镜头的女演员
被拍成完美正立面的传统民居
像毕业照一样摆在海滩上的一百个人
photographers.explore_en: Put the subject square in the middle, light it fully and evenly, and shoot with total confidence.
photographers.explore_zh: 把主体放在正中间，光打得饱满均匀，带着十足的自信按快门。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Photo Express: Tokyo (1979) was a monthly storm of flash-lit street pictures; New York (1982) hardened it into a slash of punk energy. Then the opposite: USSR 1991 and the Portraits series, formal, colour, exact.
photographers.intro_zh: 《写真特急便 东京》（1979）是每月一册、闪光照亮的街头风暴；《NEW YORK》（1982）把它硬化成朋克式的一道劈痕。然后走向反面：《USSR 1991》和《PORTRAITS》系列，正式、彩色、精确。

traits_en.color: Early black and white; later neutral, exact colour on a plain backdrop.
traits_en.composition: Early tilted, close, chaotic; later frontal and fixed.
traits_en.light: Flash in the street, then flat, even studio-like light.
traits_en.tone: Harsh contrast early; even and literal later.
traits_en.texture: Grain and glare, then clean large format.

traits_zh.color: 早期黑白；后期在素背景前的中性、精确的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 早期倾斜、贴近、混乱；后期正面、固定。
traits_zh.light: 街头的闪光，之后是平而均匀的近似棚光。
traits_zh.tone: 早期反差刺眼；后期均匀、直白。
traits_zh.texture: 颗粒与眩光，之后是干净的大画幅。

signature_en: A punk's face in a New York club, flash-burnt
A Soviet street in 1991, flat and grey
A portrait against a white wall with nothing else
signature_zh: 纽约俱乐部里被闪光烧白的朋克面孔
1991 年平淡灰色的苏联街道
白墙前别无他物的一张肖像
photographers.explore_en: Shoot a street series fast and rough, then photograph the same people slowly, frontally, against a bare wall.
photographers.explore_zh: 先快而粗地拍一组街头，再慢下来，正面、在空白的墙前拍同一群人。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The Park (1980): Tokyo's parks after midnight, photographed on infrared film with an invisible flash. Couples in the grass and the men who crept up to watch them, the photographer among the watchers.
photographers.intro_zh: 《公园》（1980）：午夜之后的东京公园，用红外胶片和看不见的闪光拍摄。草地上的情侣，以及爬过去偷看的男人们，摄影师也是偷看者之一。

traits_en.color: Black and white infrared.
traits_en.composition: Figures crouching in bushes, glimpsed, partly hidden.
traits_en.light: Invisible infrared flash, otherwise total darkness.
traits_en.tone: Grey, milky, strange tonal reversals of foliage.

traits_zh.color: 黑白红外。
traits_zh.composition: 蹲在灌木里的身影，被瞥见，半遮半掩。
traits_zh.light: 看不见的红外闪光，其余全黑。
traits_zh.tone: 灰、乳白，树叶出现奇怪的影调反转。
traits_zh.texture: 重颗粒、红外的辉光、晃动。

signature_en: Men crouching toward a couple on the grass
Leaves glowing white in infrared darkness
A figure half hidden behind a bush, looking back
signature_zh: 朝草地上的情侣爬去的男人们
红外黑暗里发白光的树叶
躲在灌木后回头看的半个身影
photographers.explore_en: Work in near-total darkness with a flash you cannot see, and photograph the watchers as much as the watched.
photographers.explore_zh: 在接近全黑的环境里用看不见的闪光，把偷看的人和被看的人一起拍下来。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: He moved to Paris in 1972 and photographed the light there as if it were a material. Fenêtre (1973–1980) is windows and the hard European daylight that cut through them; Éclats scattered that light into shards.
photographers.intro_zh: 1972 年移居巴黎，把那里的光当作一种物质来拍。《窗》（1973–1980）拍窗户和穿过它们的坚硬欧洲日光；《Éclats》则把那束光打碎成碎片。

traits_en.color: Black and white, high key against black.
traits_en.composition: Window frames, beams, edges; abstract geometry of light.
traits_en.light: Hard sunlight as the subject, deep black around it.
traits_en.tone: Extreme contrast, pure white and pure black.
traits_en.texture: Sharp edges, glass, dust in the beam.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，黑底上的高光。
traits_zh.composition: 窗框、光束、边缘；光的抽象几何。
traits_zh.light: 硬日光本身就是主体，周围深黑。
traits_zh.tone: 极端反差，纯白与纯黑。
traits_zh.texture: 锐利的边缘、玻璃、光束里的灰尘。

signature_en: A window frame burning white in a black room
A beam of light cut by a blind into stripes
An artist's face lit by one hard window
signature_zh: 黑屋子里烧成白色的窗框
被百叶窗切成条纹的一束光
被一扇硬窗光照亮的艺术家面孔
photographers.explore_en: Photograph the light rather than the room: expose for the window, let everything else go black.
photographers.explore_zh: 拍光而不是房间：按窗户曝光，让其他一切沉入黑暗。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: A sociologist with a camera. Seventeen (1988) and Couples (1988) photographed ordinary Japanese standing in their own rooms and workplaces, full length, looking at the lens, with a short statement from each. Plain, equal, exact.
photographers.intro_zh: 带相机的社会学家。《十七岁》（1988）和《对子》（1988）拍普通日本人站在自己的房间和工作场所里，全身，看着镜头，每人附一段短短的话。朴素、平等、精确。

traits_en.color: Black and white, even.
traits_en.composition: Full-length, frontal, the environment carefully included.
traits_en.light: Available light, flat and honest.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，均匀。
traits_zh.composition: 全身、正面，环境被仔细地纳入。
traits_zh.light: 现场光，平而诚实。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，一切都读得清。
traits_zh.mood: 尊重、中立、安静的社会学。

signature_en: A seventeen-year-old standing in a tiny bedroom, full length
A couple side by side in their shop
A father in his uniform in the doorway of his workplace
signature_zh: 站在小小卧室里的十七岁全身像
并肩站在自家店里的一对
穿着制服站在工作场所门口的父亲
photographers.explore_en: Photograph people full length where they live or work, frontally and in the same way every time, and ask each a question.
photographers.explore_zh: 在人们生活或工作的地方拍全身像，正面，每次用同样的方式，再问每个人一个问题。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Architectural Apocalypse (1988): buildings caught halfway through demolition, their rooms open to the sky. Kowloon Walled City, the homeless shelters of Cardboard Houses and the Kobe earthquake continued the same question of what a building is when it fails.
photographers.intro_zh: 《建筑默示录》（1988）：拆到一半的建筑，房间向天空敞开。九龙城寨、流浪者的《纸板屋》和神户地震，延续了同一个问题：当建筑失败时，它还是什么。

traits_en.color: Black and white, large format.
traits_en.composition: Frontal elevations, ordered chaos, every brick in place.
traits_en.light: Overcast daylight, no drama.
traits_en.tone: Full, long grey scale with deep detail.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，大画幅。
traits_zh.composition: 正面的立面、有序的混乱，每块砖都在位置上。
traits_zh.light: 阴天的日光，不渲染。
traits_zh.tone: 完整的长灰阶，深处有细节。
traits_zh.texture: 细节极多：瓦砾、电线、纸板。

signature_en: A half-demolished building with wallpaper open to the rain
Kowloon Walled City as a cliff of windows
A cardboard shelter photographed like a monument
signature_zh: 拆了一半、壁纸露在雨里的楼
像一面窗户悬崖的九龙城寨
被拍得像纪念碑的纸板小屋
photographers.explore_en: Photograph buildings being destroyed or improvised, frontally and in flat light, with every detail sharp.
photographers.explore_zh: 拍正在被拆除或临时搭起的建筑，正面、平光，每个细节都清楚。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Japanese Typology (1992) found abstraction in civil engineering: dams, concrete slope nets and spillways photographed with an 8×10 camera until they became pattern. Later colour work keeps the same cool, flawless geometry.
photographers.intro_zh: 《日本典型》（1992）在土木工程里找到了抽象：水坝、混凝土护坡网和泄洪道，用 8×10 相机拍到它们变成图案。后来的彩色作品延续着同样冷静、无瑕的几何。

traits_en.color: Black and white; later muted, exact colour.
traits_en.composition: No horizon, no scale, surfaces filling the frame.
traits_en.light: Overcast, shadowless.

traits_zh.color: 黑白；后期是克制、精确的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 没有地平线，没有尺度，表面填满画面。
traits_zh.light: 阴天，无影。
traits_zh.tone: 均匀，中等反差，细节巨大。
traits_zh.texture: 混凝土、水、网，呈现得完美。

signature_en: A concrete slope net as a grid across the whole frame
Water sliding down a spillway like silk
A dam wall with no sky and no ground
signature_zh: 铺满整张画面的混凝土护坡网格
像丝绸一样滑下泄洪道的水
没有天也没有地的坝墙
photographers.explore_en: Find built landscapes, remove the horizon and any sense of scale, and let the surface become the picture.
photographers.explore_zh: 找人造的地貌，去掉地平线和尺度感，让表面本身成为画面。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: For over forty years he stood by the red wall of Senso-ji in Asakusa and asked passers-by to pose. Persona (2003) collects them: square, frontal, every one captioned with a line like 'a man who said he was a poet'.
photographers.intro_zh: 四十多年里，他站在浅草寺的红墙边请路人摆姿势。《PERSONA》（2003）把他们收在一起：方画幅、正面，每张都配一句像“自称是诗人的男人”这样的话。

traits_en.color: Black and white, same wall every time.
traits_en.composition: Square, frontal, half-length, the person alone.
traits_en.light: Open shade, consistent and soft.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，每次都是同一面墙。
traits_zh.composition: 方画幅、正面、半身，只有这个人。
traits_zh.light: 开放的阴影，稳定而柔。
traits_zh.tone: 丰富的中灰，深色背景。

signature_en: An old man in a battered hat against the temple wall
A woman with a parrot on her shoulder, deadpan
A street labourer standing proudly in work boots
signature_zh: 寺墙前戴着破帽的老人
肩上停着鹦鹉、面无表情的女人
穿着工靴骄傲站立的工人
photographers.explore_en: Pick one wall in open shade, return for years, and photograph strangers half-length, frontally, with the same respect each time.
photographers.explore_zh: 选一面在阴影里的墙，年复一年地回去，用同样的尊重正面拍陌生人的半身像。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Based in Graz since 1973. Mémoires, re-edited again and again since 1989, is the photographs of his wife Christine from their meeting in 1978 to her death in 1985, with the borders and bleak suburbs of Cold War Europe around them.
photographers.intro_zh: 1973 年起定居格拉茨。自 1989 年起一再重新编辑的《Mémoires》，是他从 1978 年相遇到 1985 年她离世之间为妻子克里斯蒂娜拍的照片，周围是冷战欧洲的边境和萧瑟的郊区。

traits_en.color: Mixed: muted colour and quiet black and white.
traits_en.composition: A face close, a figure in a bleak landscape, windows, borders.
traits_en.light: Winter daylight, grey skies.

traits_zh.color: 混合：克制的彩色与安静的黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 一张近的脸，一个在萧瑟风景里的身影，窗户，边境。
traits_zh.light: 冬天的日光，灰色的天。
traits_zh.tone: 柔和、低反差、偏冷。

signature_en: Christine's face half turned away in winter light
A border fence in snow seen from a train
A child and a woman small in a grey East German street
signature_zh: 冬日光里半侧过去的克里斯蒂娜的脸
从火车上看到的雪中边境铁丝网
灰色东德街道上小小的孩子与女人
photographers.explore_en: Photograph one person over years without a plan, then edit the archive again every few years and let the meaning change.
photographers.explore_zh: 没有计划地拍一个人很多年，之后每隔几年重新编辑一次，让意义自己改变。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The wanderer of provincial Japan. Distant Town (1998) and Slow Boat (2003) drift through small stations, shuttered shops and back lanes, in soft black and white or faded colour, never in a hurry to arrive anywhere.
photographers.intro_zh: 日本地方小城的漫游者。《遥远的城镇》（1998）和《Slow Boat》（2003）在小车站、拉下卷帘的店铺和后巷间漂流，柔和的黑白或褪色的彩色，从不急着到达哪里。

traits_en.color: Soft black and white; colour faded and warm.
traits_en.composition: Loose, off-centre, a lane leading away.
traits_en.light: Overcast afternoons, dusk.
traits_en.mood: Wistful, unhurried, lonely in a pleasant way.

traits_zh.color: 柔和的黑白；彩色褪色而温暖。
traits_zh.composition: 松散、偏离中心，一条巷子通向远处。
traits_zh.light: 阴天的午后，黄昏。
traits_zh.tone: 低反差，暖灰。
traits_zh.mood: 怅惘、不急、一种舒服的孤独。

signature_en: A cat on the steps of a shuttered shop
An empty platform at a country station at dusk
A faded colour lane with one bicycle
signature_zh: 拉下卷帘的店门台阶上的猫
黄昏时乡下车站空荡的站台
褪色彩色的小巷和一辆自行车
photographers.explore_en: Take a slow train to a town nobody visits, walk its back streets in the afternoon, and photograph whatever makes you stop.
photographers.explore_zh: 坐慢车去一个没人去的小镇，下午在后巷里走，拍任何让你停下来的东西。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Kumano (1998) walked the pilgrim paths of his home region with an 8×10 camera and photographed the act of looking: a path bending into trees, light on wet stone. Sakura and the snow pictures turned the same attention to blossoms and whiteness.
photographers.intro_zh: 《熊野》（1998）带着 8×10 相机走故乡的朝圣古道，拍的是“看”这件事本身：拐进树林的小路、湿石头上的光。《樱》和雪的作品把同样的注意力投向花与白。

traits_en.color: Natural, quiet colour; pinks and whites, forest greens.
traits_en.composition: The eye's path into the frame; shallow focus, open edges.
traits_en.light: Soft forest light, snow light, overcast.
traits_en.texture: Large format with deliberate out-of-focus passages.

traits_zh.color: 自然、安静的颜色；粉与白，森林的绿。
traits_zh.composition: 视线进入画面的路径；浅焦点，开放的边缘。
traits_zh.light: 柔和的林间光、雪光、阴天。
traits_zh.tone: 细腻、明亮、低反差。
traits_zh.texture: 大画幅，带有刻意的失焦段落。

signature_en: A pilgrim path turning into dark cedars
Cherry blossoms so close they dissolve into pink
A snow field with the horizon almost gone
signature_zh: 拐进深色杉林的朝圣小路
近到化成一片粉色的樱花
地平线几乎消失的雪原
photographers.explore_en: Photograph where your eye goes rather than what is there: shallow focus, soft light, and nothing dramatic.
photographers.explore_zh: 拍你的眼睛去的地方，而不是那里有什么：浅焦、柔光，不要任何戏剧性。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: The earth as a surface. Aerial and high-vantage photographs of cities, deserts and ports with no horizon, no sky and no shadows, so that a whole town reads as texture. Named by place code, catalogued like geography.
photographers.intro_zh: 地球作为一个表面。从空中或高处拍的城市、沙漠和港口，没有地平线、没有天空、没有影子，一整座城读起来像质感。以地名代码命名，像地理学一样编目。

traits_en.color: Black and white or muted, true colour.
traits_en.composition: Top-down, edge to edge, no horizon, no focal point.
traits_en.light: Flat, high, shadowless.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，或克制、真实的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 俯视，铺满边缘，没有地平线，没有焦点。
traits_zh.light: 平、高、无影。
traits_zh.tone: 均匀，细节巨大，中等反差。
traits_zh.texture: 每一片屋顶、每一棵树都分辨得出。

signature_en: A city from above as an even field of roofs
Rice terraces as contour lines
A desert town with no sky and no shadow
signature_zh: 从上方看去像一片均匀屋顶的城市
像等高线一样的梯田
没有天也没有影子的沙漠小城
photographers.explore_en: Get high above a place, exclude the sky and horizon, shoot in flat light, and keep the entire frame equally sharp.
photographers.explore_zh: 站到一个地方的高处，把天空和地平线排除在外，用平光拍，整张画面同样清晰。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Ice Box (1996): refrigerators in friends' kitchens, each photographed closed and then open, a typology of private life. Bibliotheca (2017) did the same for books and the rooms that hold them.
photographers.intro_zh: 《冰箱》（1996）：朋友家厨房里的冰箱，每一台先拍关着的，再拍打开的，一部私人生活的类型学。《Bibliotheca》（2017）对书和放书的房间做了同样的事。

traits_en.color: Black and white, even.
traits_en.composition: Frontal, centred object, paired frames.
traits_en.light: Flat domestic light.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，均匀。
traits_zh.composition: 正面、居中的物件，成对的画面。
traits_zh.light: 平的家居光。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，一切清晰可读。
traits_zh.mood: 面无表情、有感情、安静地好笑。

signature_en: A refrigerator covered in magnets, door closed
The same refrigerator open, shelves packed
A wall of books with a ladder, frontal
signature_zh: 贴满磁贴、关着门的冰箱
同一台冰箱打开，层板塞满
正面拍的一整面书墙和一把梯子
photographers.explore_en: Choose one household object, photograph it the same way in many homes, closed and open, and let the differences speak.
photographers.explore_zh: 选一件家用物件，在很多家里用同样的方式拍它，关着和开着各一张，让差异自己说话。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Yokosuka Story (1979) was the grainy, angry town of her youth beside the US base. Mother's (2005) photographed her dead mother's lipstick, underwear and scarred skin; Hiroshima (2008) the dresses of the bomb's victims in pale, tender colour.
photographers.intro_zh: 《绝唱、横须贺故事》（1979）是她少年时代那座美军基地旁、颗粒粗粝而愤怒的小城。《母亲遗物》（2005）拍已故母亲的口红、内衣和留疤的皮肤；《广岛》（2008）用苍白温柔的彩色拍原爆受害者的衣裙。

traits_en.color: Grainy black and white early; later pale, luminous colour on a light box.
traits_en.composition: Objects isolated and centred; textures close.
traits_en.light: Backlight through fabric, soft and even.
traits_en.tone: Early dark and rough; late high key and delicate.
traits_en.texture: Grain, then thread, lace and skin in fine detail.

traits_zh.color: 早期颗粒粗的黑白；后期是灯箱上苍白发光的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 物件被孤立并居中；贴近质感。
traits_zh.light: 透过布料的背光，柔和均匀。
traits_zh.tone: 早期暗而粗；后期高调而细腻。
traits_zh.texture: 颗粒，之后是线、蕾丝和皮肤的细节。

signature_en: A flowered dress glowing on a light box, no body in it
A used lipstick photographed like a relic
A grainy Yokosuka alley at night
signature_zh: 灯箱上发光、里面没有身体的花裙
被拍得像圣物的用过的口红
夜里颗粒粗粝的横须贺小巷
photographers.explore_en: Photograph what someone left behind on a light box or against a window, centred, pale, and with every thread sharp.
photographers.explore_zh: 把某人留下的东西放在灯箱上或窗前拍，居中、苍白，每根线都清楚。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Canary (2007) and Lilly (2007) were hallucinatory flash pictures of neighbours and strangers. Rasen Kaigan: Spiral Shore (2013) came from the years she lived in the village of Kitakama, before and after the 2011 tsunami, staging its people and its memories at night.
photographers.intro_zh: 《金丝雀》（2007）和《Lilly》（2007）是用闪光灯拍邻居和陌生人的致幻影像。《螺旋海岸》（2013）来自她住在北釜村的那些年，跨越 2011 年海啸前后，在夜里把村民和他们的记忆搬演出来。

traits_en.color: Saturated, unnatural colour under flash; greens, reds and black.
traits_en.composition: Bodies and objects floating in black, staged and strange.
traits_en.light: Hard flash at night, coloured gels, long exposures.

traits_zh.color: 闪光下饱和而不自然的颜色；绿、红与黑。
traits_zh.composition: 身体和物件漂浮在黑里，摆布而怪异。
traits_zh.light: 夜里的硬闪光、彩色滤片、长曝光。
traits_zh.tone: 深黑配灼亮的高光。

signature_en: A villager lying in a field at night lit green by flash
A pine tree spinning in a long exposure
Hands holding a photograph in total darkness
signature_zh: 夜里躺在田里、被闪光照成绿色的村民
长曝光中旋转的松树
全黑中捧着一张照片的手
photographers.explore_en: Work at night with flash and long exposures, direct real people in their own place, and let the picture become a myth.
photographers.explore_zh: 夜里用闪光和长曝光，在真实的人自己的地方指挥他们，让照片变成一个神话。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Elevator Girls (1993–1999) multiplied uniformed young women through glossy, empty department-store spaces; My Grandmothers (2000–) asked young women to imagine themselves fifty years on and built the picture; Fairy Tale turned to black-and-white theatre.
photographers.intro_zh: 《电梯小姐》（1993–1999）把穿制服的年轻女性复制进光洁而空荡的百货公司空间；《我的祖母们》（2000– ）请年轻女性想象五十年后的自己，再把画面搭建出来；《童话》转向黑白的剧场。

traits_en.color: Glossy, cool commercial colour; later stark black and white.
traits_en.composition: Symmetrical, digitally built, figures repeated.
traits_en.light: Even, artificial, shadowless.

traits_zh.color: 光洁、偏冷的商业彩色；后期是生硬的黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 对称、数字合成、人物重复。
traits_zh.light: 均匀、人工、无影。
traits_zh.tone: 干净、精致、中等反差。

signature_en: Identical uniformed women in a mirrored shopping atrium
An imagined old woman riding a motorbike into the future
A child in a fairy-tale mask on a dark stage
signature_zh: 镜面商场中庭里一模一样的制服女性
骑摩托驶向未来的想象中的老妇
黑暗舞台上戴童话面具的孩子
photographers.explore_en: Build the picture rather than find it: a set, a cast, even light, and a question about who women are allowed to be.
photographers.explore_zh: 搭建画面而不是寻找画面：布景、演员、均匀的光，以及一个关于女性被允许成为谁的问题。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Born in Thailand to a Japanese father, he photographs people between places. Living Room, Tokyo (1996) visited Asian immigrants in their small apartments; Picnic (2006) sat with couples on park lawns at a respectful distance, the city soft behind them.
photographers.intro_zh: 生于泰国、父亲是日本人，他拍的是处在两地之间的人。《Living Room, Tokyo》（1996）走进亚洲移民的小公寓；《野餐》（2006）以礼貌的距离坐在公园草坪上的情侣旁边，城市柔和地在他们身后。

traits_en.color: Mostly colour, natural and calm; black and white for the rooms.
traits_en.composition: Figures centred at middle distance, surroundings included.
traits_en.light: Daylight on grass, dim apartment light.

traits_zh.color: 以彩色为主，自然平静；拍房间时用黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 人物在中景居中，周围环境纳入。
traits_zh.light: 草地上的日光，公寓里昏暗的光。
traits_zh.tone: 中低反差，柔和。

signature_en: A couple on a lawn, seen from a few metres away
A Filipino worker in a six-mat room with a rice cooker
Bangkok traffic at dusk in muted colour
signature_zh: 从几米外看去草坪上的一对
六叠小屋里带着电饭锅的菲律宾劳工
黄昏时克制彩色里的曼谷车流
photographers.explore_en: Keep a polite distance from people, centre them in their surroundings, and shoot in soft daylight without asking them to pose.
photographers.explore_zh: 和人保持礼貌的距离，把他们放在环境中央，在柔和的日光里拍，不要求摆姿势。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Tokyo Parrots (2013): the feral parakeets of Tokyo flash-lit against the night, acid green on black, so dense they turn into pattern. YUSURIKA and the later series keep the same flash-and-colour shock in nature's invasions of the city.
photographers.intro_zh: 《东京鹦鹉》（2013）：东京的野生鹦鹉在夜里被闪光照亮，黑底上的酸绿，密到变成图案。《YUSURIKA》和之后的系列延续着同样的闪光与色彩冲击，拍自然对城市的入侵。

traits_en.color: Saturated, electric: green, pink, white on black or sky blue.
traits_en.composition: Pattern-like repetition, filled frames, no single subject.
traits_en.light: Hard flash at night or in snow.
traits_en.tone: High contrast, blazing colour on black.

traits_zh.color: 饱和、带电：黑底或天蓝上的绿、粉、白。
traits_zh.composition: 图案式的重复，填满画面，没有单一主体。
traits_zh.light: 夜里或雪中的硬闪光。
traits_zh.tone: 高反差，黑上灼亮的颜色。

signature_en: Hundreds of green parakeets flash-lit in a black tree
Midges swarming white against a blue sky
A cherry tree in snow turned into a pattern
signature_zh: 黑树上被闪光照亮的几百只绿鹦鹉
蓝天前白色成群的蠓虫
雪中化成图案的樱花树
photographers.explore_en: Find nature inside the city, light it with a hard flash against the dark, and fill the frame until it becomes a pattern.
photographers.explore_zh: 在城市里找自然，用硬闪光把它从黑暗里打出来，填满画面直到变成图案。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Tokyo Circulation (2016) and the ariphoto zines: square black-and-white portraits of the people who pass through Shinjuku, met head on with a 6×6 camera, printed deep and sharp, with the same attention given to a crow or a cat.
photographers.intro_zh: 《东京循环》（2016）和 ariphoto 小册子：用 6×6 相机迎面拍下途经新宿的人们，方画幅黑白肖像，印得深而锐利，对一只乌鸦或一只猫也给同样的注意。

traits_en.color: Black and white, dense.
traits_en.composition: Square, close, frontal, the subject filling the frame.
traits_en.light: Hard street light, strong sun and shade.
traits_en.tone: Deep blacks, bright skin, high contrast.

traits_zh.color: 黑白，浓密。
traits_zh.composition: 方画幅、贴近、正面，主体填满画面。
traits_zh.light: 硬的街头光，强烈的阳光与阴影。
traits_zh.tone: 深黑、亮皮肤，高反差。
traits_zh.texture: 锐利，丰富的中画幅颗粒。

signature_en: A homeless man's face filling a square frame in hard sun
A crow on a railing, photographed like a person
A young woman in Shinjuku staring straight back
signature_zh: 硬阳光下填满方画幅的流浪者面孔
栏杆上被当作人来拍的乌鸦
新宿街头直直回望的年轻女子
photographers.explore_en: Approach people head on with a square camera, fill the frame with the face, and print the blacks full.
photographers.explore_zh: 用方画幅相机迎面走向人，让脸填满画面，把黑印满。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.intro_en: Tiny, hand-toned prints no bigger than a palm: a bird on a wire, a hand holding snow, a leaf, an empty sky. A Box of Ku, Nakazora and Tori (2016) are haiku made of silver, worn at the edges as if carried in a pocket.
photographers.intro_zh: 巴掌大、手工调色的小照片：电线上的一只鸟、捧着雪的手、一片叶子、一片空天。《Box of Ku》《中空》和《鸟》（2016）是用银盐写成的俳句，边角磨损得像在口袋里带过。

traits_en.color: Monochrome, warm or sepia toned, sometimes hand-coloured.
traits_en.composition: One small thing in a lot of space; tiny prints.
traits_en.light: Soft, diffuse, often overcast.

traits_zh.color: 单色，暖调或棕调，偶尔手工上色。
traits_zh.composition: 大片空间里的一件小东西；很小的照片。
traits_zh.light: 柔和、漫射，常是阴天。
traits_zh.tone: 低反差、发光、边缘褪色。
traits_zh.texture: 柔的颗粒、磨损的相纸、调色。

signature_en: A single bird on a wire in a pale sky
A hand cupping a little snow
A small print with worn, darkened corners
signature_zh: 苍白天空中电线上的一只鸟
捧着一小把雪的手
边角磨损发暗的小照片
photographers.explore_en: Photograph one small thing against emptiness, print it small, tone it warm, and let it age.
photographers.explore_zh: 在空无中拍一件小东西，印得很小，调成暖色，让它慢慢变旧。

photographers.intro_en: Umeme (2006) and Danshi (2007): boys pulling faces, grandpas mid-sneeze, dogs and uncles caught at the exact wrong second. Flash-lit compact-camera snapshots with perfect comic timing and real affection.
photographers.intro_zh: 《梅梅》（2006）和《男子》（2007）：做鬼脸的男孩、打喷嚏到一半的爷爷、在最不该的那一秒被抓住的狗和叔叔。小相机加闪光的快照，喜剧节奏完美，感情真实。

traits_en.color: Bright, ordinary, flash-lit colour.
traits_en.composition: Snapshot, centred, the face or gesture at the decisive silly moment.
traits_en.light: On-camera flash, daylight.
traits_en.tone: Medium contrast, slightly flat compact-camera look.

traits_zh.color: 明亮、普通、闪光灯打亮的彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 快照、居中，脸或动作停在最傻的那个决定性瞬间。
traits_zh.light: 机顶闪光，日光。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，小相机那种略平的质感。

signature_en: A schoolboy pulling a face at the camera
A grandfather mid-yawn beside a cat
A dog and an uncle with the same expression
signature_zh: 对着镜头做鬼脸的小学生
猫旁边打哈欠打到一半的爷爷
表情一模一样的狗和叔叔
photographers.explore_en: Carry a compact camera everywhere, use the flash, and press the shutter at the second everyone else would have waited.
photographers.explore_zh: 随身带小相机，开闪光，在别人都会再等一等的那一秒按下去。

photographers.intro_en: Kipuka (2018) followed the thread between Hawaii's Japanese plantation communities and Fukushima, where many came from: bon dances under lanterns, cherry trees after the disaster, shot on a rotating panoramic camera that bends the night into a long curve.
photographers.intro_zh: 《Kipuka》（2018）追寻夏威夷日裔种植园社区与福岛之间的线索（许多人来自那里）：灯笼下的盂兰盆舞、灾后的樱花树，用旋转式全景相机把夜晚弯成一道长弧。

traits_en.color: Warm lantern colour against deep night; natural greens by day.
traits_en.composition: Very wide panoramas, circles of dancers, bent horizons.
traits_en.light: Lantern light, long exposures, dusk.
traits_en.tone: Deep shadows with glowing warm highlights.
traits_en.texture: Motion in the dancers, film grain.

traits_zh.color: 深夜里温暖的灯笼色；白天是自然的绿。
traits_zh.composition: 很宽的全景、舞者的圆圈、弯曲的地平线。
traits_zh.light: 灯笼光、长曝光、黄昏。
traits_zh.tone: 深影配发光的暖高光。

signature_en: A ring of bon dancers under lanterns in a curved panorama
A cherry tree in Fukushima at night, lit from below
A plantation graveyard in Hawaii at dusk
signature_zh: 弯曲全景里灯笼下围成圈的盂兰盆舞者
夜里从下方照亮的福岛樱花树
黄昏时夏威夷种植园的墓地
photographers.explore_en: Follow a community's festival at night, use a very wide frame or a panoramic camera, and expose for the lanterns.
photographers.explore_zh: 跟着一个社群的夜祭，用很宽的画幅或全景相机，按灯笼曝光。

photographers.intro_en: Photographs rephotographed, boiled, scratched and reprinted until they are mostly grain and chemistry. Back Yard (2012), Vertigo (2014) and Linger (2014) are the picture as a degraded signal: a body, a room, a light, barely surviving the process.
photographers.intro_zh: 把照片翻拍、煮过、刮花、再印，直到剩下的大多是颗粒与化学。《Back Yard》（2012）、《Vertigo》（2014）和《Linger》（2014）把照片当作劣化的信号：一具身体、一个房间、一道光，勉强从过程中幸存。

traits_en.color: Mostly black and white; colour versions stained and shifted.
traits_en.composition: Barely legible fragments, close bodies, dark rooms.
traits_en.light: Flash, then destroyed in the darkroom.
traits_en.tone: Extreme contrast, blown highlights, chemical fog.

traits_zh.color: 以黑白为主；彩色版本带污渍与偏色。
traits_zh.composition: 几乎读不出的碎片、贴近的身体、黑暗的房间。
traits_zh.light: 先闪光，再在暗房里被毁掉。
traits_zh.tone: 极端反差、烧掉的高光、化学的雾。
traits_zh.texture: 巨大的颗粒、划痕、污渍、模糊。

signature_en: A nude dissolving into grain and chemical fog
A dark room lit by a flash and then boiled on paper
A print so degraded it is almost only texture
signature_zh: 溶进颗粒和化学雾气里的人体
被闪光照亮、又在相纸上煮过的黑屋子
劣化到几乎只剩质感的照片
photographers.explore_en: Make the photograph, then attack it: rephotograph the print, push the contrast, add noise, and keep only what survives.
photographers.explore_zh: 先拍出照片，再去攻击它：翻拍照片、拉高反差、加噪点，只留下幸存的部分。

photographers.magnum_note: Co-founded Magnum Photos in 1947.
photographers.intro_en: The photographer most associated with the decisive moment: a Leica, available light, and frames composed in the instant, never cropped afterwards. His work set the terms for candid street photography for half a century.
photographers.intro_zh: “决定性瞬间”的代名词。一台徕卡、现场光，构图在按下快门的一刻完成，从不裁切。他为此后半个世纪的街头抓拍定下了标准。

traits_en.color: Black and white; the few colour images he made he later disowned.
traits_en.composition: Geometry first: diagonals, repeated shapes, figures placed exactly where lines meet.
traits_en.light: Available light only, usually soft or open; no flash.
traits_en.tone: Full, even mid-grey scale with moderate contrast.
traits_en.texture: Fine 35 mm grain, natural sharpness, nothing forced.

traits_zh.color: 黑白为主，晚年几乎否定了自己少量的彩色作品。
traits_zh.composition: 几何优先：对角线、重复的形状，人物恰好落在线条交汇处。
traits_zh.light: 只用现场光，多为柔和或开阔的光线，从不用闪光灯。
traits_zh.tone: 完整而均匀的中灰影调，反差适中。
traits_zh.texture: 细腻的 135 颗粒，自然的清晰度，不做作。
traits_zh.mood: 从容而克制的优雅，有幽默但不嘲弄。

signature_en: Figures caught mid-step at the exact point of balance
Diagonals and echoes between foreground and background
Full-frame compositions with a thin black border
signature_zh: 人物在平衡点上被定格的那一步
前景与背景之间的对角线与呼应
带细黑边的满幅构图
series: Images à la sauvette / The Decisive Moment (1952)
photographers.explore_en: Shoot with one small camera and a fixed lens, wait for the geometry to resolve, and accept nothing you would need to crop.
photographers.explore_zh: 试试只带一台小相机和一支定焦镜头，等画面里的几何关系自己成形，不接受任何需要裁切的照片。
method_en: He trained as a painter first. Studying with the cubist André Lhote gave him the habit of seeing a scene as points, lines, planes and proportion, which is why his snapshots are composed like paintings.
The decisive moment is not shooting fast and hoping. It is recognising what an event means and, in the same fraction of a second, finding the instant when lines, light and figures fall into balance.
Find the stage, then wait. At Hyères he chose the spiral stair and the street below for their geometry and stayed until a cyclist rode into the frame.

Almost always one Leica rangefinder and one 50mm lens, the view closest to the eye, with no wide-angle stretch and no telephoto squeeze. He taped over the camera's shiny metal so no one would notice him.
No lights, no posing. Even for portraits of Sartre, Picasso and Camus he talked and waited until the sitter relaxed, then pressed the shutter.
Compose in the viewfinder. He opposed cropping afterwards and printed with the negative's black border to show the frame was as shot.
method_zh: 先学的是画。他跟立体派画家安德烈·洛特学过画，把画面拆成点、线、面和比例的习惯，就是从那时养成的，所以他的抓拍构图严谨得像油画。
决定性瞬间不是狂按快门碰运气。要在同一刹那里，既认出这件事的意义，又让画面里的线条、光影和人的位置刚好平衡，早一点晚一点都不行。
先找舞台，再等人。法国耶尔那张，是先看中了螺旋楼梯和街道的几何结构，守在那里，等一个骑车的人闯进来。
几乎只用一台徕卡旁轴和一颗 50mm 镜头。这个视角最接近人眼，没有广角的夸张，也没有长焦的压缩；他还用黑胶布贴住相机上发亮的金属，尽量不被人注意。
不打灯，不摆拍。拍萨特、毕加索、加缪这些人的肖像，也是一边聊天一边等，等对方放松下来的那一下再按快门。
构图在取景器里完成。他反对事后裁剪，放大照片时保留底片的黑边，表示画面就是按下快门时的样子。

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1949; its president from 1959 to 1962.
photographers.intro_en: A pioneer of colour photography who used slow shutter speeds, Kodachrome and reflections to turn the city into fields of colour and motion. Life magazine ran his New York colour essay in 1953, years before colour was accepted as art.
photographers.intro_zh: 彩色摄影的先驱。他用慢速快门、Kodachrome 和倒影，把城市变成流动的色块与动态。1953 年《生活》杂志刊登了他的纽约彩色专题，比彩色摄影被艺术界接受早了许多年。

traits_en.color: Saturated, warm slide-film colour, often one dominant hue filling the frame.
traits_en.composition: Loose, painterly; subject dissolves into pattern and streak.
traits_en.light: Low sun, backlight, wet streets and neon.
traits_en.texture: Motion blur and reflections replace fine detail.

traits_zh.color: 饱和而温暖的反转片色彩，常由一种主色占满画面。
traits_zh.composition: 松弛、绘画性，主体消融在图案和拖影里。
traits_zh.light: 低角度的太阳、逆光、湿漉漉的街道和霓虹。
traits_zh.tone: 浓郁的暗部与发光的高光。
traits_zh.texture: 动态模糊和倒影取代了细节。

signature_en: Panned motion that smears colour across the frame
Reflections in windows and puddles
Abstract colour fields found in ordinary surfaces
signature_zh: 追随摇摄把色彩抹过整个画面
橱窗与水洼里的倒影
在普通表面上发现抽象的色块
series: Images of a Magic City, Life (1953)
photographers.explore_en: Slow the shutter to a quarter second, follow something moving, and look for colour before you look for subject.
photographers.explore_zh: 把快门放慢到四分之一秒，跟着运动的东西摇，先找颜色，再找主体。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1953; served several terms as its president.
photographers.intro_en: The master of the visual joke: dogs at human height, couples mirrored in car mirrors, a beach seen through legs. The humour comes from timing and placement, never from mocking the subject.
photographers.intro_zh: 视觉幽默大师：狗狗视角的人间、后视镜里的情侣、从双腿之间看到的海滩。他的幽默来自时机和位置，从不嘲弄被摄者。

traits_en.color: Mostly black and white; colour work is restrained.
traits_en.composition: Clean, often centred, built around one juxtaposition.
traits_en.light: Open daylight; nothing dramatic.
traits_en.texture: Natural 35 mm grain, sharp where it matters.

traits_zh.color: 以黑白为主，彩色作品也很克制。
traits_zh.composition: 干净，常居中，围绕一个并置关系展开。
traits_zh.light: 开阔的日光，不追求戏剧性。
traits_zh.tone: 平稳的中间调，反差适中。
traits_zh.texture: 自然的 135 颗粒，该清晰的地方清晰。

signature_en: A dog and a person sharing one frame and one joke
Two things that rhyme visually
A low viewpoint at animal height
signature_zh: 一只狗和一个人共享一个画面、一个笑点
两个在视觉上押韵的东西
与动物齐平的低视角
photographers.explore_en: Look for two things in one frame that comment on each other, and wait for the moment when both are legible.
photographers.explore_zh: 在一个画面里找两个互相评论的东西，等它们同时清晰可读的那一刻。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1953 at Cartier-Bresson's invitation; full member from 1955.
photographers.intro_en: A reporter with a poet's eye, best known for the painter on the Eiffel Tower and the flower held up to bayonets at the Pentagon. He photographed China repeatedly from 1957 onward, always quietly, always from within the scene.
photographers.intro_zh: 有诗人眼光的记者。埃菲尔铁塔上的油漆工、五角大楼前举着花面对刺刀的女孩，都是他的作品。从 1957 年起他多次拍摄中国，总是安静地置身于场景之中。

traits_en.color: Chiefly black and white, with sober colour reportage later.
traits_en.composition: Frames within frames, figures small against structure.
traits_en.light: Daylight, often flat or misty.

traits_zh.color: 以黑白为主，后期有朴素的彩色报道。
traits_zh.composition: 画中画，人物在结构中显得很小。
traits_zh.light: 日光，常常平淡或带雾。
traits_zh.tone: 柔和开阔的中灰。
traits_zh.texture: 颗粒细腻，清晰度不刻意。
traits_zh.mood: 观察入微、尊重对象、带一点轻微的讽刺。

signature_en: A figure framed by a window or a steel structure
Graphic silhouettes against pale sky
Street life in China across decades
signature_zh: 被窗框或钢结构框住的人
淡色天空前的剪影
跨越几十年的中国街头
series: Marc Riboud in China: Forty Years of Photography (1996)
photographers.explore_en: Find a window, a doorway or a girder, and let someone pass through it before you release the shutter.
photographers.explore_zh: 找一扇窗、一道门或一根横梁，等有人从中经过再按快门。

photographers.magnum_note: Magnum member since 1958.
photographers.intro_en: A photographer who stays: months with a Brooklyn gang, two years on one Harlem block, a year riding the subway with a flash. The closeness shows in every frame.
photographers.intro_zh: 一个会留下来的摄影师：和布鲁克林的少年帮派相处数月，在哈莱姆的一个街区待了两年，带着闪光灯在地铁上拍了一年。这种亲近感渗透在每一张照片里。

traits_en.color: Black and white for most series; saturated flash colour in Subway.
traits_en.composition: Close, frontal, square or 35 mm, subject fills the frame.
traits_en.light: Available light indoors; direct flash on the subway.
traits_en.texture: Visible grain in the early work; crisp later.

traits_zh.color: 多数系列为黑白，《地铁》则是饱和的闪光灯彩色。
traits_zh.composition: 贴近、正面，主体充满画面。
traits_zh.light: 室内用现场光，地铁上用直打闪光。
traits_zh.tone: 深沉的黑、丰富的中间调。
traits_zh.texture: 早期颗粒明显，后期清晰。

signature_en: People who have let the camera in
Flash-lit faces against dark subway windows
A whole community seen from the inside
signature_zh: 已经接纳了相机的人们
闪光灯下、深色车窗前的面孔
从内部看到的一整个社区
photographers.explore_en: Pick one place or group and return to it until the camera is no longer an event.
photographers.explore_zh: 选一个地方或一群人，反复回去，直到相机不再是一件事。
