photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1959; full member from 1961. He withdrew from photography in the 1970s.
photographers.intro_en: A poet of tilted frames and low viewpoints who photographed Valparaíso and London with a wandering, dreamlike attention, then left photography for meditation. His pictures feel found rather than taken.
photographers.intro_zh: 倾斜画面和低视角的诗人。他以游荡般的、梦一样的专注拍摄瓦尔帕莱索和伦敦，随后放下摄影转向冥想。他的照片像是被发现的，而不是被拍下的。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Tilted horizons, figures cut by the frame edge, foreground blur.
traits_en.light: Harbour light, fog, stairways in shadow.
traits_en.texture: Grain and slight unsharpness are part of the voice.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 倾斜的地平线、被画框切断的人物、前景虚化。
traits_zh.light: 港口的光、雾、阴影里的阶梯。
traits_zh.tone: 柔和的黑、烟一样的灰。
traits_zh.texture: 颗粒和轻微的不清晰是语言的一部分。

signature_en: A tilted frame that makes a street feel like a dream
Children and cats on stairways
Figures entering from the edge of the picture
signature_zh: 让街道像梦一样的倾斜画面
阶梯上的孩子和猫
从画面边缘走进来的人
photographers.explore_en: Walk without a plan, hold the camera low or tilted, and keep the pictures that feel like half-remembered dreams.
photographers.explore_zh: 不带计划地走，把相机放低或倾斜，留下那些像半记得的梦一样的照片。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1963; full member from 1965.
photographers.intro_en: After an austere black-and-white portfolio of rural Greece, he turned to dense, saturated colour pictures of American public life: beaches, fairs and parades packed edge to edge with incident.
photographers.intro_zh: 在一组朴素的希腊乡村黑白作品之后，他转向密集、饱和的美国公共生活彩色影像：海滩、集市和游行，从边到边都塞满了事件。

traits_en.color: Hard, saturated primaries in bright sun.
traits_en.composition: Crowded, layered, many simultaneous actions.
traits_en.light: Direct midday sun and deep shadow.

traits_zh.color: 强烈阳光下硬朗饱和的三原色。
traits_zh.composition: 拥挤、层叠，许多动作同时发生。
traits_zh.light: 正午直射的太阳与深重的阴影。
traits_zh.tone: 高反差，自信的黑。

signature_en: Beach and parade crowds in hard sun
Several stories in one frame
Primary colours against deep shadow
signature_zh: 烈日下的海滩和游行人群
一个画面里的好几个故事
深影前的三原色
photographers.explore_en: Go where people gather in bright sun and fill the frame until nothing in it is empty.
photographers.explore_zh: 去人群在烈日下聚集的地方，把画面填满，直到没有一处是空的。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1971; full member from 1974.
photographers.intro_en: Photographer of exile and theatre, whose black and white carries an almost biblical weight: wide-angle, high-contrast frames in which people and animals seem to enact something larger than themselves.
photographers.intro_zh: 流亡与剧场的摄影师。他的黑白带着近乎圣经式的分量：广角、高反差的画面里，人和动物仿佛在演出比自身更大的事。

traits_en.color: Black and white only.
traits_en.composition: Wide angle, strong diagonals, figures against empty land or sky; later panoramic.
traits_en.light: Hard, raking light; heavy skies.

traits_zh.color: 只有黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 广角、强烈的对角线，人物置于空旷的土地或天空前；后期转向宽幅。
traits_zh.light: 坚硬的侧光，沉重的天空。
traits_zh.tone: 浓重的黑与压暗的高光。
traits_zh.texture: 明显的颗粒，粗粝的质感。

signature_en: A lone figure or animal against a vast, dark landscape
Gestures that look like ritual
Wide-angle distortion used for drama
signature_zh: 辽阔而幽暗的大地前孤独的人或动物
像仪式一样的动作
为戏剧性而用的广角畸变
photographers.explore_en: Use a wide lens close to the ground, wait for a gesture, and print darker than feels safe.
photographers.explore_zh: 用广角贴近地面，等一个动作，然后把照片印得比你觉得安全的更暗。
method_en: He trained as an aeronautical engineer and photographed theatre in Prague: the first gave him ruler-straight composition, the second taught him drama and emotional tension.
With the Roma he lived in their camps, neither looking down nor pitying, and photographed their dignity and wildness.
He favoured a 25mm wide angle, close enough to smell the sweat, yet the composition stays calm and exact: order inside chaos.
In the days after the 1968 invasion of Prague he went into the crowds at the front; the film was smuggled out and published under the anonymous credit P.P., Prague Photographer.
In exile he refused most commercial work, slept in parks and stations in summer and on the Magnum office floor in winter, trading possessions for the freedom to go anywhere.
Exile-period frames are often empty and solitary, a dog, a field of snow, standing for his own condition.
method_zh: 先当过航空工程师，又在布拉格剧院拍舞台：前者给了他尺子一样精确的构图，后者教会他戏剧冲突和情绪张力。
拍吉普赛人时住进他们的营地，不居高临下，也不同情，拍出的是他们的尊严和野性。
偏爱 25mm 广角，近到几乎闻得到人身上的汗味，但构图依旧冷静精确，乱中有序。
1968 年布拉格之春被镇压的那几天，他冲上街头贴近人群拍摄；照片偷运出境后以布拉格摄影师的匿名发表。
流亡后几乎不接商业工作，夏天睡公园和车站，冬天睡在玛格南办公室的地板上，用最少的物质换取想走就走的自由。
放逐时期的画面常常空旷、孤独，一只狗、一片雪地，就是他自己的处境。

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1976; full member from 1979.
photographers.intro_en: The most imitated colour street photographer alive: layered frames in which five things happen at once, held together by hard tropical light, saturated Kodachrome colour and shadows as black as ink.
photographers.intro_zh: 在世的彩色街头摄影师里被模仿最多的一位。层叠的画面里同时发生着五件事，靠热带的硬光、饱和的 Kodachrome 色彩和墨一样黑的阴影撑住。

traits_en.color: Intense, warm saturation; reds and yellows against cyan shade.
traits_en.composition: Extremely layered: foreground, middle and far distance all active; edges matter.
traits_en.light: Harsh low sun, slivers of light in deep shadow.
traits_en.tone: Very high contrast, large areas of pure black.

traits_zh.color: 强烈、温暖的饱和度；红与黄对着青色的阴影。
traits_zh.composition: 极度层叠：前景、中景、远景都在发生事情，画面边缘同样重要。
traits_zh.light: 刺眼的低角度阳光，深影里的一道光。
traits_zh.tone: 极高反差，大面积纯黑。

signature_en: Several figures stacked in depth, each lit differently
A sliver of hard light cutting a dark frame
Colour so saturated it becomes structure
signature_zh: 纵深里层层叠叠、各自受光的人物
切开暗画面的一道硬光
饱和到成为结构的色彩
series: Istanbul: City of a Hundred Names (2007)
photographers.explore_en: Shoot at the hours when shadows are black, stand where several things overlap in depth, and work the edges of the frame.
photographers.explore_zh: 在阴影全黑的时段拍摄，站在几样东西在纵深里重叠的位置，并且经营画面的边缘。
method_en: Colour was not a style chosen in advance. After long stays in the hard light and strong colours of Haiti and the Caribbean he found black and white could not hold what he felt, and moved to colour.
Colour and light decide the weight of the frame together: bright patches pull the eye first, deep shadows hide half the information, and people stepping into them become outlines.
Hard light is unforgiving, so he meters carefully on location, minding where the light falls and what should go dark.
Layers are not a queue: foreground, middle and background overlap and complete each other, leading the eye from near to middle to deep.
Walk and wait: drift with the rhythm of the street, stop at interesting light or backgrounds, and wait for unrelated people to meet briefly in the frame.
He returns to the same places for years, Haiti, the US-Mexico border, Istanbul, without rushing to a conclusion about them.
He edits books just as carefully: selection, sequence and spreads decide whether what a single frame leaves unsaid can connect.
method_zh: 彩色不是先定下的风格。他在海地和加勒比的强光与浓烈颜色里待久了，才发现黑白说不清自己的感受，于是转向彩色。
让颜色和光一起决定画面的轻重：亮处的色块先抓住视线，深重的阴影藏起一半信息，人走进去只剩轮廓。
硬光很难伺候，他在现场会仔细测光，在意光落在哪里、哪里该沉下去。
多层画面不是排队：前景、中景、背景互相遮挡、互相补充，视线从近处被带到中间，再到深处。
走和等：在街上游荡，让街道的节奏带着走；碰到有意思的光和背景就停下，等人物关系在画面里短暂相遇。
长期反复去同一个地方，比如海地、美墨边境、伊斯坦布尔，不急着给一个地方下结论。
编书时同样用心：选片、顺序和跨页决定了单张照片里没说完的东西能不能接上。

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1981; full member from 1986.
photographers.intro_en: A colourist first and a documentarian second: blocks of saturated colour, geometric shadow, and people reduced to shapes within the light. His Morocco and Belgian coast pictures look like painted film stills.
photographers.intro_zh: 先是色彩家，其次才是纪实者。饱和的色块、几何的阴影，人被简化为光线中的形状。他的摩洛哥和比利时海岸作品像上了色的电影剧照。

traits_en.color: Dense, saturated, often one warm block against one cool block.
traits_en.composition: Graphic, geometric, people as silhouettes in a colour arrangement.
traits_en.light: Hard directional light, long shadows, coloured artificial light.
traits_en.tone: Deep shadow, rich mid-tones, little white.

traits_zh.color: 浓密、饱和，常是一块暖色对一块冷色。
traits_zh.composition: 图形化、几何化，人是色彩安排里的剪影。
traits_zh.light: 坚硬的方向光、长长的影子、带色的人造光。
traits_zh.tone: 深影、丰富的中间调，很少纯白。

signature_en: A figure standing in a rectangle of coloured light
Shadow geometry dividing the frame
Colour that feels like a stage set
signature_zh: 站在一块有色光线里的人
把画面切分开的阴影几何
像舞台布景的色彩
photographers.explore_en: Treat light and shadow as flat shapes, place a person inside one, and let the colour do the talking.
photographers.explore_zh: 把光和影当作平面的形状，把一个人放进其中一块，让色彩说话。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Magnum member since 1986.
photographers.intro_en: The photographer of Afghan Girl and the monsoon essays: direct, centred colour portraits and travel pictures in which vivid dress and painted walls carry the frame. Admired for colour and criticised for staging; both are part of the style.
photographers.intro_zh: 《阿富汗少女》和季风专题的作者。直接、居中的彩色肖像与旅行影像，靠鲜艳的服饰和彩绘的墙面撑起画面。因色彩被推崇，也因摆布被批评，两者都是这种风格的一部分。

traits_en.color: Vivid, warm, complementary pairs: red against green, saffron against blue.
traits_en.composition: Centred subject, direct gaze, clean background.
traits_en.light: Soft overcast or window light on faces; saturated dusk.

traits_zh.color: 鲜艳、温暖、互补的配对：红对绿、藏红花色对蓝。
traits_zh.composition: 主体居中、直视镜头、背景干净。
traits_zh.light: 面部用柔和的阴天光或窗光；饱和的黄昏。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，平滑的肤色。
traits_zh.mood: 人文、如画、强烈的眼神交流。

signature_en: A face looking straight into the lens, centred
Red or saffron cloth against a cool wall
Monsoon rain and reflections
signature_zh: 居中、直视镜头的面孔
冷色墙面前的红色或藏红花色布料
季风雨与倒影
photographers.explore_en: Ask permission, place the person in the centre, find a plain wall of a contrasting colour, and wait for the eyes.
photographers.explore_zh: 先征得同意，把人放在中央，找一面颜色对比的素墙，然后等眼神。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1988; full member from 1994; president 2013–2017.
photographers.intro_en: Satirist of consumer life, shooting with ring flash and saturated film in full daylight so that sunburn, chips and souvenir shops glow with unflattering clarity. The joke is on all of us, himself included.
photographers.intro_zh: 消费生活的讽刺者。他在大白天用环形闪光灯和饱和胶片拍摄，让晒伤的皮肤、薯条和纪念品商店在毫不美化的清晰度里发光。笑话针对我们所有人，包括他自己。

traits_en.color: Garish, saturated, flash-filled colour.
traits_en.composition: Close, often cropped tight on food, hands or objects.
traits_en.light: Daylight plus fill flash; no shadows hide anything.
traits_en.texture: Extremely sharp; every pore and crumb visible.

traits_zh.color: 俗艳、饱和、被闪光灯填满的色彩。
traits_zh.composition: 贴近，常紧紧裁在食物、手或物件上。
traits_zh.light: 日光加补光闪光，没有任何东西藏在阴影里。
traits_zh.tone: 明亮、开放，几乎没有深影。
traits_zh.texture: 极其清晰，每一个毛孔和碎屑都看得见。
traits_zh.mood: 面无表情的喜剧，带人类学式的观察。

signature_en: Flash-lit food and sunburnt skin
Tourists photographing tourists
Garish colour in ordinary British places
signature_zh: 闪光灯下的食物和晒伤的皮肤
拍游客的游客
普通英国场所里的俗艳色彩
photographers.explore_en: Add fill flash in daylight, get closer to the thing people find embarrassing, and keep a straight face.
photographers.explore_zh: 在日光下加补光闪光，靠近人们觉得难为情的东西，保持面无表情。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1988; full member from 1994.
photographers.intro_en: A photographer of light itself: fragments of colour, reflections and projected patterns fall across people and rooms until the subject is almost lost. Tokyo and Moscow dissolve into kaleidoscopes.
photographers.intro_zh: 拍摄光本身的摄影师。色彩的碎片、倒影和投射的图案落在人和房间上，直到主体几乎消失。东京和莫斯科在他镜头里化成万花筒。

traits_en.color: Fractured, saturated, coloured by whatever light source is nearest.
traits_en.composition: Dense overlaps of reflection, shadow and figure; no clear centre.
traits_en.light: Striped, dappled, projected and reflected light; strong directionality.
traits_en.tone: Deep darks pierced by bright fragments.

traits_zh.color: 碎裂、饱和，被最近的光源染色。
traits_zh.composition: 倒影、阴影和人物密集地重叠，没有明确的中心。
traits_zh.light: 条纹的、斑驳的、投射和反射的光，方向性很强。
traits_zh.tone: 深暗中被明亮的碎片刺穿。
traits_zh.texture: 混合的：清晰的碎片旁边就是模糊。
traits_zh.mood: 梦幻、运动感、不带个人情绪。

signature_en: Light through blinds striping a crowd
Reflections that split a figure in pieces
Colour patches with no obvious source
signature_zh: 百叶窗的光给人群打上条纹
把人物切成碎片的倒影
来源不明的色块
photographers.explore_en: Photograph the light before the thing it lands on: blinds, glass, water, screens.
photographers.explore_zh: 先拍光，再拍光落在的东西：百叶窗、玻璃、水面、屏幕。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 2002; full member from 2007.
photographers.intro_en: Light as a physical force: Sydney pedestrians burnt to white silhouettes, shadows as black as space, grain like sand. His black and white is among the most extreme in contemporary documentary photography.
photographers.intro_zh: 把光当作一种物理力量：悉尼的行人被烧成白色剪影，阴影黑得像太空，颗粒像沙子。他的黑白是当代纪实摄影中最极端的之一。

traits_en.color: Mostly black and white; the colour work keeps the same violence of light.
traits_en.composition: Figures isolated by light or dark; often simple, iconic shapes.
traits_en.light: Extreme backlight, blown highlights used deliberately.
traits_en.tone: Near-pure blacks and whites, little grey.

traits_zh.color: 以黑白为主，彩色作品保留了同样暴烈的光。
traits_zh.composition: 人物被光或暗孤立出来，形状简单而标志性。
traits_zh.light: 极端逆光，刻意让高光过曝。
traits_zh.tone: 接近纯黑与纯白，灰很少。

signature_en: Silhouettes burning in a wall of white light
Grain so coarse it becomes texture
Ordinary streets made supernatural
signature_zh: 在白光墙里燃烧的剪影
粗到成为质感的颗粒
被变得超自然的普通街道
photographers.explore_en: Shoot straight into low sun, expose for the shadows and let the highlights go; push the film hard.
photographers.explore_zh: 直对低角度的太阳拍，按暗部曝光，让高光飞掉；大力迫冲胶片。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 2004; full member from 2008.
photographers.intro_en: Large-format wanderer of the American interior: quiet, slightly melancholy portraits of strangers and the rooms and riverbanks they live beside. The pictures are still, soft in colour and generous with space.
photographers.intro_zh: 用大画幅游荡于美国腹地的人。安静、略带忧郁的陌生人肖像，以及他们栖身的房间和河岸。画面静止，色彩柔和，留白慷慨。

traits_en.color: Muted, pale, slightly cool; colour never shouts.
traits_en.composition: Centred subject, lots of room around it, frontal.
traits_en.light: Overcast or window light; gentle.
traits_en.tone: Low contrast, open shadows, soft highlights.

traits_zh.color: 柔和、淡、略冷，色彩从不喧哗。
traits_zh.composition: 主体居中、四周留出大量空间、正面。
traits_zh.light: 阴天或窗光，温和。
traits_zh.tone: 低反差、明亮的暗部、柔和的高光。
traits_zh.texture: 大画幅的细节，没有颗粒。

signature_en: A stranger standing still in the middle of the frame
Beds, rooms and riverbanks as portraits of absence
Pale colour and soft, even light
signature_zh: 静止站在画面中央的陌生人
作为缺席肖像的床、房间和河岸
淡色与柔和均匀的光
series: I Know How Furiously Your Heart Is Beating (2019)
photographers.explore_en: Slow down to one frame per encounter: ask a stranger to stand still, use overcast light, and leave space around them.
photographers.explore_zh: 放慢到每次相遇只拍一张：请陌生人静静站着，用阴天的光，在他们周围留出空间。

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1998; full member from 2002.
photographers.intro_en: The flash in your face: wide lens, hand-held strobe, a stride away from strangers on Fifth Avenue. Later the same confrontation in colour, in portraits so close that every wrinkle is a landscape.
photographers.intro_zh: 怼到脸上的闪光灯：广角镜头、手持闪光、离第五大道上的陌生人只有一步。后来同样的对峙转为彩色，肖像近到每一道皱纹都是风景。

traits_en.color: Black and white street; later hard, flat colour portraits.
traits_en.composition: Extreme close-up, wide-angle distortion, subject filling the frame.
traits_en.light: Direct hand-held flash, falling off into darkness behind.
traits_en.tone: Harsh contrast, flash-white faces, black backgrounds.
traits_en.texture: Every pore rendered; grain in the film work.

traits_zh.color: 街头黑白；后期是硬而平的彩色肖像。
traits_zh.composition: 极端特写、广角畸变、主体塞满画面。
traits_zh.light: 手持直打闪光，背后迅速陷入黑暗。
traits_zh.tone: 刺眼的反差，闪光下发白的脸，黑色背景。
traits_zh.texture: 每一个毛孔都被呈现；胶片作品带颗粒。

signature_en: A flash-lit face one step from the lens
Wide-angle distortion of a crowd
Background dropped to black by flash fall-off
signature_zh: 离镜头一步、被闪光打亮的脸
广角畸变下的人群
闪光衰减后变成纯黑的背景
photographers.explore_en: Use a wide lens and a small flash, step inside the distance people find comfortable, and do not apologise.
photographers.explore_zh: 用广角和小闪光灯，走进人们觉得舒适的距离之内，并且不要道歉。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 2007; full member from 2012.
photographers.intro_en: High-contrast, grain-soaked black and white of extreme closeness: a girlfriend in a Greenland village, strangers in Tokyo, bodies and faces pressed against the lens. Tender and raw at once.
photographers.intro_zh: 高反差、浸满颗粒的黑白，距离近到极致：格陵兰村庄里的女友、东京的陌生人、贴到镜头前的身体和面孔。既温柔又生猛。

traits_en.color: Black and white only.
traits_en.composition: Very close, fragmentary, bodies cropped by the edge.
traits_en.light: Flash or hard window light; backgrounds vanish.
traits_en.tone: Blacks and whites with almost no mid-grey.
traits_en.texture: Coarse grain, soft focus, smeared highlights.

traits_zh.color: 只有黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 非常近、碎片化，身体被画框切断。
traits_zh.light: 闪光灯或硬窗光，背景消失。
traits_zh.tone: 几乎没有中灰的黑与白。
traits_zh.texture: 粗颗粒、柔焦、晕开的高光。

signature_en: A face or hand almost touching the lens
Skin rendered as grain and light
Snow, breath and bare rooms
signature_zh: 几乎碰到镜头的脸或手
被呈现为颗粒与光的皮肤
雪、呼吸和空荡的房间
photographers.explore_en: Photograph only people you are close to, from closer than feels polite, and print with no grey at all.
photographers.explore_zh: 只拍你亲近的人，从比礼貌更近的距离拍，然后印成完全没有灰的照片。

provenance.style_vector_note: editorial estimates of a body of work, not measurements

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum in 1995; full member from 2001.
photographers.intro_en: Long-term black-and-white documentary of belonging and displacement: patients chained in pairs at a Taiwanese temple asylum, immigrant workers in New York's Chinatown, arranged marriages between Taiwan and Vietnam.
photographers.intro_zh: 关于归属与离散的长期黑白纪实：台湾寺庙疗养院里被铁链成对拴住的病人、纽约唐人街的移民劳工、台湾与越南之间的跨国婚姻。

traits_en.color: Black and white.
traits_en.composition: Frontal pairs and groups; cramped interiors; square or 35 mm.
traits_en.light: Available light in small rooms; flat and honest.

traits_zh.color: 黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 正面的成对与群像；逼仄的室内。
traits_zh.light: 小房间里的现场光，平实而诚实。
traits_zh.tone: 中高反差，诚实的灰。
traits_zh.texture: 自然的颗粒，直接的清晰度。

signature_en: Two people bound together, literally or by circumstance
Small rooms that hold whole lives
Faces that look back without performing
signature_zh: 被真实的链条或处境绑在一起的两个人
装下一整个人生的小房间
不表演地回望镜头的脸
photographers.explore_en: Choose a community with a question in it, and photograph the same people for years rather than days.
photographers.explore_zh: 选一个带着问题的社群，用几年而不是几天去拍同一群人。

photographers.magnum_note: Magnum member from 1979 to 1994, when he left to found Amazonas Images.
photographers.intro_en: Epic black-and-white documentary on a biblical scale: the Serra Pelada gold mine, global labour, migration, and finally the untouched planet in Genesis. Dramatic skies and silvery tonality give every frame monumental weight.
photographers.intro_zh: 史诗尺度的黑白纪实：佩拉达山金矿、全球劳工、迁徙，最后是《创世纪》里未被触碰的地球。戏剧性的天空和银质的影调让每一帧都有纪念碑般的分量。

traits_en.color: Black and white only.
traits_en.composition: Vast scale, layered crowds or landscapes, strong horizon lines.
traits_en.light: Dramatic backlight, storm skies, dust and mist.
traits_en.tone: Rich silver mid-tones, deep blacks, luminous highlights.

traits_zh.color: 只有黑白。
traits_zh.composition: 宏大的尺度，层叠的人群或风景，强烈的地平线。
traits_zh.light: 戏剧性的逆光、风暴的天空、尘土与雾。
traits_zh.tone: 丰富的银灰中间调、深黑、发光的高光。

signature_en: Thousands of figures in one frame
Storm light over a vast landscape
Silvery, dramatic monochrome
signature_zh: 一个画面里成千上万的人
辽阔风景上的风暴光
银质而戏剧性的黑白
photographers.explore_en: Step back until the scene becomes landscape, wait for weather, and let the sky carry half the frame.
photographers.explore_zh: 退后到场景变成风景，等天气，让天空占据半个画面。

photographers.magnum_note: Joined Magnum as an associate in 1971 and later became a full member; the only Japanese full member of his generation.
photographers.intro_en: He photographed China for a decade when few outsiders could, then Korea, Burma and his own Japan, in a calm, classical colour that favours the long view: a landscape first, and people living inside it.
photographers.intro_zh: 在外人很难进入的年代拍了中国十年，之后是朝鲜半岛、缅甸和他自己的日本，用一种沉着、古典的彩色，偏爱远观：先是风景，然后是生活在其中的人。

traits_en.color: Natural, measured Kodachrome-era colour; blues and earth tones.
traits_en.composition: Wide, balanced, often from a high vantage; figures placed in landscape.
traits_en.light: Dawn and dusk, mist, soft sun.

traits_zh.color: 自然、有分寸的 Kodachrome 年代彩色；蓝与土色。
traits_zh.composition: 宽广、均衡，常从高处取景；人物置于风景中。
traits_zh.light: 黎明与黄昏、雾、柔和的阳光。
traits_zh.tone: 中等反差，干净均匀。
traits_zh.texture: 细腻、锐利，反转片的清晰。

signature_en: Guilin's karst peaks in mist with a lone fisherman
A Pyongyang mass game seen from above
Mount Fuji at dawn over a quiet town
signature_zh: 雾中桂林的山峰与一个孤单的渔夫
从高处俯瞰的平壤团体操
黎明时安静小镇上方的富士山
photographers.explore_en: Climb to a vantage point at dawn, wait for mist or soft light, and let people be small within a large, balanced landscape.
photographers.explore_zh: 黎明时爬到高处，等雾或柔光，让人在一片宽广、均衡的风景里小小的。
